sp-04213.description_en: All of target's RR's suffer a penalty of -5 for the duration.

sp-04219.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -10 for the duration.

sp-04225.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -15 for the duration.

sp-04231.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -25 for the duration.

sp-04234.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells on this list once per round.

sp-04235.description_en: The caster senses the presence of any Holy or Unholy objects in the area. Caster may concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-04237.description_en: Target Channeling spell user loses some of his faith in his church, religion, deity, etc. For the duration of this spell, all of target's spells will require a spell casting static maneuver with a special penalty of -20 (-10 if target is a Hybrid spell user, -5 if target is an Arcane spell user).

sp-04238.description_en: Target becomes guilty over some action in his past. The GM should choose some significant event in the target's past. He will not perform similar actions again and must take steps to alleviate the guilt.

sp-04239.description_en: The target may not send or receive spells or power points for the duration. In addition, target may not "regain" spent PPs for the duration.

sp-04240.description_en: Target will trust no one absolutely. When in a life threatening/ dangerous situation, there is a 50% chance (modified by Self Discipline bonus x 3) that he will not put his safety in the • hands of others.

sp-04242.description_en: As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -30 (-15 for hybrids; and -10 for Arcane users).

sp-04243.description_en: The target believes he has fallen into disfavor with

sp-04259.description_en: This spell influences the target's decision about who to attack. If the target of this spell is (or will be within 2 rounds) choosing his mdee opponent, this spell will influence that decision 20% away from the caster. Other opponents must be available for this spell to work.

sp-04260.description_en: The caster causes the target to believe that he is being watched all the time and puts him at -10% to activity.

sp-04262.description_en: The target will not attack the caster.

sp-04265.description_en: Target will flee in terror as fast as he can from the caster.

sp-04268.description_en: The target must obey the caster's suggestions as long as the suggestions are not alien to him (e.g., suicide, blinding himself, etc.).

sp-04270.description_en: As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is

sp-04271.description_en: As Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -75.

sp-04272.description_en: Target is given one task; failure results in a penalty to be determined by the GM.

sp-04273.description_en: As Unnerving Eye I, except the penalty is -50.

sp-04274.description_en: As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is

sp-04276.description_en: As Look of Diifigure I, except the penalty is -100.

sp-04277.description_en: As Unncroing Eye I, except the penalty is -75.

sp-04278.description_en: A;;. Look of Terror I, except the penalty is

sp-04279.description_en: Target's appearance is so revolting that almost no one will deal with him. Resolve as Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -150.

sp-04280.description_en: Target must resist or die. SrECIAL Non

sp-04304.description_en: Allows caster to make his body somewhat malleable and flexible to avoid attacks. Gives +5 to DB. The bonus only applies to attacks that the caster perceives.

sp-04305.description_en: The fingers on one of the caster's hands transform into sharp talons. The caster can make Small Claw attacks with these talons.

sp-04306.description_en: Caster can move one small part of his body to another location. For example, an eye could be moved to the tip of a finger to look down a small hole, a finger could be moved to the wrist to untie a rope bond, etc. This spell can only be used to move a small body part.

sp-04307.description_en: Caster's mouth fills with razor-sharp teeth. Caster may make Small Bite attacks.

sp-04308.description_en: Caster grows a set of large bat-like wings that he can use to fly at 50 feet per round. While doing so, the caster expends exhaustion points as if moving at a running pace.

sp-04309.description_en: As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Medium Claw attacks.

sp-04311.description_en: As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 100 feet per round.

sp-04312.description_en: As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Medium Bite attacks.

sp-04313.description_en: Caster's tongue becomes a 3-foot-long whip that can make a Large Grapple attack.

sp-04314.description_en: One of the caster's anns transforms into a snake that can make Large Grapple attacks.

sp-04315.description_en: As Miner Body Switch, except that any part of the body (excepting the head) can be moved to a different location. For example, an arm could be moved to a place where it could be more useful.

sp-04317.description_en: As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 200 feet per round.

sp-04318.description_en: As Shifting Defense, except bonus is

sp-04319.description_en: As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Large Bite attacks.

sp-04321.description_en: As Snake Arm, except caster can make Huge Grapple attacks.

sp-04322.description_en: As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Huge Claw attacks.

sp-04323.description_en: As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 300 feet per round. In addition, anyone who makes contact with the caster must make a RR or take a 'B' Heat critical.

sp-04324.description_en: As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Huge Bite attacks.

sp-04325.description_en: Target that meets the caster's gaze must make an RR or be turned to stone for 1 minute per 5% failure level. Caster can only gaze at one such target per round.

sp-04326.description_en: Caster can make any one of the lower level changes on this list permanent. Once per year, the caster can choose another effect to make permanent.

sp-04730.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of+ 10 to his next maneuver using a skill in the Urban skill category.

sp-04731.description_en: Target must answer a single concept question (presuming that the target can understand the question).

sp-04732.description_en: Caster has a dream about what mission his deity or church might have for him next. The dream is vague, and the caster must figure out what the dream means.

sp-04733.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and the Gamemaster will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable by 25% (e.g., roll a 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).

sp-04734.description_en: Caster's next spell within the duration is cast as if the caster were shouting, but the spell does not make a sound.

sp-04736.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he takes a specific action.

sp-04737.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +30 to all maneuvers using the Religion skill for the duration.

sp-04738.description_en: As Urban Lore I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04739.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity). The target of the spell is stunned.

sp-04740.description_en: As Question I, except the target must respond to up to 10 single concept questions.

sp-04741.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any one dead target through the eyes of the deceased. He also gets a view of the killer (if any). The caster must be within 10 feet of the corpse. The corpse must have died within a number of years equal to the caster's level.

sp-04742.description_en: Caster can make contact with any one known target he is acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being.

sp-04743.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 5 minutes into the future.

sp-04744.description_en: As Holy Vision, except the caster is shown details about the mission, and the place to begin.

sp-04745.description_en: As Stunning, except the target is blinded for the duration.

sp-04747.description_en: Causes target to misperceive events. Caster can choose whether the target sees nothing or just something vague and different from an actual event. The spell cannot make out of place events seem normal (e.g. fighting will always be seen for what it is), but an intruder could be misperceived as a passing sentry.

sp-04748.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's "soul" is torn from his body; it remains in whatever place souls go for the duration of the spell. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. Target is unconscious until soul is restored. Even subconscious activities (i.e., healing, etc.) suffer a -75 penalty.

sp-04749.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any one dead target within 10 feet. Caster gets an understanding of the reason(s) the deceased died, exactly who the killer was (if any), and who was ultimately responsible (if anyone). Corpse may be of any age.

sp-04750.description_en: As Commune, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only one concept.

sp-04751.description_en: As Absolution, except "soul" can only be brought back through Lifegiving.

sp-04752.description_en: Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question. SPECIAL Nons

sp-04753.description_en: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the caster, and adds 5 to all of the caster's RRs versus spells. If the spells are cast by a Channeling spell user that is a member of the caster's current studied faith (see "The Mask" spell list), the bonuses become +10.

sp-04754.description_en: For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any fear RRs.

sp-04755.description_en: For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any poison RRs.

sp-04756.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.

sp-04757.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are +10 and + 15 respectively.

sp-04758.description_en: Grants +10 DB versus melee and missile attacks. Not cumulative with Aura or Blur spells.

sp-04759.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10 feet of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-04760.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 3.

sp-04761.description_en: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-04762.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are + 15 and +20, respectively.

sp-04763.description_en: For the duration, the caster gains a bonus of +30 against any attempts by others to convert him. The same bonus applies to the caster's RRs vs. spells of any other religion that attempt to convert or corrupt him.

sp-04764.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 8.

sp-04765.description_en: As Deflections I, except affects two missiles.

sp-04766.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +15.

sp-04767.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are + 20 and +30, respectively.

sp-04768.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects two attacks.

sp-04769.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 12.

sp-04770.description_en: Gives the caster a bonus of +20 against any Absolution spells or against any Black Channel spells. This bonus is cumulative with other protection spells.

sp-04771.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04772.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 20.

sp-04773.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are +30 and +50, respectively.

sp-04774.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04775.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list once per round. SPECIAL Nons

sp-04786.description_en: Detects any poisons on a single object or a area of effect. single being.

sp-04787.description_en: As Detect Holy/Unholy, except for invisibility, or other misrepresentations of the truth. range and duration.

sp-04788.description_en: Caster learns the direction and distance to any one exactly where the target is located. of the caster's "Marks."

sp-04789.description_en: Attempts to learn from the target's mind what this list once per round. Divine Status level he has. See Section 6.0 for more information on Divine Status.

sp-04790.description_en: Caster can remember an exact route he traveled, whether or not he was without one or more of his senses when he made his original journey (e.g. a 12th level caster could remember the course of 12 hours of a trip even if he had been blindfolded). To be effective, this spell must be cast within one month of the journey.

sp-04791.description_en: Caster receives a divine vision of one of the caster's "Marks" specified at the time of casting. The vision will only reveal general activities of the target (i.e., target is fighting, target is sleeping, target is gambling, etc.). The caster's "Mark" must be within range of this spell, location of the "Mark" will not be revealed.

sp-04792.description_en: As Tracking, except the bonus is +75.

sp-04793.description_en: As Perceive Power, except for range and area of effect.

sp-04794.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other

sp-04821.description_en: Adds + 10 to one maneuver the round after this spell is cast. No other action can be performed until this maneuver is resolved.

sp-04823.description_en: Caster can ignore up to -10 in accrued penalties from injuries or concussion hit loss.

sp-04824.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round; for 1 hour, caster can move at no more than a walking pace, or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-04825.description_en: Caster is relieved of one round's worth of accumulated stun effects.

sp-04826.description_en: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-04827.description_en: Will reduce damage to the caster by 1 hit every minute as long as the caster concentrates. If the caster is unconscious this spell will operate on him without concentration.

sp-04828.description_en: As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round.

sp-04829.description_en: As Tolerance I, except up to -20 in accrued penalties can be ignored.

sp-04830.description_en: As Inner Focus I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04831.description_en: As Unpain I, except an additional 50% can be sustained.

sp-04832.description_en: As Regeneration /, except caster's damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute of concentration.

sp-04834.description_en: Caster can cure any one paralysis problem.

sp-04835.description_en: As Clotting I, except that all blood loss (i.e. hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-04844.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +20 to any Ambush maneuvers made within the duration. This spell adds no ranks to caster's Ambush skill, it only helps to succeed in the Ambush maneuver roll.

sp-04845.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +20 to any Silent Kill maneuvers made within the duration.

sp-04846.description_en: Caster can summon a weapon within range to his hand. The weapon travels at 100 feet per round (with no acceleration), avoiding obstacles if possible. If the weapon is restrained, it cannot break free.

sp-03233.description_en: Allows caster to take the physical form of a Jellyfish (the caster gains the abilities of this new form). The transformation takes ten complete rounds of concentration to occur.

sp-03234.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a normal Starfish, and the transformation takes only nine rounds.

sp-03235.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a small fish, and the transformation takes only eight rounds. Upon reaching 5th level the caster may use the medium variety and upon reaching 10th level the caster may use the large variety.

sp-03236.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a normal Crab, and the transformation takes only seven rounds.

sp-03237.description_en: As jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a Sea Snake, and the transformation takes only six rounds.

sp-03238.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of an Eei and the transformation takes only five rounds. Upon reaching 5th level use Moray Eel stats, upon reaching 10th level use Conger Eel stats and upon reaching 15th level use Electric Eel stats.

sp-03239.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a Turtle. Upon reaching 10th level use large Turtle stats, and the transformation takes only four rounds.

sp-03240.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of an Octopus, and the transformation takes only three rounds. Upon reaching 10th level use Medium stats and upon reaching 15th level use Large stats.

sp-03241.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a Portugese Man-o-war, and the transformation takes only two rounds.

sp-03243.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Dolphin. Up to 9th level use River Dolphin stats. Upon reaching 10th level use Dolphin stats, upon reaching 15th level use Porpoise stats and upon reaching 25th level use Killer Whale stats.

sp-03244.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Ray. Up to 5th level use Manta Ray stats, upon reaching 10th level use Sting Ray stats, upon reaching 15th level use Electric Ray stats and upon reaching 20th level use Sawfish stats.

sp-03245.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Water Hound.

sp-03246.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Sailfish or Swordfish.

sp-03247.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Merman.

sp-03248.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Shark. Up to 15th level use Small stats. Thereafter use Large stats.

sp-03249.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Lake Worm.

sp-03250.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Whale. Up to 15th level use Toothed, Small stats, upon reaching 30th level use Toothed, Large stats and upon reaching 50th level use Baleen stats.

sp-03251.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Sea Troll.

sp-03253.description_en: Form - As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Dragon Salamander.

sp-03254.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Sea Drake.

sp-03298.description_en: Allows caster to communicate with his deity on how best to conduct his divine duties. He will receive a general feeling about how best to run the ceremonies of his religion so as to increase the faith and dedication of its members. Will also add a special bonus of +10 to any Religion static maneuvers.

sp-03299.description_en: Puts the blessing of the caster's church on an important event. Any activities at the event will receive a special bonus of +5 to appropriate maneuvers.

sp-03300.description_en: Seals marriage vows and renders the union acceptable by the caster's deity.

sp-03303.description_en: The target's vestment becomes AT 3 with a special bonus of +10 to DB. For the duration of the spell, the vestment will resist all soiling. Will not clean a dirty vestment. The vestment must first be consecrated with Holy Vestment.

sp-03304.description_en: Places the target under a vow to accomplish a goal for the church. Violation will result in penalties and consequences to be determined by the church (i.e., the GM). Success or failure may also result in changes in the target's Divine Status.

sp-03305.description_en: Converts 4 ounces of clear spring water to holy water. Holy water is used for ceremonies and to combat Undead. Undead take 'B' Holy Spell criticals when splashed. The water should be stored in as pure a container as possible or it will lose its potency quickly.

sp-03321.description_en: Caster cleanses his thoughts and spirit to reduce the chance of him tainting a summoned spirit. This spell reduces the chance of the caster tainting the spirit by 50%. This spell must be cast prior to summoning a spirit.

sp-03322.description_en: Caster removes d 10 levels of taint from a given spirit. This spell is used usually after, and sometimes before, a spirit will do something requested by the caster. Each level of taint that a spirit has gives it a special bonus of +5 to its RR

sp-03323.description_en: Caster's spirit leaves his body to wander the physical world, and can travel at normal walking speed for the duration of this spell. While in spirit form, the caster is invisible, and cannot affect the physical world in any way. The caster's spirit cannot do anything that his normal physical body cannot do (e.g. fly, walk through walls, etc.). If the caster's spirit has not returned to the caster's body before the end of the spell, the caster must make an RR versus his own level or he will die. This RR must be made every minute past the end of the spell in which the caster's spirit is not back in his body.

sp-03324.description_en: The caster will have a vision related to a topic chosen prior to this spell being cast. A single topic may be the subject of one vision per day, additional attempts will repeat the previous vision. Note that this spell will always take an hour, even though the visions created by it may seem to last but a moment, or an eternity.

sp-03328.description_en: When cast prior to any other chant from this list, (which must be cast within one minute of finishing this spell) the caster may include in the chant up to one additional target per every five full levels of the caster. Each participant must be touching at least one other participant of the spell.

sp-03329.description_en: As Spirit Walk I, except that caster may move at double his normal walking pace, and he may float/fly at a rate of 10 feet per round.

sp-03330.description_en: As Warning Chant, except that the caster will know exactly what condition was broken. This will give the caster all information that he would be able to normally detect using his senses (e.g., if a person entered the radius of the Awareness Chant, he would know who entered and from what direction, but if that person were invisible, he would only know that the radius of the spell had been crossed and where it was crossed; he would not be able to tell who broke the condition of the spell).

sp-03331.description_en: As Vision Chant I, except that the caster can have up to three visions, each lasting one hour each. Each vision must be on a separate topic.

sp-03332.description_en: As Healing Chant II, except that all wounds are healed at a rate of three times normal.

sp-03333.description_en: When cast, this spell instantly returns the caster's spirit to his body without penalty. This works for both Spirit Walk and Spirit Travel spells.

sp-03334.description_en: As Spirit Walk II, except that the caster may move at up to triple his normal walking pace, and may pass through non-magical substances (e.g. walls) at a rate of one foot per round.

sp-03336.description_en: As Vision Chant III, except that the caster may have up to five separate dreams.

sp-03337.description_en: As Healing Chant ll, except that the caster may heal at up to four times his normal healing rate.

sp-03338.description_en: As Spirit Walk III, except that the caster may move at up to four times his normal walking pace, and he may float/fly at a rate of up to 100 feet per round.

sp-03339.description_en: As Vision Chant Ill, except that the caster may have visions relating to up to ten different topics.

sp-03340.description_en: As Spirit Walk IV, except that the caster may move at up to five times his base walking rate, and he is able to pass through non-magical solid matter at a rate of up to 10 feet per round.

sp-03341.description_en: As Healing Chant IV, except the caster may heal himself at five times his normal healing rate.

sp-03343.description_en: Grants the caster a special bonus of +10 bonus to his History (Battles) maneuvers.

sp-03344.description_en: Grants the caster a special bonus of +10 bonus to on his Military Organization maneuvers.

sp-03345.description_en: Grants the caster a special bonus of +10 bonus to all recruitment activities in one settlement.

sp-03347.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +10 to his Tactics maneuvers.

sp-03348.description_en: Caster's entire unit gains a special bonus of +5 to all melee attacks and morale maneuvers this round.

sp-03349.description_en: The caster becomes more easily recognizable as the leader of a unit. Commands from the caster carry more weight. This adds a special bonus of +10 to the caster's Leadership maneuvers.

sp-03350.description_en: All maneuvers using skills in the Awareness group that relate to battle are made with a special bonus of +15.

sp-03351.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 to any Frenzy maneuver performed the round after this spell is cast.

sp-03352.description_en: Caster's unit gains a special bonus of +25 to any morale maneuvers for the duration. This bonus also applies to RRs versus fear and influence effects.

sp-03353.description_en: As Troop Fanning, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03354.description_en: As War Cry I, except the bonus is +10.

sp-03355.description_en: Caster's voice is amplified so that it can be heard over the din of battle in the given area. This spell confers no command ability, but merely allows the caster to be heard.

sp-03356.description_en: As Clarion Call, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03357.description_en: Causes the members of caster's unit to become aware of the next battle maneuver that the caster performs as their leader (that is performed within one minute of completing this spell). They will be notified of an impending regroup, rally, or retreat and their part in it, granting a special bonus of +30 to the maneuver.

sp-03358.description_en: As Tactics, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03359.description_en: As Battle Awareness, except that caster is also aware of the general health (unwounded, lightly wounded, seriously wounded, unconscious, dying) of each of the members of his unit.

sp-03360.description_en: As War Cry I, except the bonus is +15.

sp-03361.description_en: As Leadership, except that the bonus is +30.

sp-03362.description_en: Allows the caster to perceive a battlefield area from a different perspective. This should be an extremely good view of the situation and may grant the caster bonuses to his Tactics maneuvers and other maneuvers as the situation dictates and as the GM allows. For example, General Durathor casts this spell and is able to observe the battle from a height of 500 feet over the center of the battle.

sp-03363.description_en: Causes caster's unit to have perfect morale and be immune to fear and influence effects for the duration. The caster must be alive and visible to the unit for the benefits to be received.

sp-03364.description_en: As War Cry I, except the bonus is +25.

sp-03365.description_en: Caster takes on the appearance of (or temporarily becomes at the GM's discretion) an Avatar to his deity. This causes friendly troops within sight to have perfect morale, and also gain a special bonus of +30 to OB, DB, and RRs. The caster gains the same bonuses. The spell also opens a channel to the caster's deity, in which the deity can direct the caster in battle if it is necessary. SPECIAL Non

sp-03410.description_en: Detects any active spell from any realm and its area of effect, but it does not reveal anything about the nature of the spell.

sp-03411.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +5 on any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers he makes.

sp-03412.description_en: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Channeling, the "incoming" spell must first make a RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the "incoming" spell passes the RR, it may target the caster normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-03413.description_en: As Cancel Channeling, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.

sp-03414.description_en: As Cancel Channeling, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.

sp-03416.description_en: As Detect Magic I, except caster learns realm(s), type, and profession of the target spell's caster, as well as the realm and level of the spell.

sp-03417.description_en: Any active spell that is on the target must make an RR (use the level of that spell's caster as its level). If the RR fails, the spell is dispelled.

sp-03419.description_en: The caster's next attack spell that is cast within the duration is given a +10 on the Spell Casting maneuver, a special+ 10 on its basic attack roll, and any spell failure is resolved with a modifier of -20.

sp-03420.description_en: Target gains protection from a specific realm of magic (chosen at the time of casting). All RRs and DB versus spells of that realm receive a bonus of +20.

sp-03433.description_en: Caster can tell the purpose and bonus of any one magical or non-magical shield.

sp-03434.description_en: Caster enchants a shield which is to become his "Faith's Shield".

sp-03435.description_en: Caster's shield DB is improved by +5.

sp-03436.description_en: Allows the caster to use his shield to automatically intercept an attack made against him. The caster must be aware of the attack and it may not be from behind. Any resulting critical hit will be reduced by one level of severity (an 'A' critical becomes an 'A' with a special modification of -25).

sp-03437.description_en: Caster is able to determine the exact abilities, properties, powers and history of any one shield.

sp-03438.description_en: Causes holy fires to dance around caster's shield. Any critical taken in melee combat causes the attacker to make an RR. Failure results in the attacker taking a Holy Spell critical one level lower in severity to the one inflicted on the caster (an 'A' critical becomes an 'A' with a special modification of -25).

sp-03439.description_en: As Shield Defense I, except the bonus is+ 10.

sp-03440.description_en: Caster's missile parry DB bonuses (see RMFRP Section A-10.3) performed while the caster is holding his shield are increased by 50% for the duration.

sp-03441.description_en: Caster's Faith's Shield will return through the air to the caster's hand at the rate of 100 feet per round with no acceleration. If the shield is restrained, it cannot break free.

sp-03501.description_en: Caster is totally protected from all naturally Priest Base List 17.4.13 occurring forms of his element and he receives a special bonus of

sp-03502.description_en: Caster can control the natural forms of his Area of Effect Duration Range Type Lvl Spell element (e.g., campfires, snow, water, etc.) within the radius, 1} Resist Element * caster self 1 min/lvl controlling their path, size, and temperature. 10'R □ 2} Control Element self 1 min/lvl E

sp-03503.description_en: Caster creates a magical shield formed of his caster □ 3) Element Shield * 1 min/lvl self chosen element. This shield occupies a hand as a normal shield 10'x10'x1' □ 4) Element Wall E 1 min/lvl 100' does. It acts as, and has the general shape of, a normal shield in 1 elemental F □ 5) Tum Elemental 1 min/lvl 100' all respects. The shield will give an additional +5 to DB and RR 6} Element Strike I * self against attacks of its element. If anyone comes in contact with the caster E 7) Element Protection caster 1 min/lvl self shield other than the caster, they must make a RR or take an 'A' 8) Banish Elemental 1 elemental F 1 min/lvl 100' critical of the appropriate element. There is a 50% chance that, caster 9) Element Shroud self E 1 md/lvl with eveiy attack of the opposite element against the caster, the 10) Element Cloud t0'R 1 mdjlvl 100' E shield will be destroyed.

sp-03504.description_en: Caster forms a wall created from his chosen □ 11) Element Armor caster 1 min/lvl self element. Anything passing through the wall will take an 'A' critical caster self

sp-03524.description_en: Caster enchants one suitable holy item and turns it into his personal Holy Symbol. This Holy Symbol is aligned to the caster's faith. Any being who is an 'enemy' of the caster's faith or a creature "of darkness" that picks up the symbol must make an RR or take an 'A' Holy Spell critical.

sp-03525.description_en: Caster may store one spell on his Holy Symbol. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Symbol Store is cast. The stored spell may then be later cast as an instantaneous spell. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.

sp-03526.description_en: Any spell prepared while this spell is active will receive a special bonus of +5 on any Spell Casting Static Maneuver.

sp-03527.description_en: While holding the Holy Symbol, the caster gains +10 to DB and RRs for the duration.

sp-03528.description_en: Caster's Holy Symbol erupts in holy light that flares out to one foe. Target must resist or suffer an 'A' Holy Spell critical. If the creature is an "enemy" or "of darkness," the critical is a 'B', and the RR is made with a special modification of -20.

sp-03529.description_en: As Minor Symbol, except it also makes the Holy Symbol a +2 spell adder.

sp-03530.description_en: While holding the Holy Symbol, the caster gains +15 to DB and RRs for the duration.

sp-03531.description_en: As Symbol Blast I, except that the critical is a 'B' for normal targets, and a 'C' if an "enemy" or "of darkness."

sp-03532.description_en: As Symbol Store, except other spells may be cast while a spell is stored.

sp-03544.description_en: Caster goes into a trance this round, contemplating a moving maneuver. In the following round, he may perform that maneuver with a special bonus of +20.

sp-03545.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +20 to one maneuver performed this round using a skill from the Self Control category.

sp-03546.description_en: This chant places the caster into a trance for one hour. During this time the caster will have a vision related to a topic chosen prior to this spell being cast. A single topic may be the subject of one vision per day, additional attempts will end up repeating the previous vision. Note that this spell will always take an hour, even though the visions created by it may seem to last but a moment, or an eternity.

sp-03547.description_en: For as long as the caster concentrates, any wounds he has will heal at double normal rate. This spell will also stop fatal (non-instantaneous) criticals from killing the caster, providing he stays in the trance long enough to heal the death dealing damage. Note that healing time is based upon the guidelines presented in RMFRP Section 24.1. This spell will not effect any form of healing other than normal, mundane time.

sp-03548.description_en: As Channeling Trance I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-03550.description_en: As Focus Trance II, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03551.description_en: As Self Control/, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03552.description_en: Caster goes into a trance for one round. During this round, he may make a Divine Intervention maneuver with a special bonus of +10.

sp-03553.description_en: As Vision Trance I, except that the caster can have up to three visions, lasting one hour each. Each vision must be on a separate topic.

sp-03554.description_en: As Healing Trance II, except that all wounds are healed at a rate of three times normal.

sp-03555.description_en: As Channeling Trance /, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03564.description_en: As Healing Trance IV, except that the caster may heal himself at five times his normal healing rate.

sp-03565.description_en: Caster enters a trance in which he receives a detailed answer from his deity on one question. SPECIAL Non

sp-03556.description_en: As Focus Trance II, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03557.description_en: As Self Control I, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03558.description_en: As Vision Trance III, except that the caster may have up to 5 separate dreams.

sp-03559.description_en: As Healing Trance III, except that the caster may heal at up to four times his normal healing rate.

sp-03560.description_en: As Cleansing Trance, except that it will remove one corruption point per level.

sp-03561.description_en: As Channeling Trance /, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03562.description_en: As Vision Trance V, except that the caster may have visions relating to up to ten different topics.

sp-03563.description_en: As Self Control I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-03602.description_en: As Air Blast I, except it delivers a 'D' Unbalancing critical.

sp-03603.description_en: As Wind Mastery I, except caster can vary wind speed by 2 miles per hour per level.

sp-03604.description_en: As Pillar of Wind, except the combination of height lifted in feet times weight in pounds is equal to 1000.

sp-03605.description_en: Caster creates a small, but very powerful windstorm. The storm moves randomly about at a rate of 10' per round. All struck by or within the Cyclone, receive a 'D' Unbalancing critical and are thrown 5d10 feet away from the Cyclone.

sp-03606.description_en: As Windwalking, except target can move at a running pace.

sp-03607.description_en: Caster may call forth a wind storm with maximum wind speeds equal to twice his level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according to circumstance (and the GM's discretion).

sp-03608.description_en: As Cyclone, except for area of effect and range, it delivers an 'E' Impact critical, and it throws targets 10d10 feet away.

sp-03609.description_en: As Windrunning, except target can run up to twice normal speed on calm air and expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-03610.description_en: As Air Blast I, except for range, and it delivers an 'E' Unbalancing critical.

sp-03611.description_en: Caster summons a chariot made of pure air that is solid enough for the caster and one other being per ten full levels of experience to ride in. The air chariot has a movement rate of 50 feet per round per level of the caster.

sp-03612.description_en: Detects the total number of "enemies" (giving approximate direction and distance). This spell also reveals the most heavily represented type of enemy (by total levels). Caster can concentrate on a different 50'R each round.

sp-03613.description_en: As Deted Enemies I, except it detects creatures "of darkness."

sp-03614.description_en: Adds +15 to the caster's melee or missile attack for the current round. -----~

sp-03635.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of + 15 to any Animal Mastery maneuvers that deal with horses.

sp-03636.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any Animal Healing maneuvers performed on horses.

sp-03637.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +10 to all Riding maneuvers for the duration.

sp-03638.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to all attempts to track someone who is riding a horse.

sp-03639.description_en: Adds +20 to the caster's Mounted Attack combat maneuvers for the current round.

sp-03640.description_en: Caster's horse can travel at double its normal rate and spend exhaustion points as if it were walking. When the horse stops traveling, this spell is canceled.

sp-03641.description_en: Caster can ride at a normal pace without leaving tracks or other visible signs of his passing. This can normally be resolved as a special penalty of -60 to the Tracking maneuvers of those who attempt to track the caster using mainly visual signs.

sp-03642.description_en: As Riding I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-03643.description_en: Caster can ride silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating more then 10 feet from his body.

sp-03644.description_en: As Charging I, except the bonus is +30; in addition, the charge attack delivers an Unbalancing critical two levels lower in severity to any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Unbalancing critical, a 'B' critical would inflict an 'A' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -50). The attack must occur in the round this spell is cast.

sp-03645.description_en: Caster can "call" any one known specific horse that the caster has ridden before. If it is physically possible, the animal will come to him if the horse is within range when this spell is cast.

sp-03646.description_en: As Charging I, except affects up to one target per level.

sp-03647.description_en: As Riding/, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03648.description_en: Caster's horse can travel at triple its normal rate and not spend any exhaustion points. When the horse stops traveling, this spell is canceled.

sp-03649.description_en: As Riding II, except up to one target per level is affected.

sp-03650.description_en: As Charging I, except the bonus is +40; in addition, caster delivers an Unbalancing critical one level less in severity to any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'B' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Unbalancing critical, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -25).

sp-03651.description_en: As Hide Tracks, except it affects one horse per level.

sp-03652.description_en: As Stamina, except it affects one horse per level.

sp-03653.description_en: As Horse Calling, except it calls up to one horse per level (up to ~ ' as many are as are able to come).

sp-03654.description_en: As Riding I, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03655.description_en: As Charging I, except the bonus is +50; in addition, caster delivers an Unbalancing critical of equal severity to any normal critical delivered.

sp-03656.description_en: As Charging II, except affects up to one target per level.

sp-03657.description_en: As Hide Tracks and Silent Ride, except it affects one horse and rider per level of the caster and each horse is allowed to ride at double normal movement rate and not break the effects of the spell. SrtctAL Non

sp-03658.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 bonus for all Tracking maneuvers.

sp-03659.description_en: Adds +15 to the caster's missile attack for the current round.

sp-03660.description_en: Caster can monitor animate activity in the area of effect (i.e., he will be aware of subtle movements). For the duration of this spell, the caster cannot move.

sp-03661.description_en: Removes any diseases or poisons from one animal that the caster has killed.

sp-03662.description_en: As Tracker I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-03663.description_en: Makes one wooden weapon difficult to break for the duration. That weapon receives a special modification of+ 75 to any strength checks for the duration.

sp-03664.description_en: Caster's next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) has all range penalties halved (round up).

sp-03665.description_en: Caster learns origin of tracks and acquires a visual image of the one who left them. Caster will gain a special bonus of +25 when tracking this particular being or animal.

sp-03666.description_en: As Aiming I, except the bonus is +25.

sp-03667.description_en: Caster receives special bonus of+ 25 to his Fletching skill.

sp-03681.description_en: All insects flee the area. All insects with a level will receive a RR.

sp-03682.description_en: Caster summons 1d100 Type I insects from the surrounding area. Caster has limited control over the summoned insects. They will follow simple, one-word commands (e.g., fly, eat, stay, etc.).

sp-03683.description_en: As Summon Insects I, except it summons Type II insects.

sp-03684.description_en: For the duration, caster receives an additional RR versus all poisons.

sp-03685.description_en: As Summon Insects I, except it summons Type III insects.

sp-03686.description_en: As Repel Insects, except for area of effect.

sp-03688.description_en: Caster causes one insect to grow to a Small size. The insect will be capable of attacking on an attack table appropriate to its type (e.g., pincer, stinger, bite).

sp-03689.description_en: As Summon Insects[, except it summons Type IV insects.

sp-03690.description_en: Caster either has total control over all normal insects in the area, or one Small-size insect within the radius.

sp-03691.description_en: Caster takes on one aspect of an insect (eyes, stinger, etc.). If used in combat, the caster may make Medium attacks (of some appropriate type).

sp-03692.description_en: As Insect Growth [, except that size is Medium.

sp-03693.description_en: One group (d100 times ten) of up to Type II insects is summoned and sent on some quest which it will relentlessly pursue until finished. The target of the quest must be visible to the caster when this spell is cast. There must be enough available insects in the surrounding area when this spell is cast, or it has no effect.

sp-03695.description_en: As Insect Control I, except for area of effect, and it can control up to one Medium-sized insect or two Small sized insects.

sp-03697.description_en: As Minor Insect Plague, except up to Type IV insects may be summoned.

sp-03698.description_en: As Insect Growth I, except that size is Large.

sp-03699.description_en: As Insect Control I, except for area of effect, and it can control up to one Large-sized insect or a combination of up to two Medium-sized or four Small-sized insects.

sp-03700.description_en: Caster summons 10,000-100,000 insects of all types to perform special missions for the caster (e.g., block out the sun, destroy crops, defend against an invading army). GM's discretion.

sp-03701.description_en: As Insect Growth I, except that size is Huge.

sp-03702.description_en: Allows caster to take the physical form of an ant. Caster has and can perform all of the abilities of an ant. The transformation takes ten complete rounds of concentration to occur. For exact details and statistics see Creatures & Monstm.

sp-03703.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a normal-sized spider and the transformation takes nine complete rounds to occur.

sp-03704.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a rat, mouse, squirrel, chipmunk, etc., and the transformation takes eight complete rounds to occur.

sp-03705.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a frog and the transformation takes seven complete rounds to occur.

sp-03706.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a chameleon and the transformation takes six complete rounds to occur.

sp-03707.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a small lizard and the transformation takes five complete rounds to occur.

sp-03708.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a Small Bird and the transformation takes four complete rounds to occur.

sp-03709.description_en: As Ant Form, except the caster takes the physical form of a Raccoon and the transformation takes three complete rounds to occur.

sp-03710.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a Deer and the transformation takes two complete Tounds to occur.

sp-03748.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +10 to preaching his religion to groups of people. This can normally be resolved as a special bonus of +10 to the Public Speaking skill.

sp-03749.description_en: For as long as they speak together, the target of this spell will believe that the caster is a good friend and is acting in the target's best interest.

sp-03750.description_en: Caster's voice is amplified two times. This is useful for talking to large crowds.

sp-03751.description_en: For as long as the caster speaks, the target will believe that the reasoning and ideas that the caster expresses are correct and valid.

sp-03752.description_en: Doubles the rate at which the caster can learn a language. Every rank of language developed (i.e., DP's spent), results in two ranks being learned. It is assumed that this spell is cast and in effect while the language is being learned.

sp-03753.description_en: As Conversion I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-03754.description_en: As Sounding II, except amplification is four times.

sp-03755.description_en: As Voice of Friendship, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-03756.description_en: The caster is subtly directed (hints and clues) towards a specific person or group of people that the caster's deity believes should hear the caster's message. The exact form of the guidance will vary from deity to deity (e.g., a deity of the wind would have the wind constantly blow the same way, etc.). For the duration of the spell, the caster must concentrate to be led in the correct direction.

sp-03757.description_en: As Learn language II, except rate is tripled (three ranks are gained for every one).

sp-03758.description_en: As Conversion I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03759.description_en: As Voice of Reason, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-03760.description_en: Caster's basic needs are met by his deity in various ways (i.e., people bring the caster food, and offer him shelter for the evening, etc.).

sp-03762.description_en: As Learn language II, except rate is quadrupled (four ranks are gained for every one).

sp-03763.description_en: [RR Mod: -50) After casting this spell, the caster must tell the truth (as he knows it). All targets who fail their RR will believe the caster is speaking the absolute truth.

sp-03764.description_en: As Conversion I, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03765.description_en: Caster is able to speak any language (even one that he has never heard before) as if he was a native speaker.

sp-03766.description_en: As Voice of Conviction, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-03767.description_en: If the caster's deity agrees, a divine sign or miracle will be shown to an appropriate group of people.

sp-03768.description_en: Caster's eyes appear as those of a snake. Those who view the caster see his eyes as slits. This has no value other than as an illusion and can be detected as such.

sp-03769.description_en: Caster charms one snake. That snake will not attack him, and will follow his non-violent suggestions.

sp-03770.description_en: Caster magically summons a viper that will arrive in two rounds. It will act as the caster directs it.

sp-03771.description_en: Caster's mouth fills with razor-like teeth that can be used to make Small Bite attacks.

sp-03772.description_en: Caster's eyes become hypnotic to one target. Target must make a RR or be stunned for the duration.

sp-03773.description_en: As Summon Viper, except it summons a cobra.

sp-03774.description_en: As Charm Snake I, except it can effect up to two snakes.

sp-03775.description_en: As Snake Bite I, except caster can make Medium Bite attacks.

sp-03776.description_en: As Summon Viper, except it summons a python.

sp-03777.description_en: Caster's next summoning spell from this list (cast within the duration) will summon two snakes.

sp-03778.description_en: Caster gains total control over the actions of one snake.

sp-03779.description_en: The caster's bite this round will inject a mild poison into the target with any critical that is delivered. Type of poison should be determined by the Gamemaster.

sp-03780.description_en: Caster summons a special type of snake that is common to the terrain he is in. In the forest, this could be a Horned Snake; in the snow, a Giant Furred Snake; etc.

sp-03781.description_en: As Snake Bite I, except caster can make Large l3ite attacks.

sp-03782.description_en: As Marter Snake I, except it can affect up to two snakes.

sp-03783.description_en: As Poison Bite I, except it injects a moderate poison.

sp-03784.description_en: Caster summons a giant snake. The details are left to the GM.

sp-03785.description_en: As Multi-Summoning II, except three snakes will be summoned.

sp-03786.description_en: As Master Snake I, except it can affect up to three snakes.

sp-03787.description_en: As Poison Bite I, except it injects a severe poison.

sp-03789.description_en: As Poison Bite I, except it injects an extreme poison.

sp-03790.description_en: Caster opens up a magical gate to a mythical or legendary snake creature or perhaps a powerful snake lord. Details are left up to the GM.

sp-03812.description_en: Allows the caster to detect any spirit within the area of effect of the spell. The caster may concentrate on a. different area each round. Caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-03813.description_en: Informs the caster of the type of a given spirit as well as its general power level.

sp-03814.description_en: This spell must be cast every day for one week. At the end of that week, the caster's totem will come to the caster to help and guide him. This totem will have the physical form, natural enemies and allies of a normal animal of this species. The exact species of the totem should be either chosen by the GM to match the personality of the caster (or the caster's faith), or be rolled randomly on the chart in Section 12.5. The totem will always be a young animal that gains experience as the caster does. If the caster's totem is ever killed, he will be at -100 to all maneuver the first week,-90 the second week, and ·so on until the penalty is gone. After ten weeks, the caster may cast this spell again, any new totem will always be the same species as the first totem the caster ever gained Any bonuses or abilities gained from the totem are lost when the totem is lost (until a new one can be summoned). See Section 12.5 for more details about Totem Familiars.

sp-03815.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a first-level spirit of a type chosen by the caster prior to the casting of this spell. The caster is not granted the ability to converse with the spirit through this spell. The spirit will appear before the caster as a wavering form.

sp-03816.description_en: Gives the caster the ability to speak with and understand spirits.

sp-03817.description_en: The caster binds the spirit of one dead person to his own spirit, for the purpose of taking that spirit to the spirit world. This spell functions in part so that the caster may bring such a spirit across to the spirit world, and thus to the proper nexus for the spirit to travel to its afterlife domain.

sp-03818.description_en: Allows the caster to bind a spirit into an item. This imbues the item with the power of the spirit. The spirit remains bound until the item is used. When used, all within a 100 foot radius must make an RR versus the level of the spirit or they will suffer the effects of the spirit's power. Once the item has been activated, the spirit is free to return to the spirit world.

sp-03819.description_en: Caster imbues himself with a spirit of calm. All within the area of effect are overcome with a feeling of calmness.

sp-03820.description_en: Caster imbues himself with a spirit of harmony. All within the area of effect are overcome with a feeling of unity and a desire to work together.

sp-03821.description_en: The target of this spell is banished back to the spirit world. This spell may also be used against Undead that contain spirits. Animated Undead are unaffected by this spell.

sp-03822.description_en: As Summon Spirit I, except that the caster may summon up to a fifth level spirit.

sp-03823.description_en: As Spirit Binding I, except that the caster may bind up to a fifth level spirit into an item, or he may bind a first level spirit into an item for two uses of its abilities (i.e., the spirit is not released after the first use).

sp-03824.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of discord. All within the area of effect will feel a great dissatisfaction and refuse to agree with anyone about anything.

sp-03825.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of friendship. All within the area of effect are overcome by a tremendous feeling of camaraderie and goodwill.

sp-03826.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] -As Spirit Guide, except that the spirit suffers a penalty to its RR, and the caster will know exactly where on the spirit world, the proper nexus is located.

sp-03827.description_en: As Summon Spirit V. except the caster may summon up to a tenth level spirit.

sp-03828.description_en: As per Spirit Binding V. except that the caster may bind up to a tenth level spirit for a single use of its abilities, or he may bind up to a fifth level spirit for two uses of its abilities, or he may bind a first level spirit for three uses of its abilities.

sp-03829.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of anger. All within the area of effect are overcome with anger and go berserk.

sp-03830.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit offear. All within the area of effect are overcome with fear, and either seek to flee or become incapacitated if they cannot flee.

sp-03831.description_en: [RR Mod: -20)-As Banish Spirit, except that the spirit suffers a penalty to his RR.

sp-03832.description_en: As Summon Spirit X. except that the caster may summon up to a 20th level spirit.

sp-03833.description_en: As Spirit Binding X, except that the caster can bind a spirit of up to twentieth level into an item for a single use, or he may bind a spirit of up to fifteenth level into an item for two uses, or he may bind a spirit of up to tenth level into an item for three uses, or he may bind a spirit of up to fifth level into an item for four uses, or he may bind a first level spirit into an item for five uses. A second casting of this spell upon a bound spirit will bind the spirit permanently into an item until the item is destroyed, the spirit is released by the caster, or a condition set up prior to the casting of this spell (the second time) is fulfilled. If made into a permanent item, the item-bound spirit powers a daily item with a number of uses equal to the number of uses gained when this spell was cast the first time. This spell could also be used to make any one lower level Spirit Binding spell permanent.

sp-03834.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of awe. All within the area of effect are overcome with feelings of awe and worship towards the caster. SPECIAL Nons

sp-03835.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 to one Meditation Static Maneuver performed next round.

sp-03836.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight.

sp-03837.description_en: For the duration of the spell the caster receives a special bonus of +30 to RRs versus outside corruption influences.

sp-03838.description_en: Detects "evil" in an animate or inanimate target; caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-03839.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen within the next minute if he takes a specified action.

sp-03841.description_en: Caster can sense if there is a disharmony in the "natural order" of the world within the area of effect. The caster gets an impression of something wrong, but not the reason why. For example, the caster could sense that magical effects were altering nature, or that some curse lay upon the area, etc.

sp-03842.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can been seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-03843.description_en: Detects any invisible object in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-03844.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 2 minutes into the future.

sp-03858.description_en: Stones within 10 foot radius of the caster are hurled at the target. The attack is resolved on the Ram/Butt/Bash Attack Table (in Arms Law) with a maximum result of Small. The casters OB will equal his Directed Spell skill bonus for 'stones.'

sp-03859.description_en: Caster may repair damage, cracks, or breaks in a stone object or a mass of stone up to 20 foot radius.

sp-03860.description_en: Caster can communicate with any one stone (if it possesses animate qualities) or one Earth Elemental. Caster may only use this spell on only one stone at a time.

sp-03861.description_en: As Small Stone, except for area of effect and the maximum attack result is Medium.

sp-03862.description_en: The next stone that the caster throws (within the duration) will deliver an additional critical that is two levels lower in severity to any normal critical delivered. (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' critical, a 'B' critical would deliver an additional 'A' critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would deliver an additional 'A' critical with a special modification of -50). The critical type can either reflect the nature of the deity or it can be treated as a Holy Spell critical. The attack must occur in the round this spell is cast.

sp-03863.description_en: Caster summons a Weak Earth Elemental (a Type II Elemental) that gradually appears over the course of two rounds. The caster can concentrate to get the elemental to perform actions or he may use Stonespeech to command it verbally. Otherwise, it will stand motionless. The elemental departs after the duration expires.

sp-03864.description_en: As Small Stone, except for area of effect and the maximum attack result is Large.

sp-03865.description_en: As Holy Stone I, except the critical severity is one lower (i.e., a 'B' critical would inflict an additional 'A' critical, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' critical with a special modification of -25).

sp-03866.description_en: Creates an area of veiy sharp spiked stones from rock occurring in the affected radius. The spikes take one round to form, so anyone in the radius when it is cast may make a moving maneuver to avoid taking a critical. Any creature caught in the area when the spikes form suffers a 'B' Puncture critical. In addition, anyone moving through the area must make a moving maneuver or suffer an 'A' Puncture critical. (GM determines all maneuver difficulties based on the situation.)

sp-03867.description_en: Creates a wall of rough-cut stones up to 10 foot x 10 foot x 1 foot. It can be chipped through. The wall must rest on a solid surface.

sp-03868.description_en: Creates a 3 foot by 6 foot corridor that is 1 foot per level long. It can cut through any non-metal, inorganic material. The corridor is created at a rate of 1 foot (length) per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-03869.description_en: As Earth Elemental II, except it summons a Type III Earth Elemental.

sp-03871.description_en: As Holy Stone I, except the critical severity is one lower.

sp-03872.description_en: As Spike Stones I, except for the area of effect, and the criticals inflicted are 'C' and 'B,' respectively.

sp-03873.description_en: As Earth Elemental II, except it summons a Type IV Earth Elemental.

sp-03874.description_en: For as long as he concentrates, caster may mold 1 cubic foot of stone with his hands as if it were putty; then the stone will harden.

sp-03875.description_en: If there is a suitable round boulder nearby (no more than 10 pounds per level), caster can cause it to roll in a direction he specifies. Resolve the attack on the Trample/Stomp Attack Table (in Arms Law) using a maximum of Large results. The OB will equal the caster's Directed Spell skill bonus for 'stones' with a special bonus of +20.

sp-03877.description_en: Causes a large crack to open in the ground. The size of the crack will be up to 10 feet wide, up to 100 feet deep, and up to 200 feet long. The crack takes two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.

sp-03879.description_en: Causes a large crevice to open in the ground (up to 10 foot per level deep, 1 foot per level wide, and 20 foot per level long). The crevice takes two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.

sp-03880.description_en: Caster can cause an earthquake, with the spot he touches as the epicenter. The quake can be delayed up to one round per level. The severity of the quake on the Richter scale is determined by a d 100 roll: (10-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6.0, (4&65) = 6.5, (66-80) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91-95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) = 9.0. SPECIAL Nons

sp-03910.description_en: As Sloth I, except the penalty is 2d10. F 4 rnds 100' 1 target □ 15) Slow IV*

sp-03914.description_en: As Quickness I, except the bonus is 2d10. self 1 min/lvl caster □ 50) Time Walk

sp-03915.description_en: As Slow I, except it lasts three rounds. w..

sp-03916.description_en: Predicts the most probable actions of a being in the next round. The target's specific action and targets are 25. sp-03917.description_en: As Time Stretch, except the duration is tripled. 50. Tune Walk-Caster is presented with a vision of any event from

sp-03918.description_en: As Slow I, except it lasts four rounds. anytime in his past. Caster may then use any of his skills, spells,

sp-03921.description_en: All spells cast within the radius will have their durations cut in half. In addition, all maneuvers performed within the radius will take twice as long to complete.

sp-03922.description_en: Caster enters a deep sleep in which he does not age. Caster must set conditions from which he can awaken (e.g., a specific time, a certain event).

sp-03926.description_en: Allows caster to understand and "speak" the language of any one tree species.

sp-03927.description_en: Allows the caster to appear as any one type of tree. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the tree (i.e. it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules; see Spell Law Section 15.14 for more on illusions).

sp-03928.description_en: Heals 3d 10 hits of damage on a tree.

sp-03929.description_en: Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorns. The wall is up to 10'x10'x5'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 50%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. Anyone moving through it receives a takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).

sp-03931.description_en: All non-magical fire in the area of effect is put out. Magical fire must make an RR or be extinguished.

sp-03932.description_en: Caster magically enters a tree and can leave from any other tree within range.

sp-03933.description_en: Creates a wall of tough branches that is 10' x 10' x 1'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 80%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. Anyone passing through it takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).

sp-03934.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 8.

sp-03935.description_en: Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating. (Tree will perform similarly to an Awakened Tree.)

sp-05642.description_en: Caster can see through 10' per level of water (even murky water) as if it were day. Some residual light must exist for this spell to work.

sp-05643.description_en: As Watersight, except caster can see in normal darkness such as a clear night outdoors. Some residual light (e.g., starlight, phosphorescent fungus) must exist for this spell to work.

sp-05644.description_en: As Watersight, except caster can see in fog, mist, any other precipitation or any gas.

sp-05645.description_en: Caster can see through non-magical wood (up to 1" thickness per level of experience).

sp-05646.description_en: Caster's point of hearing may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his hearing through walls or closed doors).

sp-05647.description_en: Caster can pick a point (up to 10' away), and he will be able to see and/or hear from that point. The point is fixed but can be rotated. There can be intervening barriers such as walls.

sp-05648.description_en: Caster's point of sight may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. The point of sight may also be rotated. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his sight through walls or closed doors).

sp-05649.description_en: Caster can see all invisible beings or objects as if they were not invisible. Note that this means the invisible object is not “detected;” it simply isn't invisible to the caster.

sp-05650.description_en: As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical stone.

sp-05651.description_en: As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical iron or steel.

sp-05652.description_en: Caster can see “through” all visual illusions, phantasms, and glamours.

sp-05653.description_en: As Observe I, except for the range.

sp-05654.description_en: As Long Ear, except for the range and the caster may move any and all senses.

sp-05655.description_en: As Ironsight II, except caster may see through any non-magical metal.

sp-05656.description_en: As Nightsight, except caster can see through magically created darkness (such as those resulting from Dark or Utterdark spells) or total ordinary darkness (i.e., no residual light required).

sp-05657.description_en: As Observe I, except 2 points up to 100' away may be observed simultaneously.

sp-05658.description_en: As Observe I, except for the range.

sp-05659.description_en: As Woodsight, except caster can see through any non-magical wall of any thickness.

sp-05660.description_en: As Observe III, except caster does not have to concentrate until the spell is triggered by some movement or some sound which could be perceived from the observation point (and after the spell “activates,” the caster must concentrate on the point or the spell will be dispelled). If the caster is ever more than 100' per level of experience of the point selected, the spell is dispelled.

sp-05661.description_en: As Long Sense, except for the range.

sp-05662.description_en: As Observe III, except for the duration and the caster need not concentrate (he need only glance and listen once every three rounds).

sp-05663.description_en: As Woodsight II, except the caster can see through all inanimate material. Highly magical materials might receive an RR (at the GM's discretion).

sp-05664.description_en: As Long Sense, except the caster may move his senses with no limitations on range.

sp-05666.description_en: Caster can detect whether an unfulfilled fate, destiny, or wyrd lies upon a person, object, or place.

sp-05668.description_en: The caster can attempt to avoid one attack, which can be a missile or a melee attack or a spell. The missile, weapon, or enemy spellcaster must be within range and within the caster's field of vision when this spell is cast. The caster receives a bonus of +50 to his DB against missile, melee, and directed elemental attacks; his normal DB against area elemental attacks, or the enemy spellcaster suffers a -10 to his Base Attack Roll (for all other spell attacks).

sp-05670.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. This spell can only be used once per night, the caster must sleep a minimum of one sleep cycle, and the caster must not be disturbed during the sleep.

sp-05671.description_en: Predicts most probable action of a being in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no details on targets or exactly what spell) This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target has decided to do. Note the target is free to change his declared action (with the requisite penalties).

sp-05672.description_en: The caster is able (using the culturally specific apparatus) to make a prediction concerning a person, place, or object. Using the apparatus to make the prediction will take at least one minute per level of the spell. Only one prediction may be made in any given 24-hour period by the caster (and a failed spell counts towards this limit). The prediction will be accurate 25% of the time plus 1% per level of the caster (otherwise, the results are random). The prediction may not concern events further than one day per level of the caster into the future. The predictions will be general, ambiguous and enigmatic. The interpretation of the predictions is left entirely to the caster.

sp-05673.description_en: As Anticipations I, except if the action is to cast a spell, the exact spell to be cast and the target are learned.

sp-05675.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05676.description_en: As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to 1 month per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05678.description_en: This provides an analysis of an unfulfilled destiny in terms of who made the prophecy and/or the source of the destiny, the strength of the destiny, and where appropriate the oracular riddle (or whatever) which encapsulates the destiny. The spell does not indicate how a destiny may be fulfilled. Note that this spell will reveal if a given prophecy or divination is a hoax—the strength of the destiny will in such cases depend on the degree to which the victim of the hoax believes in the divination.

sp-05680.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05681.description_en: As Divinations III, except the predictions may concern events up to 1 year per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05682.description_en: As Anticipations III, except if any of the actions involve spell casting, the spells to be cast and the targets are learned.

sp-05683.description_en: As Anticipations V, except caster can either predict the most probable actions of 5 beings in the next round or can predict the most probable actions of one being over the next five rounds.

sp-05684.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams per night on any combination of topics.

sp-05685.description_en: As Anticipations I, except caster can predict the most probable actions of every being within 100'.

sp-05686.description_en: As Anticipations True, except if the actions are to cast spells, the spells to be cast and intended targets are learned.

sp-05687.description_en: As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to ten years per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05688.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all thinking/sentient beings within his range. The caster may opt to use this spell to become aware of animal presences within his range (for use with spells on the Vision Borrowing spell list). If the caster wishes to sense animal presences, he must expend one PP in the casting of this spell.

sp-05689.description_en: Caster stores the mental pattern of a target which must first have been detected by Presence. This pattern can be used with other spells on this list (and other lists). The caster can only have as many patterns stored as the sum of his Memory and Presence stats (not the bonuses). The caster can choose to release a pattern at any given time (the GM should require that a character keep track of all the patterns he has stored).

sp-05690.description_en: Caster learns one of the following concerning a target: race, profession, or level. The target must have been located by Presence.

sp-05691.description_en: Caster learns direction and distance to any unshielded mind for which he has a mental pattern from Mind Store or Long Mind Store, and which is within range of this spell.

sp-05693.description_en: Target must answer single-concept questions truthfully. Questions are asked and answered mentally. One question may be asked per round.

sp-05694.description_en: As Analysis, except caster learns race, profession, and level of the target.

sp-05695.description_en: As Presence, the caster also gains general knowledge of all of the targets' actions. In a tactical situation, the caster can declare his actions after learning one of each of the targets' actions for the round (and when he wants to perform the action). This does not prevent the target from changing his action (with the appropriate penalty for changing his action).

sp-05696.description_en: The caster knows when anyone within the radius is lying.

sp-05698.description_en: As Awareness, except that the caster learns all actions for the round.

sp-05699.description_en: As Mind Store, except for the range.

sp-05700.description_en: As Mind Typing, except for the range.

sp-05701.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05703.description_en: As Truth I, except for the area of effect.

sp-05704.description_en: As Truth I, except for the range.

sp-05705.description_en: As Truth I, except when this spell is cast before any Vision Behind spell, it will detect anyone who is lying within the vision.

sp-05706.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05707.description_en: As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target's subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).

sp-05708.description_en: Caster can remove one thought or memory from the target's mind each round.

sp-05709.description_en: This can either be cast as Truth V with a duration of one minute per level or as Long Truth with a range of 100' per level.

sp-05710.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05718.description_en: When cast before a Vision Behind spell, this allows the caster to perceive the past using one (and only one) additional sense (i.e., smell, taste, feel) or to use one and only one perceptive skill (in addition to the normal vision and hearing; such as Power Perception or Reality Awareness).

sp-05722.description_en: As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event in the past which occurred at the caster's current location.

sp-05726.description_en: Gives a complete rundown on an item's construction, powers and purpose (completeness or specificity of information may be reduced if the item is extremely powerful).

sp-05727.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 year per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 week) and the trance can last up to 5 hours per level of the caster.

sp-05728.description_en: As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event which happened in the target's past.
