Note that if the mirror in the casters own world is moved or destroyed, he will be unable to return home until another mirror is placed in the same location as the previous one.

sp-02841.description_en: For the duration of this spell, caster will always know in which direction North lies.

sp-02842.description_en: Caster creates his own symbol on a surface of object, which may flare up and be visible to the naked eye or merely visible to Detect Magic spells.

sp-02843.description_en: Caster is able to instantly fasten together any two pieces of cloth, leather, etc. with appropriate materials (thread, thongs, etc). This spell also allows the caster to patch torn or holed material by roughly reattaching torn edges. This spell may also be used to reinforce clothing.

sp-02844.description_en: Caster repels all insects within the area of effect. All insects in the area of effect must leave.

sp-02845.description_en: Caster can see far-off objects as if they were ten times closer. Provides a special +35 to all Observation maneuvers involving distant objects.

sp-02846.description_en: Target repels dirt, mud, blood, and grime for the duration of this spell.

sp-02847.description_en: Target repels rain, hail and snow in a I 'radius around the target. For the duration, the target will not get wet from precipitation. This spell does not provide any protection from bodies of water or water attacks.

sp-02848.description_en: Lights a IO' radius area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object or being.

sp-02849.description_en: Caster sets conditions (such as "unauthorized entry") upon which a loud alarm will sound. The alarm may be set to protect an area up to a 50' radius.

sp-02850.description_en: Creates a hidden carrying area up to 1 cubic foot that will hold objects with a combined weight of less than five pounds. Caster is able to recall what is kept in the Hidden Pouch instantly to his hand. For example, Puzz the mage is captured by bandits and is stripped, bound, and gagged. During a moment alone he called up his trusty dagger that is stored in his Hidden Pouch, which enables him to escape. For the duration, the caster may retrieve from or place an item within the Hidden Pouch any number of times. If the items are not retrieved before the end of the duration, the stored items will appear at the caster's feet.

sp-02851.description_en: Caster has a 30% chance of opening any nonmagical lock. If the lock is not unlocked, there is a 10% chance that any traps associated with it are set off. Rolls are open-ended and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll. (See Spell Law Section 7.1.29). Alternatively, the caster may automatically lock any lock.

sp-02852.description_en: Allows caster to communicate at a distance using a normal method such as flags, flares, lights, drums, etc. Caster may communicate simple ideas or concepts to all who can see the signal. If a viewer of the signal has the skill Signaling, then they will be able to understand more complex concepts or ideas sent by this method.

sp-02853.description_en: Shields a package from the environment. The caster may protect a total surface area ofup to 10 square feet per level of the caster. This spell will not protect against temperature differences, merely moisture damage and vermin. For example, a package protected through the use of this spell will be free of mold and mice, but the mayonnaise inside will still go bad in the summer heat.

sp-02854.description_en: Allows caster to read weather signs (e.g., clouds, winds, smells, temperature, barometric pressure, animal actions, etc). This will allow the caster to predict probable weather conditions for up to 12 hours in advance with 90% accuracy.

sp-02855.description_en: Allows caster to control the direction of a ship, wagon, or other vehicle from any location on that vehicle as if he were in the appropriate location to steer the vehicle.

sp-02856.description_en: Allows caster to move up to 200 pounds at his normal walking pace (i.e., as if he were not encumbered).

sp-02857.description_en: Allows caster to move large loads (up to 2,000 pounds) short distances (up to 10' per round with no acceleration).

sp-02858.description_en: Allows caster to move objects from one place to another without concentration. Caster casts this spell on a pile of objects which are then transferred (usually from ground to wagon or back). Caster is able to transfer up to 200 pounds per round a distance of up to 100 feet. This spell will not move objects heavier than allotted, and when this is attempted the spell will be canceled. For example, Holl ad, a 20th level mage, casts this spell on a storeroom full of weapons. The spell then moves the weapons (approximately 200 pounds of them per round) to the designated place up to 100 feet away (in this case a waiting wagon outside the building).

sp-02859.description_en: Allows caster to diminish the weight of an object or package to one-fifth normal weight.

sp-02860.description_en: This spell makes all members of a caravan recognizable to each other (outsiders will be easily noticed). This portion of the spell "magically" marks every member of ~he caravan. The mark manifests itself to every type of percept10n (though not in an unpleasant or dominating way). The caster may effect up to I 00 targets.

sp-02861.description_en: Creates an animal of force that will transport up to 500 pounds as a normal pack animal (movement rate of approximately 5 mph).

sp-02862.description_en: Caster is able to pack one item (up to 50 cubic feet) that will be kept in stasis for up to I month. If the packing container is opened before the duration is up, the spell is cancel ed. If this spell is cast upon a living target, the target will be placed in stasis when put into the container.

sp-02863.description_en: Caster creates an interdimensional space (that will hold up to 50 cubic feet) that will hold up to 1,000 pounds. The dimensional pack encumbers the caster at a weight equal to one-tenth the stored weight. This spell must be cast on a suitable container (e.g., barrel, backpack, large box, etc.) which can normally carry the one-tenth weight. If this spell fails, any item inside the space is forever lost.

sp-10438.description_en: Causes a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 10 from all attacks.

sp-10439.description_en: I-As Charm Opposite I, but one sentient plant is affected.

sp-10440.description_en: Caster emotionally and/or sensually manipulates one humanoid target (emotional attachment may result). Caster receives a bonus to his Seduction maneuvers against this target equal to the amount the target failed his RR. For example, if a target fails a RR by 15, the caster gets +15 to all Seduction maneuvers for the duration of the spell.

sp-10447.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except affects any sentient being.

sp-10448.description_en: As Self Aura, except 20 is subtracted from all attacks.

sp-10450.description_en: Target is given one task that must be within its abilities. Failure or refusal to perform the task results in the target taking 3 'E' electricity criticals.

sp-10452.description_en: As Geas, except failure results in death.

sp-10453.description_en: As Self Aura, except caster seems like a demi-god and the penalty to all attacks is -30.

sp-10454.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell from this list every round.

sp-01928.description_en: Darkens a I 0' radius about the point touched.

sp-01929.description_en: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19 in Spell Law.

sp-01930.description_en: The caster can pick any shadow in range and may visually perceive as if he were at that location.

sp-01931.description_en: Allows the caster to teleport by stepping into one shadow and out of another shadow within range. Both shadows must be in range of the spell and in the line of sight of the caster. Both shadows must be capable of covering the caster.

sp-01932.description_en: Causes a 10' radius burst of intense darkness. All targets inside are stunned for one round per I 0% failure.

sp-01934.description_en: Creates a fog of concentrated shadow in a I 0'R that delivers an 'A' Cold critical to those who pass through it. Once created, the fog is affected by the wind and breezes. At the end of the duration, the fog melts away entirely. I 0. Banish Shadow-Target's shadow is banished. For the duration of this spell the caster has no shadow. People without shadows are often shunned as evil, hunted as servants of the unlife and are generally mistrusted.

sp-01937.description_en: When cast in conjunction with a Dark or Enshroud spell, it delays the effects of the other spell until a specific time has passed (up to 24 hrs), or until triggered by a specific event (chosen by the caster at the time of casting).

sp-01938.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed at all for this spell to work.

sp-01939.description_en: Target's shadow has a life of its own. Although the shadow remains with the target, it does not mimic the target's movement (except in a general way). Instead, its specific movements are often grotesque and random.

sp-01940.description_en: Darkens a lO0'R about the point touched. Utterdark nullifies all magically and naturally created light.

sp-01991.description_en: The target need not breathe for the duration of this spell. This spell does not allow the target to breathe water, only to hold his breath for a long time. Therefore, the target cannot speak for the duration either.

sp-01992.description_en: Provides the minimum nutritional requirements to keep the caster from starving. Use of this spell does not provide the feeling of having eaten (the target will still feel hungry). If this spell is used continuously for more than a week (without actually eating normally), the caster will begin to suffer- I for each additional day he uses the spell for sustenance. This penalty can be relieved by eating normally (gaining back 10 points for each day the caster eats normally).

sp-01993.description_en: While the spell is in effect, the caster may, at any time, spend 1 power point to gain 5 exhaustion points. This in not considered to be casting another spell, requires no concentration, and takes no activity.

sp-01994.description_en: Target will feel well-rested without sleep, however he does not heal (or regain power points) until such time as he does sleep for at least 4 hours plus an additional 4 hours for each night he went without sleep.

sp-01995.description_en: Target can tolerate temperatures I O per level of the caster beyond normal with no ill effects. This temperature modification can be set for extremes of heat or extremes of cold, but cannot be changed once the spell is cast.

sp-01996.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster will expend no exhaustion points for any activity that he performs. If this spell is cast multiple times in one day, after the second spell ends, all exhaustion point expenditures are doubled (then tripled after the third spell, etc.).

sp-01997.description_en: Caster can cause his skin to become more dense and resistant to damage. The caster gains AT 3 for the duration. However, if the caster spends double the normal necessary PPs (i.e., 14 PPs), he gains AT 8. If the caster spends triple the normal PPs (i.e., 21 PPs), he gains AT 11. If the caster spends quadruple the normal PPs (i.e., 28 PPs), he gains AT 14. However, in all cases, the caster's DB is lowered by -10.

sp-01998.description_en: For the duration of this spell, all concussion damage the caster takes is halved (rounding up).

sp-01999.description_en: The caster gains an extra RR versus any poison in his system. This RR is modified by +20. If the poison is still not resisted, it takes effect normally. I 0. Resist Disease-As Resist Poison, except affects diseases.

sp-02001.description_en: Target becomes extremely resistant to a particular element (designated by the caster at the time of casting). The target and his equipment gain a special modification of +50 to any RRs versus normal, non-magical elements specified. Versus magical attacks from that element, the target gains a special bonus of +20 to DB and/or RRs.

sp-02002.description_en: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a coma until he is healed or his brain is destroyed. The caster's normal bodily functions occur, but he is still subject to changes from the environment around him.

sp-02003.description_en: Resists the effects of harmful psychological changes on the target. This allows the target to make an RR versus the insanity modified by a +20. If the RR fails, the insanity has normal effects.

sp-02004.description_en: Allows caster a special bonus of +1 per level to all RRs versus spells from one realm of magic (Essence, Channeling or Mentalism) chosen at the time of casting.

sp-02005.description_en: Allows caster a special bonus of+ I per level to all RRs versus one combination of the realms (Essence/ Channeling, Essence/Mentalism, Arcane, etc.) chosen at the time of casting.

sp-02006.description_en: Caster gains some slight resistance to criticals. All criticals rolled against the caster are lowered by l per five levels of the caster (i.e., a 21st level Illusionist would have all criticals he took lowered by -4). However, this effect does not apply to natural '00' or natural '66' on the critical roll.

sp-02008.description_en: Caster may make a second RR versus any attempt to remove his soul from from his body (via Absolution, etc.).

sp-02009.description_en: Caster is able to cause his body to maintain it's internal pressure regardless of outside conditions. Thus it is possible for a caster to be exposed to the ocean depths (or in a vacuum) without harm.

sp-02010.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster operates as if he were in normal gravity conditions.

sp-02011.description_en: Caster goes into a state of suspended animation. He can survive in any environment regardless of conditions. When this spell is cast, the caster sets a condition under which he will come out of the stasis. This condition must be relatively simple and pertain to the immediate location of the caster (i.e., after a certain time has elapsed, when the temperature drops below I 00 degrees, when I am no longer underwater, etc.).

sp-02059.description_en: Detects the presence of any counterspells on a target. Has a 50% chance of revealing what spell by which the counters pell will be triggered. Multiple casts of this spell on a target will reveal no additional information.

sp-02060.description_en: When casting this spell on the target, the caster must specify one first level spell to be counterspelled. The spell to be counterspelled must either be known by the caster or have been previously studied (using the Study Spell on this list). If the specified spell is later cast on that target, that spell will have no effect, and this counterspell will be dispelled. At any one time, a target can only have one level of counterspells per level of experience. Each Counters pell I counts as 1 spell level, each Counterspell III counts as 3 spell levels, etc.

sp-02061.description_en: Detects the presence of any spell traps on a target. Has a 50% chance of revealing what spell by which the spell trap will be triggered. Multiple casts of this spell on a target will reveal no additional information.

sp-02062.description_en: As Counterspe/1 /, except if the specified spell is cast on the target, the target will gain a number of PP equal to the level of the countered spell.

sp-02063.description_en: As Counterspe/1 /, except that three levels of spells can be countered. This can be a specific third level spell or a specific second and a specific first level spell or three specific first level spells. Note that the three first level spells can be the same spell, so that if the spell is cast on the target repeatedly it can be countered more than once.

sp-02064.description_en: Any Counterspel/s or Spelltraps on the target have a chance of disintegrating with no effect. Each counterspell or spelltrap should roll a resistance roll at +25. Failure results in the dispelling of the failing counterspell or spell trap.

sp-02065.description_en: As Counterspell Ill, except affects 4 levels.

sp-02066.description_en: As Spelltrap I, except that up to 3 levels may be trapped.

sp-02068.description_en: As Spelltrap Ill, except 5 levels can be trapped.

sp-02069.description_en: As Counterspe/1 Ill, except affects 8 levels.

sp-02070.description_en: This spell may be cast in conjunction with any Counterspell. If the specific spell selected is cast on the target, the spell is reflected back upon its caster. Treat the caster as the target of the spell in all ways.

sp-02071.description_en: As Reflect Essence, except affects Channeling spells.

sp-02072.description_en: As Reflect Essence, except affects Mentalism spells.

sp-02074.description_en: As Countermeasures, except resistance rolls are made at no modification (+O).

sp-02075.description_en: As Counterspe/1 Ill, except affects 15 levels.

sp-02076.description_en: As Spelltrap Ill, except 15 levels can be trapped.

sp-02077.description_en: When this spell is cast, the target spell must make a RR (target level is the level of the spell) or be reversed. A reversed spell will have the opposite effect it was intended to have. For example, elemental attack spells will heal hits and wounds, Hold spells will Haste the target, Curses will Bless, etc. The exact nature of this reversal is up to the GM. If there is no appropriate reverse effect, the spell is merely canceled.

sp-02078.description_en: As Counterspel/ Ill, except affects 20 levels.

sp-02079.description_en: As lord Counterspe/1, except affects the specified spells that target anyone or anything inside a 10'R around a point touched. This point may be on an object that can be moved.

sp-02080.description_en: As Spelltrap Ill, except 20 levels can be trapped.

sp-02131.description_en: ental-As Repel Elemental Servant, except it repels Weak Elementals.

sp-02132.description_en: ental-As Control Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals.

sp-02133.description_en: ental-As Banish Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals.

sp-02134.description_en: As Summon Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals.

sp-02135.description_en: unication-For the duration, the caster can communicate freely with the target Elemental. This spell allows no control of the Elemental and does not automatically make it friendly toward the caster.

sp-02136.description_en: ental-As Master Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals. _

sp-02137.description_en: ental-As Repel Elemental Servant, except it repels Strong Elementals.

sp-02138.description_en: ental-As Control Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02139.description_en: ental-As Banish Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02141.description_en: ental-As Summon Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02142.description_en: ental-As Master Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02166.description_en: The caster can summon a torch-sized flame to his hand. The hand will be unharmed by the flames, though the fire is very real. If the caster strikes an opponent in combat with this hand, there is a 50% chance that he will inflict an 'A' Heat critical on his opponent in addition to any other damage he does.

sp-02167.description_en: Any solid inanimate, non-metal material (up to 1 cubic per level) can be warmed to 100° F at a rate of 1 cubic per round of concentration.

sp-02168.description_en: Causes one flammable object to burst into flames. Fire is normal and can be put out by the usual methods.

sp-02169.description_en: Caster can cauterize any one bleeding wound that is bleeding 5 hits per round or less. The target takes 2 concussion hits for each hit per round the wound was bleeding. This stops the bleeding, but leaves an ugly scar.

sp-02170.description_en: Caster is totally protected from natural heat up to 200° F and adds + 10 to RRs versus heat and -10 to elemental fire attacks.

sp-02171.description_en: Caster is bathed in flames. Anyone who comes within l' of the caster will take an 'A' Heat critical. The caster is unharmed by these flames, but the cloak provides no protection from other elemental attacks (including fire).

sp-02173.description_en: As Resist Heat, except protects against all natural heat and fire and modifies spells involving heat and fire by -20.

sp-02174.description_en: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Attack Table.

sp-02175.description_en: Caster can control the movement and spread of flames within the area of effect. The caster can cause flames to spread in a specific direction at the rate of 1' per round to 1O' per round depending upon the fuel. The fire itself can be caused to suddenly flare in areas to attack targets within the area of effect causing an 'A' Heat critical to any targets within the area of effect (the whole area must be aflame). The caster can only cause the fire to flare in such a way every other round. The caster can concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-02176.description_en: As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'B' Heat critical.

sp-02177.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a lO'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Attack Table.

sp-02178.description_en: As Lesser Firebolt, except range is 100'.

sp-02179.description_en: As Ignite, except 1 object per level of the caster is ignited.

sp-02180.description_en: Caster creates a wall of fire that is 1O' high and forms a lO'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-02181.description_en: As Resist Heat, except protects against all natural heat and fire and modifies spells involving heat and fire by 20, reduces damage from fire by half, and reduces heat criticals by one level.

sp-02182.description_en: I-Caster creates a lO'xlO'xlO' cube of flame. The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or that is caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-02183.description_en: As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'C' Heat critical to anyone touching the caster and an 'A' Heat Critical to all within 5'R of the caster.

sp-02184.description_en: As Control Flames, except area of effect is 20'R, caster can cause a flame to spread at a rate of 3' per round to 30' per round depending on the fuel. Also, the caster can cause 'B' Heat criticals from sudden flare up of the flame.

sp-02186.description_en: As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'D' Heat critical to anyone within 1' of the caster and an 'B' Heat Critical to all within I O'R of the caster.

sp-02187.description_en: With this spell, the caster causes an explosion offire. The attack is resolved as a+ 100 Fire Ball delivering double concussion hits. The caster is at the center of the attack, but takes half damage.

sp-02188.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell from this list each round.

sp-02225.description_en: Caster launches a flare of light that rapidly flies to a target area within range, where it slowly drifts to the ground. For the duration of the spell, the flare illuminates a 1O' radius area. If fired at a target, it will do no damage and simply fade away.

sp-02226.description_en: A beam of light springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will "tum off;" when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration has not expired).

sp-02227.description_en: Target is immune to bright light, sun glare, and snow blindness. Target also receives a special bonus of +25 versus all blinding attacks.

sp-02287.description_en: The tip of the staff glows at whatever intensity the caster desires, from barest glimmer to a bright light (20'R). When the caster is not concentrating, the tip will barely glow.

sp-02288.description_en: The caster can store any one spell in his staff. The spell to be stored must be cast immediately after this spell (within I minute). The power point cost of this spell is equal to the level of the store spell plus the cost of the spell to be stored. For example, in order to store a 5th level spell in a magic staff using Staff Spell I is equal to 5 (the level of the spell)+ 3 (the level of the store spell) = 8. The caster must spend power points to cast the spell that has been stored. A stored spell may be cast at any later time with no preparation and does not prevent the caster from casting other spells normally. Every staff has up to 5 spell storage slots in it. Only the first of these slots is available through the use of this spell, so only one spell may be stored at a time through the use of Spell Store I.

sp-02289.description_en: As Minor Staff, except that it turns the Minor Staff into a + I adder and a + I O quarterstaff.

sp-02290.description_en: When this spell is cast on a staff, it becomes attuned to a particular situation. If this situation arises, the staff makes a sound, alerting the caster. The situation must be within 100' for the staffto register the situation. For example, if the caster attuned his staff to ores, the staff would make a sound as soon as an ore approached within 100'. The caster must decide ifhe wants the alerting sound to be loud or soft at the time of casting.

sp-02291.description_en: This immediately returns the caster's staff to his outstretched hand if the staff is within range of this spell.

sp-02293.description_en: As Staff Spell I, except caster can store spells in the second spell storage slot. The caster may store any one spell in this slot and use it with no preparation at any later time.

sp-02294.description_en: As Lesser Staff, except that it turns the Lesser Staff into a +2 spell adder and a+ 10 quarterstaff.

sp-02296.description_en: As StaffSpell I, except caster can store spells in the third spell storage slot.

sp-02297.description_en: Caster's staff points in the direction of any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described to him in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object within 10% if actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes to make the item unique.

sp-02298.description_en: When this spell is cast, the caster adds his level to his Defensive Bonus and Resistance Rolls (e.g. a 15th level caster would add+ I 5 to both his DB and all RRs).

sp-02299.description_en: As StaffSpell I, except caster can store spells in the fourth spell storage slot.

sp-02300.description_en: As Greater Staff, except that it turns a Greater Staff into a +3 spell adder and a+ 15 quarterstaff.

sp-02301.description_en: Staff does double concussion hits for the duration of this spell.

sp-02302.description_en: Transforms caster's staff into any animal (creature intelligence). The creature's mass may not exceed 50 pounds. The beast is treated as a familiar (see Section 10.0 for more information on familiars).

sp-02303.description_en: As Staff Spell I, except caster can store spells in the fifth spell storage slot.

sp-02304.description_en: As Silver Staff, except that it turns a Silver into a +4 spell adder and a+ 15 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staffinto a x2 PP multiplier and a + I Oquarterstaff.

sp-02305.description_en: Staff does triple concussion hits for the duration of this spell.

sp-02306.description_en: As Golden Staff, except that it turns a Golden into a +5 spell and a+ 20 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staff into a x2 PP multiplier and a+ I 5 quarterstaff.

sp-02307.description_en: As Lord Staff, except that it turns a Lord Staff into a +6 spell adder and a +30 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staffinto a x2 PP multiplier and a +20 quarterstaff.

sp-02354.description_en: This spell analyzes one "machine," giving the caster an idea of its purpose and operating procedures. This gives the caster a +20 when operating this particular machine. Anyone to whom he describes the analysis to can get a+ I 0 when operating the machine.

sp-02355.description_en: Caster discovers the weakest point in the studied object. The weakness may be a crack, a thin point, or crumbling mortar in a wall. This weak point may be exploited by the casteror pointed outto others. Any attacks the caster does to a weak point is at xl.5 damage. This spell does not work on living creatures.

sp-02356.description_en: Target object develops a temporary internal fracture-like flaw. This reduces the strength of the item by 10 for every 10% failure on the item's RR. The item must be checked for breakage/reliability the first time it is used after this spell is cast on it. After the initial check, follow normal breakage/reliability rolls.

sp-02357.description_en: Caster warps a mechanism to modify its normal operations in a specific way. For example, if the mechanism is set to go off if the correct key is not inserted into the lock, the mechanism can be warped to go off only when the correct key is inserted. Changes to a mechanism must operate with the existing machinery.

sp-02358.description_en: Caster can improve the efficiency of any mechanism by 50% over its original efficiency for the duration of this spell.

sp-02359.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the object degrades with use. Each round the object is used it receives a cumulative -1. At the end of this spell, the object will lose a -1 penalty each round (to a maximim of +0). For every accumulated penalty of -25, the object will have a permanent -5 penalty. This penalty can be removed with an appropriate maintenance maneuver.

sp-02360.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the object improves with use. Each round the object is appropriately used it receives a cumulative +I (non-magic bonus). For every 2 rounds the object is not appropriately used, it loses a +I bonus (to a minimum of +0). At the end of the spell's duration, the object will lose a+ I bonus every 2 rounds. The maximum bonus for any object is +50.

sp-02361.description_en: The area of effect becomes a chaotic maelstrom of activity. The actual appearance of this spell depends on the surroundings. If this spell is cast in the forest, then leaves and dirt may swirl in the air throughout the area of effect. If this spell is cast indoors, books, pots, pans, and the like may swirl around. Though the appearance varies, the net effect remains the same. Everyone in the area of effect must make a successful Observation maneuver (Medium to Very Hard) or be unable to move for that round. The caster may pass through the chaos unaffected.

sp-02362.description_en: Caster instantly assembles a number of appropriate components to form a simple trap. The catalysts must logically work together, but the spell itself forms the connections that assembles the catalysts into a coherent trap. The GM must determine the effectiveness and quality of the trap based on the materials and the caster's description of how the trap will work.

sp-02363.description_en: Caster gains special insight into mechanical operations which allows him to analyze the inner workings of a specific mechanism. The caster can use this information to later re-create this mechanism given the appropriate materials. Additionally, caster gains a +25 to all Mechanition rolls.

sp-02364.description_en: As Concealed Flaw, except the strength of the item is reduced by 25 per 10% failure.

sp-02365.description_en: Allows caster to delay the effects of the next spell cast from this list (must be cast within I minute) up to 24 hours. The spell may be triggered by a specific set of circumstances that must be set at the time of casting.

sp-00846.description_en: Target will take no aggressive/offensive action, and will fight only if attacked. If the caster casts this spell at an already calmed target, the target will fall asleep.

sp-00847.description_en: Target must answer the next question the caster asks truthfully.

sp-00848.description_en: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action; he may continue to fight current foes or in self defense.

sp-00849.description_en: Target believes that the caster is of the same alignment as himself, is influential, and is superior to himself in rank, power and/or efficiency. Target will usually seek to ingratiate himself to the caster.

sp-00850.description_en: Target will obey a command of up to 5 words in length from the caster. Command cannot be completely alien to the target (e.g., suicide, blinding himself, etc) and the caster must speak a language the target can understand.

sp-00851.description_en: Target permanently forgets up to I min/lvl of specified memories as selected by caster. Memories older than I day give a special modification of +20 to the target's RR and memories older than I week get a special +40 RR modification. Memories older than I month may not be forgotten through this spell.

sp-00852.description_en: Target domesticated animal reverts to a wild state for the duration of this spell.

sp-00853.description_en: Caster causes the target to experience any one specified emotion. Caster cannot dictate the direction the target will choose to express this emotion. For example, caster can specify the emotion oflove, but he cannot choose a person for the target to fall in love with, the target will just be very loving in general.

sp-00854.description_en: The target likes or dislikes a person, place, or thing as specified by the caster. If the target has very strong feelings about the subject previously, the GM may indicate that the target receives a bonus or penalty to his resistance rolls. JO. Fear-Target flees in total fear from the caster (or a specified location) for I min per 5% failure. The target will not desire to return to the location or wish to face the caster for I day/5% failure.

sp-00856.description_en: Target develops a very serious and troublesome doubt concerning a previously accepted fact, action, or idea.

sp-00857.description_en: As Inclination, except the target experiences either devoted love or repulsive hatred towards a subject designated by caster (must be present at time of casting). For the duration the intensity of the emotion will be such that the target will have a difficult time focusing on anything else other than his love or hate. At the end of the duration, the target must make an additional resistance roll with a +20 RR modification or the effect will become permanent (to a lesser degree of intensity).

sp-00858.description_en: Target will seek to enact some vengeance against a person, place, or thing as specified by the caster. There must be in the target's mind some concept of the subject having wronged the target for the spell to be effective. The exact form of the vengeance sought depends on the character of the target, and the severity of his RR failure.

sp-00859.description_en: The caster may summon any extra planar creature (e.g., demon, elemental, etc) whose True name he knows (through use of the Creature Name spell). Each round there is a 35% chance the specified creature hears his name and appears to the caster. This spell does not command the entity, though the caster may control the entity through the use of other spells on this list or through various influential skills.

sp-00860.description_en: All targets within the area of effect will become hostile and seek to attack the nearest opponent

sp-00861.description_en: Target extra planar creature (e.g. demon, elemental, etc) whose True name the caster knows (through the use of the Creature Name spell) is dismissed from the caster's plane back to his home plane. Alternatively, the caster can attempt to banish the target from the caster's plane for a period of I 00 years/I 0% failure. The target receives a special +20 RR modification to any banish attempt and if the spell fails, the target will either attack the caster or flee. The attempt to banish the demon cancels any of the caster's control spells of which the target is under the influence.

sp-00862.description_en: Targets flee in total panic from the caster.

sp-00863.description_en: Target is eased from the effects of mind disease, grief, Iycanthropy, hate, etc for the duration of this spell.

sp-00864.description_en: As Confusion, except affects all targets in radius.

sp-00865.description_en: As Command, except affects all targets in radius.

sp-00866.description_en: Target sleeps in a deep, unwakable sleep without aging or deterioration until dispelled, a set condition is met or the duration ends.

sp-00868.description_en: Target becomes the caster's unquestioning slave for the duration of this spell. The target may attempt a new RR at the end of each week to break the effect. The target will seek to ingratiate himself to his master and do all things in a manner to please his master and forward his master's goals.

sp-00870.description_en: This spell inscribes a spell on a specially prepared piece of paper. The rune can then be used to cast the inscribed spell once. The spell to be inscribed must be cast within one minute after this spell is cast. Rune II can inscribe 1st or 2nd level spells. The rune can be set to affect the reader.

sp-00871.description_en: [RR . - - - - - - - - - - . . - - - - - - - - - - - - , Mod: -20] A Sign can be inscribed on any "non-mobile" surface and affects the triggering being. A Sign can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): a) specified time has passed, b) specified movements within 20', c) specified sounds within 20', d) touch, or e) reading. The Sign is cancelled when a target fails a RR against it. Sign of Pain causes the target to take 25%

sp-00872.description_en: '-As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 3rd level spells.

sp-00873.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain, except Iii.Ji I target feels weak and drained. This results in a special modifi- W cation of -20 to all maneuvers and attacks for I O minutes per 5 RR failure.

sp-00874.description_en: The caster may determine what spell is inscribed within a rune or sign. This spell has a I% chance per level of the inscribed spell of setting off the inscribed spell. The caster also learns if the rune or sign is set to affect a readerornot.

sp-00875.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 5th level spells.

sp-00876.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target is in a state of shock for I Ominutes per 5% failure (treat shock victims as if they are stunned except they never pass out due to this shock).

sp-00877.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 6th level spells. I0. Sign of Fear-[RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target will flee the place of the sign. The target may not return for I0 minutes per 5 RR failure.

sp-00879.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 7th level spells.

sp-00880.description_en: As Sign ofPain except target is teleported to one of the caster's designated Observation Signs. The designated Observation Sign may not be more than I mile per level of the caster (at the time of inscribing this spell) away from the Sign of Transport or else the attempt to inscribe this Sign automatically fails.

sp-00881.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 8th level spells.

sp-00882.description_en: Caster's may see and hear as ifhe were at any one of his Observation Signs within range of this spell. The caster's vision may rotate around the point of the Observation Sign (except that he will not be able to see through the surface the Sign is inscribed on if it is opaque.

sp-00883.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 10th level spells.

sp-00884.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target takes 90% of his remaining hits.

sp-00886.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 15th level spells.

sp-00887.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target is blinded for I hour per 5% RR failure.

sp-00888.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 20th level spells.

sp-00889.description_en: As Signwatch, except for the range.

sp-00890.description_en: Caster may inscribe any lower level Sign on this list, except that it can affect a number of targets equal to the level of the caster before being cancelled.

sp-00891.description_en: Caster may store a number of power points within a sheet of rune paper equal to the level of this spell. The power points stored are considered to be of the same realm as the ~ 1\ \ caster and they may not be multiplied in any way when the rune . f is eventually activated.

sp-00892.description_en: Allows the caster to retain anything he reads or learns as if he had a photographic memory with. total recall for the duration.

sp-00939.description_en: Caster can remove one Symbol/ (an placed I st level spell). The Symbol's RR is based on the level of the spell in the Symbol spell (the target's level) and the level of the Bypass Symbol Spell (the attack level).

sp-00940.description_en: Caster can emplace one I st level spell on any I given non-mobile stone (see below). Within one minute, the spell to be placed must also be cast (within I 0'). The symbol is usually visible, but is only required to be visible if reading is the trigger (see below). • The Symbol must be placed on a slab of stone (block, piece, etc.) weighing at least 2,000 pounds. Only one Symbol may be placed on each continuous slab. The stone may not be moved without dispelling the Symbol. • A Symbol can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. The triggering range is normally I 0' or the range of the placed spell, whichever is larger. • If the spell placed is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell's level (i.e., for Symbol I that attack level is always 1st level, not the level of the caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normally +0. However, the attack can be focused on a location (as opposed to simply the person who triggers the symbol). In this case the OB is +50. • Normally, if the Symbol affects a being or thing (e.g., healing, attacks, etc.), it can be triggered only once per day.

sp-00941.description_en: Allows the caster to connect one surface or trigger to a symbol that is normally outside of range of the symbol. For example, manipulating a door and lock mechanism in one room could trigger a Light Symbol on the other side of the building, bringing someone to investigate. The distance between the trigger and the symbol can be up to 1 foot per level. Symbol Extension must be in place before the symbol to use it is inscribed or imbedded.

sp-00942.description_en: As Bypass Symbol/, except affects up to a Symbol II/.

sp-00943.description_en: As Unsymbol /, except affects up to a Symbol

sp-00955.description_en: As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a I 3th level spell.

sp-00956.description_en: As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol X/11.

sp-00957.description_en: As Symbol I, except caster can emplace any spell less than his level.

sp-00958.description_en: Allows caster to modify any imbed symbol spell on this list to allow it to be imbedded on a mobile surface. The resulting sign will remain potent until it is triggered. The mobile surface must be non-living and must weigh at least I 00 pounds. A given spell caster can only have one mobile sign per level of experience (subsequent castings will cause the oldest castings to dispel).

sp-00959.description_en: As Unsymbol I, except caster can remove any spell of a level less than his own (e.g., a 50th level Runemage could remove a 49th level spell, but not a 50th level spell).

sp-00960.description_en: As Inscribe Sign, except target must be a living creature and must weigh at least 50 pounds. The sign will remain potent until triggered. Often these signs are disguised by incorporating them with existing tattoos.

sp-00961.description_en: Allows the caster to research special ward spells to be used with this list. In addition, the caster receives a special bonus of +25 to his next Ward Lore maneuver.

sp-00962.description_en: Allows the caster to detect all active wards within the area of effect. The caster can move the area of effect each round.

sp-00963.description_en: When cast on a properly prepared ward this spell will sound an alarm when a specified set of circumstances occur within the area of effect. The alarm may be silent (only the caster will be aware, at a range of 100' per level of caster) or audible (everyone will hear an alarm will sound), as dictated at the time of casting. An alarm may either sound for as long as the specified circumstance exists, or it can be set to sound for up to 1 minute per level of the caster before returning to a dormant and watchful state.

sp-00964.description_en: When cast on a properly prepared ward sign(s) this spell will prevent the use of one designated sense through the area of effect. The sense must be decided at the time the ward sign is prepared. If the caster spends double the normal number of PPs required by this spell, he may add an additional sense that is blocked by this spell. For each increment of normal PPs spent, another sense may be blocked. For example, if 16 PPs are spent, four senses could be blocked. Note that for each extra sense blocked, this spell is treated as being one level higher (for the purposes of Warding Lore).

sp-00965.description_en: When cast on a properly prepared ward sign(s) this spell will attempt to prevent the passage of animals into or through the area of effect. Any animal that attempts to travel through this area will go elsewhere unless it makes an RR (with a special modifier of -20) versus the level of the caster. An animal may be forced into the area, but it will fight and struggle against this as much as it is able. Any animal forces past the ward will suffer a -25 to all actions while in the protected area.

sp-00966.description_en: As Lesser Animal Ward, except affects lesser spirits of the dead (Class I, II, and III).

sp-00967.description_en: As Lesser Animal Ward, except affects lesser demons (Type I, II, and III).

sp-00968.description_en: As Sense Ward, except prevents the casting of Essence spells through the area of effect. All Essence spells must first resist versus the level of the ward or else be canceled. Active spells that pass through the area of effect must make a RR or else be dispelled.

sp-00969.description_en: As Lesser Essence Ward, except prevents the use of Mentalism spells.

sp-00970.description_en: As Lesser Essence Ward, except prevents the use of Channeling spells. ll. Multiple Ward-Allows the caster to combine multiple wards into one properly prepared ward sign. The caster must cast all of the wards involved immediately after this spell (within 2 minutes).

sp-00972.description_en: As Sense Ward, except prevents all creatures from passing into or through the area of effect. Any creature that attempts to pass through the area of effect must make a -20 RR or be blocked from passing through the area. This spell does not have any effect on Class IV, V, and VI undead, nor does it have any effect on Type IV, V, and VI demons.

sp-00973.description_en: As Lesser Animal Ward, except animals must make a -40 RR.

sp-00974.description_en: As Greater Animal Ward, except Class I, II, and III undead must make a-40RR and Class IV, V, and VI undead must make a normal RR.

sp-00975.description_en: Allows caster to tum the ward signs of any ward invisible. The ward is still detectable by a Detect Ward spell.

sp-00976.description_en: As Greater Animal Ward, except Type I, II, and III demons must make a -40 RR and Type IV, V, and VI demons must make a normal RR.

sp-00977.description_en: As Lesser Essence Ward, except for duration.

sp-00978.description_en: As Lesser Mentalism Ward, except for duration.

sp-00979.description_en: As Lesser Channeling Ward, except for duration.

sp-00980.description_en: As Lesser Barrier Ward, except any creature attempting to pass through the area of effect must make a -40 RR. Class IV, V, and VI undead and Type IV, V, and VI demons resist at 10.

sp-00982.description_en: Caster may enchant one ward to have an additional defense versus the ward's target creature type. Whenever the designated creature attempts to pass through the area of effect, in addition to the normal effects of the ward, the ward delivers an 'E' Impact critical if it enters the area of effect (regardless of the creatures resistance roll).

sp-00983.description_en: When this spell is cast on any lower level ward, the target ward will have its duration increased to 1day/level of the caster.

sp-00254.description_en: Allows target to see all Mana Barriers (any spell effect from this list) within 100'. Without benefit of this spell, the caster can only see Mana Barriers that he creates.

sp-00255.description_en: Creates a shield of force in front of the caster th.at adds 25 to his defense. The shield will move with the caster.

sp-00256.description_en: Creates an invisible barrier 10'x I0'x I' that slows anyone who tries to move through it by 35%. It will also modify any attack made through it by -35.

sp-00257.description_en: Creates a shield of mana behind the caster that negates any bonuses for flank or rear attack made on him.

sp-00258.description_en: Encases the caster in a mana shield that will absorb 20 concussion hits damage before collapsing. Any concussion hits absorbed in this manner are not inflicted upon the caster. Any criticals scored against the caster are reduced by one level unless the concussion damage breaks the shield (treat an 'A' critical as an 'A' critical modified by -25).

sp-00259.description_en: Creates a cage of mana around a target. Target cannot move more than I foot from his current location or make any attacks. All melee attacks against (or by) the target suffer a special modification of -50 and missile attacks suffer a penalty of -25. The target can break out of this cage by making a Very Hard static maneuver (modified by triple Strength).

sp-00260.description_en: As Hindrance Barrier I, except movement reduction is 50% and penalty if -50.

sp-00261.description_en: Covers an area in a thin layer of mana that is very slippery. All attempts to move across the area require a Hard moving maneuver to avoid slipping and falling (Very Hard if moving on an incline).

sp-00262.description_en: Creates a mana barrier around a single, inanimate object (that has no more than 1.5 times the caster's mass) that makes the object difficult to hold on to or move. Any attempt to manipulate the object requires a Hard static maneuver (modified by triple strength). If the object is a weapon, failing this maneuver results in a fumble.

sp-00263.description_en: As Personal Shield I, except the shield can take 40 hits before collapsing.

sp-00264.description_en: Creates a wall of mana through which nothing will pass. It can withstand 100 concussion hits damage before collapsing.

sp-00265.description_en: Creates an invisible field that slows anyone trying to move through it by 75%. All attacks made through the field are at -75.

sp-00266.description_en: Wraps the target in a mana barrier that is very slippery on the exterior. Everytime the target moves, he must make a Very Hard moving maneuver to stay on his feet.

sp-00277.description_en: Creates a pot that can hold up to 5 gallons of liquid. It is not damaged by the effects of normal fire and cold. It should be treated as an iron cooking pot for all purposes.

sp-00278.description_en: Creates a rope up to 20 feet long +5 feet per level of the caster. Treat the rope as a superior hemp rope for all purposes.

sp-00280.description_en: The hammer created by this spell can be ofany size up to a I Opound sledge hammer, but cannot be changed after the spell is cast.

sp-00298.description_en: Caster can observe all spell signatures in the area of effect.

sp-00299.description_en: Allows the caster to store a single signature for use with other spells on this list. The caster gains no information about the spell signature in question, but can recognize it as being distinctly different from other signatures. A given caster can only have one signature stored per level of experience.

sp-00300.description_en: The caster creates an area with a higher concentration of Essence. One of the following effects (roll d I 00, not open-ended) will occur for all spells cast from within this area for the duration of the spell. The caster may add or subtract I from this roll for every rank he has developed in this spell list. 1-25: spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -10 26-50: spell durations are l .5x normal 51-75: spell areas of effect are 1.5x normal 76-100: spell ranges are 1.5x normal

sp-00301.description_en: The caster creates an area with a lower concentration of Essence. One of the following effects (roll dl 00, not open-ended) will occur for all spells cast from within this area for the duration of the spell. The caster may add or subtract 1 from this roll for every rank he has in this spell list. 1-25 spell targets get an RR bonus of+ 10 26-50 spell durations are half normal 51-75 spell areas of effect are half normal 76-100 spell ranges are half normal

sp-00302.description_en: The caster creates an area in which the average amount of available Essence fluctuates wildly. All spells cast in the area of effect require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver with a special modification of -15 (even spells that do not normally need to make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver).

sp-00303.description_en: The caster creates an area in which the average amount of Essence is almost perfectly uniform. Anytime a Spell Casting Static Maneuvers made in the area ofeffect, that maneuver is made with a special modification of+ 15.

sp-00304.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's spells leave no signatures.

sp-00305.description_en: As Concentrate Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25 spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -20 26-50 spell durations are 2x normal spell areas of effect are 2x normal 51-75 76-100 spell ranges are 2x normal.

sp-00306.description_en: As Disperse Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25 spell targets get an RR bonus of +20 26-50 spell durations are one quarter normal 51-75 spell areas of effect are one quarter normal 76-100 spell ranges are one quarter normal

sp-00307.description_en: Caster is able to determine what spell created the target spell signature.

sp-00309.description_en: As Stabilize Essence I, except the modification is +30.

sp-00311.description_en: As Concentrate Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25 spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -30 26-50 spell durations are 3x normal 51-75 spell areas of effect are 3x normal 76-100 spell ranges are 3x normal.

sp-00312.description_en: As Disperse Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows.

sp-00326.description_en: Caster may combine two existing servants, created by lower level spells on this list, into one servant that will be suitable for both tasks. This spell will end when either of the servants is dispelled or when the first servant's duration runs out.

sp-00327.description_en: The Mover can pick up any single object (that weighs no more than JOO pounds) and move it up to JOO feet away. If the caster desires, the Mover will continue to do this with other similar objects until they are all moved to the new location. The Mover can stack the objects in any fashion they are normally stackable.

sp-00328.description_en: The Carrier is shaped like a big turtle with a flat back. It can carry up to I 00 pounds per level of the caster (moving at a rate of up to 40' per round). It is 5 feet wide by 8 feet long by 2 feet high. The Carrier can negotiate most terrain in the manner as the Mount I spell. This spell makes no provision for loading the cargo onto the Carrier.

sp-00329.description_en: The Climber can move on any solid surface that the caster desires at are rate of 50' per round so long as the surface will support the weight of the Climber. The Climber can even move across a ceiling, so long as the ceiling surface can hold the weight of the climber (stone or wood should be no problem; plaster might)

sp-00319.description_en: The Binder is a circular band 3" wide and l' in diameter. It can contract to whatever size the caster desires to hold two objects together. It can release and contract again during the duration. The strength of this bond is such that it would normally require a Hard maneuver (modified by triple Strength) to break it. This can be used to bind wounds and (though the caster must make a successfuly First Aid maneuver to place the binding correctly) reducing bleeding by up to 2 hits per round.

sp-00320.description_en: The Holder will hold onto anything the caster gives him for the duration of the spell. The Holder may not move from the spot where it was created. The object it is holding is fixed to the spot very tightly and it would normally take a Very Hard maneuver (modified by triple Strength) to dislodge it. The Holder can grip an object very tightly if necessary, but will never grip hard enough to break the object.

sp-00321.description_en: The Alarm servant cannot move by itself, but can be moved by others. At the time of casting, the caster designates a range and a number of targets up to his level. If anyone other than the caster or designated targets come within I O' of the binder, the Alarm servant will begin a very loud wailing noise.

sp-00341.description_en: Caster can command an Mana Warrior to move to any location within 100'. Once there, the Mana Warrior will wait for further commands. It will not engage in melee even if attacked.

sp-00342.description_en: Caster can command an Mana Warrior to attack any specific target within 100'. The Mana Warrior will move to and engage the target in melee combat. Once the target is down (but not necessarily dead or unconscious), the Mana Warrior will cease any actions. The Mana Warrior will re-engage the target if the target gets up or is moved in any way.

sp-00343.description_en: Creates a Lesser Mana Warrior with the following stats. Level 3, 30 hits, AT 8, DB +10, OB +20, Move Rate of 50. Resolve all attacks by the Mana Warrioron the Club Attack Table.

sp-00344.description_en: As Attack/, except caster can designate up to two specific targets (each within 100'). The Mana Warrior will move to and engage the first designated target in combat. Once the first target is down, the Mana Warrior will move to the second target and engage it in combat. After both targets are down, the Mana warrior cease any action. The Mana Warrior will reengage either of the two targets designated in this spell if they get up or are moved in any way (engaging the first target first if both get up or are moved).

sp-00345.description_en: Caster commands an Mana Warrior to guard a person, place, or thing. The Mana Warrior will attack anything except the caster (or the target person if guarding a person) that approaches within 20' of the thing to be guarded. The Mana Warrior will move at maximum movement rate to stay within 10' of the thing to be guarded. The caster may (at the time of casting) designate a number of people or creatures up to half his level (rounded up) that may approach the thing to be guarded without being attacked by the Mana Warrior.

sp-00346.description_en: Creates a Minor Mana Warrior with the following stats. Level 5, 50 hits, AT 10, DB + 10, OB +40, Move Rate of70. Resolve all attacks by the Mana Warrior on the Short Sword Attack Table.

sp-00347.description_en: Caster commands an Mana Warrior to move continuously between two designated, non-mobile points and to attack anyone who comes within 50' of the Mana Warrior. The Mana Warrior will follow the shortest unobstructed path between the two points. Both points must be within 100' of the caster when the spell is cast. The caster may, at the time of casting, designate a number of people or creatures up to half his level (rounded up) that may approach the Mana Warrior without being attacked.

sp-00348.description_en: Caster may cast two spells from this list on a single Mana Warrior. They must make sense in the order they are given or only the first will be followed. For example a Mana Warrior commanded to "guard then patrol" will only guard.

sp-00349.description_en: Creates a Major Mana Warrior with the following stats.: Lvl 10, 75 hits, AT 14, DB +10, OB +60, Move Rate 90. Resolve all attacks on the Broadsword Attack Table.

sp-00350.description_en: As Attack//, except caster may designate up to five specifc targets. All targets must be within 100' of the caster when this spell is cast.

sp-00351.description_en: As Multi-Command//, except caster may cast up to three spells on a single Mana warrior.

sp-00352.description_en: Creates a Greater Mana Warrior with the following stats. Level 15, 100 hits, AT 16, DB+ 10, OB +80, Move Rate of 110. Resolve all attacks by the Mana Warrior on the Morning Star Attack Table.

sp-00353.description_en: Puts an Mana Warrior in a "stasis." Caster can cast any spells (including Move, Guard, and Patrol) he desires upon an Mana Warrior, but the commands will not be executed until a specific circumstance occurs. The conditions under which the Mana Warrior is activated must be declared at the time this spell is cast and cannot be changed unless this spell is cast again.

sp-00354.description_en: As Multi-Command// except caster may cast up to five spells from this list on one Mana Warrior, or cast three spells on one Mana Warrior and two on another.

sp-00355.description_en: Creates a Lord Mana Warrior with the following stats. Level 20, 130 hits, AT 18, DB + 10, OB +100, Move Rate of 130. Resolve all attacks by the Mana Warrior on the Battle Axe Attack Table.

sp-00356.description_en: As Attack/, except caster may continue designate targets to one Mana Warrior as long as the Mana Warrior exists.

sp-00357.description_en: Creates an Mana Warrior True with the following stats. Level 50, 160 hits, AT 20, DB +10, OB + 120, Move Rate of 150. Resolve all attacks by the Mana Warrior on the Two-Handed Sword Attack Table. SPECIAL Norn

sp-01452.description_en: Caster may divide his parry between up to two melee attackers with no penalty.

sp-01453.description_en: Caster may move up to 30% normal movement and attack without suffering a penalty to his OB.

sp-01454.description_en: I-Caster may attack and parry as normal and then perform a diving roll to a location up to 20' away from his starting point. This maneuver is part of the attack and requires no extra percentage activity (or declared action).

sp-01455.description_en: Casters next attack this round delivers l .5x concussion hits.

sp-01456.description_en: Caster may parry this round with 125% of his 08; however, the caster may not attack this round.

sp-01457.description_en: If the casters next attack this round inflicts a critical, it will cause I hit per round of bleeding in addition to all other critical results. This spell will have no effect on creatures that are normally immune to bleeding wounds (golems, constructs, undead, etc.).

sp-01458.description_en: As Split Parry II, except caster may divide his parry between up to three attackers.

sp-01459.description_en: I-If the target of the casters next melee attack this round parries with a weapon or shield, it must immediately make a breakage check modified by -20.

sp-01460.description_en: Caster can divide his melee 08 in any proportion he desires and attack two separate targets with no penalty as long as both are within normal melee range and neither of the targets is positioned to the caster's rear.

sp-01461.description_en: If the casters next attack this round inflicts a critical, it will cause I round of stun in addition to all other critical results. This spell has no effect on creatures that are normally immune to stun.

sp-01462.description_en: As Tumble Evasion/, except caster may end up in a location 50' away.

sp-01463.description_en: As Moving Strike I, except caster may move up to 70% normal movement.

sp-01464.description_en: As Hammer Strike I, except delivers double concussion hits.

sp-01465.description_en: As Survival Instinct/, except caster may parry with 150% of his normal OB.

sp-01466.description_en: As Bleeding Strike I, except 2 hits/rnd are caused in addition to all other critical results.

sp-01467.description_en: If the caster parries a melee attack this round, and the melee attack does not inflict any damage, he may attack back with 50% of his normal 08 immediately following the opponent's attack. This riposte attack requires a action of its own, but may be made in addition to any other attack this round. For example, the caster could cast this spell, attack with 90% 08, and then riposte with 50% OB.

sp-01468.description_en: As Shatter Strike I, except the weapon or shield must make the breakage check modified by -50.

sp-01469.description_en: As Split Parry II, except caster may divide his parry between up to four attackers.

sp-01470.description_en: As Split Attack II, except caster can attack up to three separate targets as long as all three are within normal melee range and none of the foes is to the caster's rear.

sp-01471.description_en: Caster may utilize any one of the lower level spells on this list once per round.

sp-01516.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as ifit were daylight.

sp-01517.description_en: Caster has a 300 degree field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.

sp-01518.description_en: As Nightvision, except the caster can see l 00' in even murky water.

sp-01519.description_en: As Battle Awareness I, except bonus to the maneuver is +50.

sp-01520.description_en: Caster can breathe water but not air.

sp-01521.description_en: Target can swim without expending energy (i.e., will expend no exhaustion points).

sp-01522.description_en: As Nightvision, except the caster can see l 00' in smoke, fog, rain, or any gas that would normally impede vision.

sp-01523.description_en: As Waterlungs, except the caster can breathe any gas as normal air. I 0. Darkvision-As Nightvision, except that any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-01525.description_en: Delays the effect of a poison on the caster. If poison is not eliminated before the spell expires, the caster will be affected by the poison at that time.

sp-01526.description_en: As Swimming, except the caster can also perform any maneuvers (including melee combat) as though he were on dry land.

sp-01527.description_en: As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe water, air, and/or any gas at will.

sp-01528.description_en: Caster can ignore the effects of high pressures such as those found deep under water.

sp-01529.description_en: Caster and his equipment are immune to the effects of normal (non-magical) fire for the duration. He may perform any movement or maneuvers as normal.

sp-01530.description_en: Combines the effects of Watervision, Waterlungs, and Water Maneuvering.

sp-01531.description_en: Caster does not need to breathe to survive for the duration. I 9. Fire Dwelling-Combines the effects of Gasvision, Gaslungs, and Fire Maneuvering.

sp-01533.description_en: Caster and his equipment are immune to the effects of airless environments for the duration. This spell gives the caster a +50 RR versus vacuum attacks. Note that this spell does not confer any protection against the heat or cold of the vacuum of space.

sp-01535.description_en: As Water Dwelling except for duration.

sp-01536.description_en: Caster can survive comfortably and move and maneuver as normal in any of the hostile environments the lower level spells on this list protect against.

sp-07992.description_en: Creates a black, insubstantial wall up to 20' x 20' x l" that light cannot pass into or through (i.e., does not hinder movement, but it blocks vision).

sp-07993.description_en: Creates a wall of dense churning airup to I O'x I O'x3 '. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

sp-07994.description_en: As Light Wall, except for duration.

sp-07995.description_en: Creates a wall of water up to lO'xlO'xl'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.

sp-07996.description_en: Creates a wall of wood up to IO'x20'x2'. This wall can be burned though, chopped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).

sp-07997.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of earth and has a size up to I O'x l O'x (3' at base, l' at top) of packed earth.

sp-08000.description_en: Opens a pit (500 cubic feet in stone; l 000 cuic feet in earth or ice). The entire pit must be within 50' of caster. A pit may not be opened except on a horizontal surface with an incline of Jess than 45'.

sp-08001.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of stone and has a size up to IO'x IO'x l '. It can be chipped through.

sp-08004.description_en: As Earth Wall, except for duration.

sp-08005.description_en: As lcewall l, except for area of effect.

sp-08007.description_en: Fuses 2 touching walls (must be of the same material; seam can be up to 20' long) or fuses a section of stone blocks (up to 100 cu').

sp-08008.description_en: Creates a wall out of the predominant ground material (grassy earth, sand, etc.) The wall may have dimensions of up to IO'xlOO'xl'. The wall has all of the physical properties of the ground it came from.

sp-08009.description_en: As any one of the lower level "wall" spells on this list (except Meld Walls), except the wall can be curved up to a semicircle.

sp-08010.description_en: As Meld Walls, except walls may be of dissimiliar type.

sp-08011.description_en: As Stonewall True, except the caster may create a freestanding structure with a total surface area ofup to 2000'.

sp-08012.description_en: As Groundwall, except for the duration.

sp-08013.description_en: By directly Channeling the power of his deity, the caster creates a transparent wall of "force" that is absolutely impassable by anyone or anything. It is up to IO'x20'x I".

sp-08014.description_en: As Wall ofForce, except for duration.

sp-08015.description_en: Exerts 1 pound of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by Staying alone and pressure can only be in one direction.

sp-08017.description_en: Allows caster to move up and down vertically 1O' per round. The spell does not provide a means for horizontal movement.

sp-08018.description_en: As Staying I, except pressure limit is 25 pounds.

sp-08019.description_en: Target can fly at a rate of 100' per round (approximately 7 mph). While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g., walking, running, etc.) is not allowed.

sp-08021.description_en: As Levitation I, except rate is I 00' per round.

sp-08022.description_en: As Flying /, except rate is 300' per round (approximately 20 mph).

sp-08023.description_en: By concentrating on the mind of a missile firer and the flight of the missile, the caster causes +50 to be added to the attack roll of the missile. The caster must concentrate, touch the firer and the see the mssile for the entire round that the missile is fired.

sp-08038.description_en: Target can see I 00' ona clear night as if it were day. At least some small amount of residual light is required for this psell to work. See Section 7.1.19 (in Spell Law) for more on the environment's effect on vision.

sp-08039.description_en: Target's step is muffled. This results in a special +25 bonus to all Stalking maneuvers.

sp-08040.description_en: Target gains extremely acute sense of smell. This spell confers a special +50 bonus to all Awareness maneuvers involving only smell (+25 to maneuvers involving smell and other senses).

sp-08041.description_en: As Nightvision, except affects vision underwater (and other liquids).

sp-08042.description_en: Target gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a bonus to all actions that require a sense of touch. For example, target might receive +25 to picking locks, disarming traps, opening secret doors, etc. In addition, this spell confers a special +50 bonus to all Awareness maneuvers involving only touch (+25 to maneuvers involving touch and other senses).

sp-08043.description_en: Target gains extremely accurate sense of vision. This spell confers a special +50 bonus to all Awareness maneuvers involving only vision (+25 to maneuvers involving vision and other senses).

sp-08044.description_en: As Nightvision, except no light source is required and target can see even in magically created darkness.

sp-08045.description_en: As Scent, except target can detect extremely faint scents (e.g., up to 48 hours old, after rain storms, through snow, etc.).

sp-08046.description_en: Target can see in any brightness of light (including that which would normally be blinding or glaring). This spell does not work in the absence of light.

sp-08047.description_en: Target gains extreme sensitivity to vibrations in the ground (or other solid material; up to the area of effect). Target gains information indicating general movements and number of targets (± I 0% ). Treat as a +25 to + 100 bonus to Awareness maneuvers (depending on the type of activity).

sp-08048.description_en: As Waterlungs, except target can breathe any air, water, and/or gas at will.

sp-08049.description_en: As Nightvision, except range of vision is the range of normal daylight vision.

sp-08050.description_en: For the duration of the spell, all illusions within range of the spell cease to exist for the target. Target need not be aware of any illusions within the range before casting this spell.

sp-08051.description_en: · - Target's skin has the resilience of a minor drake (effective AT of 12).

sp-08052.description_en: For the duration of this spell, any poisons in the body of the target (at the time of the casting) will not affect the target. For the duration of this spell, the target cannot be the target of further Stop Poison spells.

sp-08053.description_en: Target has the effects of Sly Ears, Scent, Touch, and Sharp Eyes spells simultaneously.

sp-08054.description_en: Target can "merge" his senses with those of a subject whose exact location is known. Exact location can be established through a prior arrangement. If the subject is not at the specified location, the PPs for this spell are still expended.

sp-08055.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-08080.description_en: Caster can remove one Sign I (an emplaced 1st level spell). The Sign's RR is based upon the level of the spell in the Sign (the target level) and the level of the Unsign spell (the attack level).

sp-08081.description_en: Target sign will not trigger for the duration of this spell. This spell may only be cast upon any given sign once per day.

sp-08082.description_en: Caster can emplace one I st level spell on any inanimate object (see below). Within one minute, the spell to be emplaced must also be cast (within 10' of the sign). The symbol is usually visable, but is only required to be visible if reading is the trigger (see below). • The Sign must be placed on an inanimate object of a size relative to the level of the spell. The object must be either I 0 square inches per level of the spell or weigh I 0 pounds per level of the spell. • A Sign can be triggered by one of the following (decided by the caster): time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. The triggering range is normally I 0' or the range of the em placed spell, whichever is larger. • If the spell emplaced is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell' s level (not the level of the caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normall +0. However, the attack can be focussed on a location (as opposed to simply the person who triggers the symbol). In this case, the OB is +50. • Normally, if the Sign affects a being or thing (e.g., healing, attacks, etc.), it can be triggered only once per day.

sp-08083.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign I, except instead of imbedding a spell, the Sign itself affects a target character (trigger effects determined upon imbedding). Target character is limited to 60% activity for I minute per 10 failure.

sp-08084.description_en: As Sign I, except up to a 3rd level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08085.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target suffers a -30 to all actions for I minute per 10 failure.

sp-08086.description_en: As Unsign I, except will remove up to a Sign Ill, or a Sign of Hesitation, or a Sign of Confusion.

sp-08087.description_en: As Sign ofHesitation, except target is put into a state of shock for 10 minutes per 10 failure (treat as if target is stunned, except target will never pass out due to this shock).

sp-08088.description_en: As Sign /, except up to a 5th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08089.description_en: As Sign ofHesitation, except target will flee the location of the Sign for 1 minute per 5 failure. The target must make his RR based upon his resistance to Essence (not his resistance to Fear).

sp-08090.description_en: As Unsign I, except will remove up to a Sign V, a Sign of Fear, or Sign of Shock.

sp-08091.description_en: As Sign ofHesitation, except target falls into a magical sleep from which he cannot be awakened for 10 minutes per 10 failure.

sp-08093.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target is . blinded for 1 hour per 10 failure.

sp-08095.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target is paralyzed for 1 hour per 10 failure.

sp-08096.description_en: As Sign I, except up to a 10th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08097.description_en: As any Sign spell, except may affect a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-08098.description_en: As Unsign I, except any lower level Sign spell may be removed.

sp-08099.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target is is killed if he fails his RR.

sp-08100.description_en: As Sign I, except any level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08101.description_en: As Unsign True, except a number of Signs may be removed equal to the caster's level.

sp-08157.description_en: I-As Tap Source I, except rate is 3 PPs per minute.

sp-08158.description_en: As Power Storage I, except stores 3 PPs per level.

sp-08160.description_en: As Sense Power I, except for the area of effect.

sp-08161.description_en: As Power Storage/, excpet stores 4 PPs per level.

sp-08163.description_en: As Tap Source I, except rate is 5 PPs per minute.

sp-08164.description_en: As Channels I, except up to twentieth level spells may be transmitted.

sp-08165.description_en: As Tap Source I, except rate of absorbtion is 1 PP per round.
