sp-08185.description_en: Caster knows the direction, and distance to any inhibition zones within the area of effect. The caster receives no specific information on the nature of the spell inhibition.

sp-08186.description_en: Caster creates an inhibition zone, preventing the casting of spells from a specific spell list. This spell prevents the casting of up to second level spells from the specified spell list.

sp-08187.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08188.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08189.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except spells up to fourth level are prevented.

sp-08190.description_en: As Spell Inhibition IV, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08191.description_en: _:.. As Spell Inhibition IV, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08192.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except spells up to sixth level are prevented.

sp-08193.description_en: As Spell Inhibition VJ, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08194.description_en: As Spell Inhibition VI, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08195.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except spells up to tenth level are prevented.

sp-08196.description_en: As Spell Inhibition True, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08197.description_en: As Spell Inhibition True, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08276.description_en: I - Caster gains insight into important events in the very recent past of a place or an item. The caster will see the most significant events in the item's past (the past is defined as 1 hour per level of the caster). The caster will see one event for every five levels of experience. The importance of the events is only measured with respect to the time period viewed (not in the absolute history of the item or place).

sp-08277.description_en: Gives the area oforigin of the item, the race of the being who created it, and when it was made (within 100 years).

sp-08278.description_en: Caster learns the cause of death, the instrument(s) used to cause death, and the time of death of a single dead body (must be within 10' of the body). Corpse must have died within a number of years equal to the caster's level.

sp-08279.description_en: One of the caster's senses is moved to a point up to 100' distant (ignoring intervening barriers). The exact distance must be specified when the spell is cast. Once the sense is placed, it may not move, but may rotate. If the caster has access to sense affecting spells, the projected sense may use these as well.

sp-08280.description_en: As Retrocognition I, excpet that the past is defined as I day per level of the caster.

sp-08283.description_en: Caster may cause a number of targets equal to his level to perceive what he senses with either along Sense or Scrying spell.

sp-08285.description_en: As Long Sense Ill, except that caster may project all five senses.

sp-08286.description_en: Caster transfers one of his sense into an inanimate object. While the object contains the sense, the caster can only sense through the object (regardless of the range to the object). The caster may end the spell at any time (up to the proscribed duration), but the sense is not restored until the caster touches the object.

sp-08295.description_en: The target's aura becomes visible and brightly illuminated. This makes the target seem more powerful, subtracting I O from all attacks against the target.

sp-08296.description_en: The caster receives specific information about the target's aura. This information includes whether the target views the caster as a friend or foe, the general skills of the target, and his general demeanor.

sp-08297.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] All who come within 10' of the target must make an RR Failure indicates that the person is confused for I round per I 0% failure. While confused, a person is limited to 50% activity (though he will always defend himself as if at I 00% activity).

sp-08298.description_en: The caster combines the effects of a first level spell with the target's aura. All who come into physical contact with the target are affected by the spell (though the target is never affected). Only spells with an area ofeffect of I target and a range of touch may be combined with an aura.

sp-08299.description_en: The target is surrounded by light, his aura visible for all to see. All attacks on target subtract 15. I 0. Hide Aura - The caster's aura cannot be viewed.

sp-08301.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] As Aura ofConfusion except victims failing their RR are under the effects of Fear for I round per I0% failure.

sp-08302.description_en: As Spell Aura I, except that up to a third level spell may be used.

sp-08303.description_en: As Aura, except target has a great holy presence and attacks subtract 25 .

sp-08304.description_en: Caster alters his aura, changing its appearance however he likes.

sp-08305.description_en: As Aura of Fear, except there is no RR modification and the radius is 20'.

sp-08306.description_en: As Spell Aura I, except that up to fifth level spells may be used.

sp-08307.description_en: As Alter Aura, except may be used on other targets (not just the caster).

sp-08308.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Aura ofFear, except that radius is 50'.

sp-08309.description_en: As Spell Aura I, except that up to tenth level spells may be used.

sp-08310.description_en: As Aura, except that caster seems as a deity. Attacks against the caster are at -45.

sp-08398.description_en: Creates an ~\imple, immobile image or scene up to an area of I0'R

sp-08399.description_en: A single object is made invisible (l garment, I naked body, etc.); until 24 hours pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-08401.description_en: As Unseen/, except everything within I foot of target is invisible, barring terrain.

sp-08402.description_en: Lights a 50'R about the point touched. If the point isonamobileobjectorbeing, it will move with the object/being. See Section 7.1.17 (in Spell law).

sp-08404.description_en: As Light V, except radius is as dark night.

sp-08406.description_en: As Invisibility I, except radius is 10'.

sp-08407.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table (in Spell law).

sp-08408.description_en: As Light V, except radius is 100' and the light also nullifies all magically created darkness. Any magical darkness inside the radius will return when this spell expires.

sp-08409.description_en: As Dark V, except radius is 100' and no nonmagical light can exist inside. Any magical light inside the radius will return when this spell expires.

sp-08434.description_en: Caster stores the location of the node that he currently occupies (for use with other spells on this list).

sp-08435.description_en: Caster becomes aware of all animate activity within the boundaries of a node that he both occupies and has "stored" (see Store Node).

sp-08437.description_en: Caster is teleported to any place within the node he occupies.

sp-08438.description_en: As Node Summons V, except that ten levels are summoned.

sp-08439.description_en: The caster becomes aware of the direction of the nearest Node within one mile per level of the caster. This spell will not reveal a Minor Earthnode unless the caster has "stored" the node (see Store Node). If the caster has stored the node, he will also know the exact distance to the node.

sp-08440.description_en: Caster is aware of the specific triggers for any Node Ward spells currently active any node within range.

sp-08442.description_en: As Node Summons V above, but the total of levels is fifteen.

sp-08443.description_en: When the target's soul leaves its body, it will be interred into the node (the node may be any node "stored" by the caster) and will stay in the node for the duration of this spell. The interred soul will enter any "soulless" body brought into the node.

sp-08444.description_en: One sentient target becomes a "defender" for the specified node. Both the caster and the target must occupy the node at the time of caster. While acting as a defender, the target will make all RRs at the caster's level instead of his own. In addition, he will have+ 10 to all of his OBs, DB, and all maneuvers. For the duration of this spell, the target cannot leave the radius of the node.

sp-08445.description_en: As Node Ward: Alarm, exceptthe 'enemy' must make an RR (modified by -20) or flee in terror.

sp-08447.description_en: As Node Summons V, except twenty levels of animals are summoned.

sp-08448.description_en: Casteropens a 5' x 1O' doorway connecting two nodes. The nodes must be within 100 miles per level of the caster and both must be "stored" by the caster (with the Store Node spell). The doorway is two-way and anyone may pass through (so long as they can fit through the door). When the caster ceases to concentrate, the doorway will close. Any being caught in the gate when it closes takes an 'E' slash critical (see Anns Law) and is randomly sent to one end of the gate (flip a coin). Any severed limbs are automatically on the other side of the gate. Node gates must be formed as close to the center of a node as possible.

sp-08449.description_en: This spell prevents a node from moving. This spell ties the node to a "permanent" feature within the radius of the node. Permanent features include very large rocks, trees, etc. If the feature is moved, or if the feature is destroyed, this spell is cancelled.

sp-08450.description_en: As Node Defender, except so long as the target of this spell is within the node, he will not age and will recover(slowly) from any injury (the rule of thumb for recovery time for injuries is 1 day per 1 hit or I% penalty; severed or destroyed limbs and organs take longer). If the Guardian leaves the node, the spell is cancelled.

sp-08451.description_en: The caster takes all of the power of a node and converts it into a single, on-going spell effect. The effect is limited by the power of the node (minor nodes can only create up to I 0th level effects, major nodes can create up to 20th level effects). While this effect is active, the node can do nothing else (including any normal abilities the node may have) and cannot be the target of any node spells (and any spells that were previously targetted on the node are temporarily suspended while this spell is active).

sp-08492.description_en: Caster "stores" his current location for use with later spells on this list. A given caster can only store one location for every five levels of experience (or portion thereof). For example, a third level caster can only have one location stored, while a thirteenth level caster can have three.

sp-08493.description_en: Caster teleports to a location up to 10' per level away. There can be no intervening "barriers" in a direct line between the caster and the point. A "barrier" is defined as anything the target could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-08494.description_en: Target object becomes intangible. This object cannot be handled in any fashion. In addition, it is only partially visible (detected with an Awareness maneuver modified by the -30).

sp-08495.description_en: I-As SelfLeaving, except not limited to the caster and the target can be teleported up to 200' away.

sp-08496.description_en: Caster causes his body (but not all of his gear and clothing) to become intangible and only partially visible (detected with an Awareness maneuver modified by 30). Movement is limited to a walking pace, but not limited to a horizontal plane (caster must simply concentrate to walk on a vertical plane). Caster passes through normal solid barriers and is unable to pick up objects. All maneuvers while intangible are modified by -50.

sp-07388.description_en: Caster gains insight into target item's inherent power. If the item has PPs or charges, he will know exactly how many.

sp-07389.description_en: Caster bathes the area in magical energy, creating waves of magical resonance. All spells become visible (if the GM deems it appropriate, all Power Perception maneuvers are modified by +50 instead of all spells becoming visible).

sp-07390.description_en: Creates a wall of pure magical power(this wall is visible as a rippling wall of light). All coming into contact with the wall suffer a 'A' Mana critical. No spells can be cast through this wall (and no power can be detected through the wall).

sp-07391.description_en: I - Caster fires a blinding white beam of concentrated power from his palm. Bolt strikes on the Mana Bolt Attack Table. Mana Bolts add + 10 to all Spell Risk Rolls.

sp-07392.description_en: As Magelight I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07393.description_en: Caster imbues a mundane (non-magical) weapon with raw power. Strikes made with the weapon yield Mana criticals of one less severity to the normal Anns Law criticals. In addition, directed elemental attacks may be parried with the Eldritch Weapon at half effectiveness (2 points of OB giving 1 point of DB). When this spell expires, the weapon is automatically consumed (destroyed beyond use).

sp-07394.description_en: I - Caster creates an explosion of pure magical power. Those caught within the area are subjected to an attack on the Mana Ball Attack Table. Mana Balls add +20 to all Spell Risk Rolls.

sp-07395.description_en: As Mana Bolt I, except for the range.

sp-07396.description_en: Caster opens a channel between himself and the target. The target and the caster may freely exchange PPs. Note that neither the caster nor the target may exceed his normal maximum of PPs. When spell expires, the PPs remain exchanged.

sp-07397.description_en: As Mana Ball I, above, except for the area of effect.

sp-07398.description_en: As Eldritch Weapon, except weapon delivers Mana critical equal in severity to normal criticals.

sp-07399.description_en: As Mage light I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07400.description_en: As Mana Bolt I, except for the range.

sp-07401.description_en: The target of this spell regains half of his currently spent PPs. If the target has not spent any PPs, this spell has no effect on him. For example, if the target normally have SO PPs and has spent 20, he would be returned to 40 PPs (regaining 10). If that same caster had spent all of his PPs, he would be returned to 25 PPs (regaining 25).

sp-07402.description_en: Caster summons a sentient portion of his power source. The animate mana remains so long as the caster concentrates. The animated mana fights as a Weak Fire Elemental (except dealing Mana crits instead of Heat crits). The mana creature is immune to non-magical weapons. Elemental spells heal the number of hits that they would have inflicted to the construct, with criticals being ignored. If the caster ceases to concentrate, the mana creature vanishes in a bright flash. SO. Mana Pool - All spell users within the area of effect may share power points freely amongst themselves. PPs are totaled each round and all spell users may access all PPs in the pool. No spell user suffers penalties for PP expenditure until the pool is sufficiently drained (at which time, all spell users suffer the same penalties). No caster can regain PPs while they are in the area of effect of this spell (and the pool does not regain PPs). If a caster leaves the area, he loses all his normal PPs (as they are in the pool), though they may be regained normally.

sp-07423.description_en: Caster temporarily imbeds power into an item (which he may later tap as a source of power with a Tap Source spell). This item is known as a Store. The spell stores one PP per level of the caster into an item. The stored PPs must be expended at the time this spell is cast. Typically, the item must be specially constructed of crystalline stone. The stone must be at least one ouce (in weight) per PP to be stored. A given caster can only have one Store at a time.

sp-07424.description_en: [RR Mod: -30] When the caster concentrates he drains I PP per minute from the target. The target can be any target that has PPs (including anyone that currently has PPs). If the target fails his RR by more than 30, he does not even notice the effects of the spell. The spell is cancelled whenever the caster ceases to touch the target.

sp-07425.description_en: I-As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 3 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07426.description_en: As Power Storage/, except the Store is permanent (and can be recharged with Store spells). In addition, this spell can create a store out of any inorganic material (transforming the material into the proper crystalline structure). If a new Store is created by a given caster, any old stores are dispelled.

sp-07427.description_en: The caster charges a Store with 5 PPs per minute, as long as he concentrates. The PPs come from his personal reserve.

sp-07428.description_en: As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 5 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07429.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Drain Power/, except that the caster may drain 3 PPs per minute.

sp-07430.description_en: As Create Store/, except the Store may hold up to 3 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07431.description_en: As Store V, except that up to 10 PPs per minute may be stored.

sp-07432.description_en: As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 10 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07433.description_en: I- [RR Mod: -10] As Drain Power I, except that the caster may drain 1 PP per round.

sp-07434.description_en: As Create Store I, except Store may hold up to 5 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07435.description_en: As Store V, except that up to 20 PPs per minute may be stored.

sp-07436.description_en: As Drain Power I, except the caster may drain 2 PPs per round.

sp-07437.description_en: As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 20 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07438.description_en: As Store V, except that up 1 PP per level of the caster is transfered per minute.

sp-07439.description_en: As Create Store I, except the Store may hold up to 20 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07477.description_en: Detects any active ward; caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-07478.description_en: Caster gains understanding the nature of the target ward (including all things prohibited/protected by the ward).

sp-07479.description_en: The area of the spell is protected from intrusion by any normal creatures. Any creature above level 0 must make an RR (versus the level fo the caster) or they will not be able to enter the protected area.

sp-07482.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to two different spells.

sp-07484.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to three different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07485.description_en: As Alarm Ward I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07486.description_en: As Protected Site, except for the area of effect.

sp-07487.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to four different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07488.description_en: As Spell Ward/, except that caster may prevent up to five different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07489.description_en: As Scrying Ward I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07490.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to seven different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07491.description_en: As A farm Ward I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07492.description_en: As Repulsion Ward, except that caster may also specify a single sentient race that will receive an additional penalty of 20 to their RR (when they attempt to enter the protected area).

sp-07493.description_en: As Spell Ward/, except that caster may prevent up to ten different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07494.description_en: As Spell Ward/, except that all forms of magical transportation (leaping, leaving, long door, teleportation, returning, etc.) are prevented. Casters/beings attempting to enter or leave must make an RR (with a special -30 modifier) versus the level of the caster to actually enter or leave via magical methods.

sp-07496.description_en: The caster senses the presence of any Holy or Unholy objects in the area. Caster may concentrate on a different IO'R area each round.

sp-07497.description_en: When concentrating, the target gains the ability to see through plants as if they were nonexistent.

sp-07498.description_en: The caster creates a field of energy around the target. All spells cast will require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver. If the spell is a Channeling spell, there is an additional -10 penalty to the maneuver.

sp-07499.description_en: The target may not send or receive spells or power points for the duration.

sp-07500.description_en: The target suffers a 'B' Void critical each time he casts a spell. If the target fails his RR by more than 20, he is unaware that this spell has been cast upon him. If the target is casting a Channeling spell, he takes a 'C' Void critical.

sp-07501.description_en: The target believes he has fallen into disfavor with his lord, church, religion, god, etc .. No therapy will help this. The target will take irrational actions to regain favor.

sp-07502.description_en: All tracks and traces of passing within the area are eradicated.

sp-07503.description_en: All plant material within the area turns into a grey mush and falls to the ground. The grey mush is still fertile, however.

sp-07504.description_en: Target is without power points. The duration of this spell is 1 hour for targets who do not have Channeling as their realm; one day for Channeling targets.

sp-07505.description_en: Target is cured of one diagnosed or known disease (the caster must know the specific disease or this spell has no effect).

sp-07506.description_en: As Defoliation I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07507.description_en: One known curse is removed from target (the caster must know the specific curse or this spell has no effect).

sp-07508.description_en: All animals (of animal intelligence or lower) must make a RR or they will not enter area. Animals within the area when the spell is cast must make an RR each round or leave the area. Animal that are magically controlled receive a special +10 modifier to their RRs.

sp-07509.description_en: As Soul Poison I, except for the duration.

sp-07510.description_en: As Defoliation I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07511.description_en: Creates a false trail (length of I mile per level of the caster). A successful Read Tracks maneuver (with a -70 modfier) will reveal that the trail is false.

sp-07512.description_en: Target is unable to magical means of transportaion for the duration.

sp-07513.description_en: Target is plagued by extreme doubt of his faith. He will cease any combat immediately. A pilgrimage is sure to follow.

sp-07514.description_en: Caster may use the other spells on this list once per round.

sp-07516.description_en: One musical intrument becomes completely out of tune (-50 to all Play ... maneuvers). This spell can also be cast on a person's voice (with a duration of! round per 10% failure).

sp-07517.description_en: The target may see all persons rendered invisible.

sp-07518.description_en: The caster creates a field of energy around the target. All spells cast will require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver. If the spell cast is a Mentalism spell, there is an additioanl -10 penalty to this maneuver.

sp-07519.description_en: The target suffers a 'B' Void critical each time he casts a spell. If the caster fails his RR by more than 20, he is unaware that this spell has been cast upon him. If the target is casting a Mentalism spell, he takes a 'C' Void critical.

sp-07520.description_en: Target loses one magically stored bit of information. This can be any information that was stored with a Store ... spell (or any other similar spell).

sp-07521.description_en: Target suffers a -50 to all activities.

sp-07522.description_en: Target's disguise falls apart. This spell will even dispel a magical guise.

sp-07523.description_en: Target is without power points. The duration of this spell is l hour for targets who do not have Mentalism as their realm; one day for Mentalism targets.

sp-07524.description_en: As Mind Poison I, except for the duration.

sp-07525.description_en: Target is cured of any mental illnesses.

sp-07526.description_en: Target person is no longer attuned to one of his magic items. The caster must be touching either the magic item or the target person. If the caster is touching the target person and the target magic item, he receives a special modifier of -20 to his RR. If the caster is only touching the target person, one of the target's item at random is no longer attuned to the target person.

sp-07528.description_en: Caster may accurately discern the nature of any one target (ignoring all magical guises).

sp-07529.description_en: As Mind Poison I, except for the duration, and the target is subjected to 'D' severity criticals ('E' for Mentalism targets).

sp-07530.description_en: When the caster is attacked by any mental spell (a spell sub-type of "m"), the offender is drawn into the caster's mind and held for a while. The offender makes an RR (versus the level of the caster). He will be held for I hour per 10 failure (success indicates that offender avoids the trap). If drawn into the trap, the offender's body slumps lifelessly to the floor.

sp-07531.description_en: The caster may use each of the 25th and lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-07532.description_en: When the target of this spell is the target of a spell, the "incoming" spell must first make an RR. For RR purposes, the incoming spell uses its caster's level. If the incoming spell fails the RR, it has no effect on the target.

sp-07533.description_en: If the target attempts to cast a spell while this spell is active, that spell (and only that first spell) automatically takes one extra round before the effects are resolved. This has no effect on the preparation/casting time-the effect is simply delayed one round.

sp-07534.description_en: Any active spell within the area of effect must make an RR (use the level of that spell's caster as its level). If the RR fails, the spell is dispelled.

sp-07535.description_en: If the target attempts to cast a spell while this spell is active, that spell (and only that first spell) automatically makes a Spell Casting Static Maneuver with a -15 penalty.

sp-07536.description_en: The target's must make a Spell Casting Static Maneuever (ifhe is not already forced to make one) and rounds of preparation currently accrued are lost. This spell automatically stops a caster from concentrating on a spell that has a duration requiring concentration.

sp-07537.description_en: As Delay Spell I, except the effects are delayed for two rounds.

sp-07538.description_en: As Fumble/, except that the penalty is -30.

sp-07539.description_en: The caster's next spell has no perceptible effect (to normal senses or magical detections). Indirect effects will still be noticed. For example, if cast before a Fireball, the explosion is silent, invisible and will not be felt; but suddenly the vegetation will be burning and lots of damage will appear on the area.

sp-07540.description_en: The target forgets the spell that he most recently cast. He may not cast that spell again for the duration of this spell. All lower- and higher-level versions of the spell are also forgotten (e.g., Sleep V, Sleep X, etc.).

sp-07541.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target must make Spell Casting Static Maneuevers for all spells he wants to cast; each of these maneuvers suffers a -10 penalty.

sp-07542.description_en: For the duration of this spell, any information gathering spells cast on anything in the area will only discern what the caster specifies. The caster must specify exactly what will be learned (if left unspecific, the information spell will discern the truth). For example, if the caster specifies that his presence in the area will be masked, all information spells will reveal everything as normal, except the caster of this spell will not be revealed.

sp-07543.description_en: As Delay Spell I, excpet the effects are delayed for three rounds.

sp-07544.description_en: As Failure I, except that the penalty is -30.

sp-07545.description_en: As Dispel Magic I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07546.description_en: The caster may change the target spell into any spell of the same Type of lower level. The caster of the targetted spell is fully aware of the change and has full control over the spell (for durations, targets, etc.).

sp-07547.description_en: As Failure I, except that the penalty is -40.

sp-07548.description_en: Target magic item loses all magical abilities. Artifacts receive a special +30 bonus to their RR. All items use creator's level for item level in RR and add their inherent bonuses to the roll.

sp-07549.description_en: As Dispel Magic I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07550.description_en: As Disjunction, except that artifacts do not get the special bonus to their RR. Some very powerful items may still receive this bonus (GM's discretion).

sp-07551.description_en: As Failure I, except that the penalty is -50.

sp-07552.description_en: Caster may use the other spells on this list, once per round .

sp-07569.description_en: Causes the next spell that the target casts (must be within I minute of the completion of this spell) to have it's range increased by 50'.

sp-07570.description_en: Causes the next spell that the target casts (must be within I minute of the completion of this spell) to have it's duration tripled.

sp-07572.description_en: As Extend Range /, except that range is increased by 100'.

sp-07573.description_en: Causes the next spell that the target casts (must be within I minute of the completion of this spell) to have it's radius increased by 5'.

sp-07574.description_en: As Extend Duration Ill, except that duration is quadrupled (x4).

sp-07576.description_en: As Extend Range I, except that range is increased by 300'.

sp-07577.description_en: As Increase Radius I, except Radius is increased by 10'.

sp-07579.description_en: As Extend Range I, except that range is increased by 500'.

sp-07580.description_en: As Increase Radius I, except radius is increased by 15'.

sp-07581.description_en: As Extend Duration lll, except that duration is increased by ten times.

sp-07582.description_en: As Extend Range/, except that range is increased by 1,000' .

sp-07583.description_en: As Extend Range IV, except that this spell is instantaneous.

sp-07584.description_en: As Increase Radius/, except radius is increased by 20'.

sp-07585.description_en: As Increase Radius I, except radius is increased by 25'.

sp-07586.description_en: As Extend Duration Ill, except that duration is increased by 20 times.

sp-07587.description_en: As Extend Range I, except that range is increased by I 00' per level of the caster.

sp-07588.description_en: As Extend Duration Ill, except that duration is Permanent.

sp-07589.description_en: Everyone with 5' of the caster adds +5 to all their RRs.

sp-07590.description_en: Caster gains + 10 to RRs versus a specific element (chosen at time of casting) and 10 is subtracted from any elemental attack from that element (when the caster is the target of the attack).

sp-07591.description_en: As Protect I, except bonus is + 10.

sp-07593.description_en: As Resist Elements, except RR bonus is +20 and elemental attacks suffer a -20 penalty.

sp-07594.description_en: As Spell Shield I, except that two realms may be chosen.

sp-07595.description_en: As Protect/, except for the area of effect.

sp-07597.description_en: Caster gains protection from a specific realm of magic (chosen at the time of casting). All RRs versus spells of that realm are receive a bonus of +30.

sp-07598.description_en: I - As Element Shield /, except that all criticals are reduced by one severity ("D" becomes "C", "B" becomes "A", "A" subtracts 50 from the critical result, etc.) and all concussion damage is halved.

sp-07599.description_en: As Protect//, except for the area of effect.

sp-07601.description_en: As Realm Annor I, except that two realms may be chosen.

sp-07602.description_en: I As Element Annor I, except that two elements may be protected against. I 9. Protect Sphere III As Protect l/l, except for the area of effect.

sp-07604.description_en: As Spell Shield /, except that caster may shield up tp 1 target for each of his level.

sp-07605.description_en: As Realm Armor I, except that caster may protect up tp I target for each of his level.

sp-07606.description_en: As Realm Annor /, except that Bonus is +50.

sp-07607.description_en: As Realm Resistance // and Element Armor // simultaneously.

sp-07735.description_en: Allows the target to leap 50' laterally or 20' horizontally in the round that this spell is cast.

sp-07736.description_en: Allows the target to land safely after a fall up to 20' per level of the caster. The target may also take that distance off of the severity of a greater fall.

sp-07737.description_en: Caster teleports the target to a point up to 100' away. There can be no intervening "barriers" in a direct line between the target and the point. A "barrier" is defined as anything the target could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-07779.description_en: Caster can alter his form to the form of any desired humanoid race. The form cannot be a specific form. For example, a human caster could take on the form of a Dwarf, but not the Dwarven king. Only physical form is gained (e.g., the target who becomes a Dwarf would not recieve the Dwarves' ability to see in the dark). The caster can only alter his size by up to 25%. See Section 7.1.11 (in Spell Law).

sp-07780.description_en: A single piece of wood, ofup to JO cubic feet in volume, becomes as hard as granite.

sp-07781.description_en: One item (up to 5 cubic feet) becomes as brittle as thin glass. Treat as an item that must always check for breakage with a Strength factor of equal to a dJO.

sp-07782.description_en: As Reinforce Wood, except that a single stone (up to 10 cubic feet) becomes as hard as steel.

sp-07783.description_en: Caster may increase his mass by up to JO% per level of the caster (height in most situations); there is no increase in his strength (except for movement purposes). JO. Unbreakable-Oneobjectofno greater volume than I cubic foot is made unbreakable. Treat as having a Strength of 250.

sp-07785.description_en: As Change to Kind, except that the caster may change his form at will, by concentrating for one round per change.

sp-07786.description_en: As Reinforce Wood, except that a single iron or steel object (up to JO cubic feet) becomes unbreakable.

sp-07787.description_en: Caster creates a tunnel 6' radius by 10' long through any non-living, organic or inorganic mass.

sp-07788.description_en: As Enlarge, except that the mass change is 20% per level of the caster.

sp-07789.description_en: Caster causes up to I cubic foot per level of any nonmagical, non-living solid to melt. There is no increase in temperature, so the material will begin to solidify immediately after the duration of this spell expires. The melting takes 3 rounds.

sp-07791.description_en: Caster causes up to I cubic foot per level ofany normal liquid to boil. Liquid will continue to boil as long as the caster concentrates. The caster must be able to see the target liquid. Boiling takes 3 rounds. Caster is immune to damage from the boiling liquid.

sp-07793.description_en: As Impersonate, except that any mass may be gained up to 100% per level.

sp-07794.description_en: As Enlarge, except for the number of targets.

sp-07795.description_en: May transmute up to I ounce of any nonmagical substance to any other non-magical substance. This takes 8 hours of uninterrupted concentration.

sp-07797.description_en: Creates dense fog within the area.

sp-07798.description_en: The caster's hands become as hard as stone. Any attacks are made with Martial Arts 0B (using the most appropriate skill), but is resolved on the Mace Attack Table (see Arms law).

sp-07799.description_en: s - Caster creates an intense, directed updraft of air that can support a weight of up to 500 lbs. (so long as the weight is concentrated in the area of effect). The combination of height lifted times weight is always equal to 500. For example, a 100 pound man would be lifted 5 feet into the air; while a 500 pound object would be lifted I foot into the air; while a 2 pound object would be lifted 250 feet into the air.

sp-07800.description_en: Caster creates a wall of swirling hail I O' x I O' x 5' (deep). All coming into contact with the wall suffer a 'B' Impact critical. All movement through the wall is slowed by 75%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -75 penalty.

sp-07801.description_en: The caster raises one buried object from a depth

sp-07813.description_en: Caster adds 5 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-07814.description_en: II - Caster reads at a rate of 20 pages per minute.

sp-07815.description_en: Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity). See Section 7.1.24 in Spell Law for more information.

sp-07816.description_en: For the duration of this spell, any wounds that deliver stun effects to the caster have the number of rounds of stun reduced by one.

sp-07817.description_en: Casterreceives a special+ 15 bonus to his next static maneuver (the static maneuver must be completed before the duration of this spell expires).

sp-07818.description_en: In melee, the caster does double normal concussion hits and his Strength stat bonus is doubled.

sp-07819.description_en: As Haste I, except for the duration.

sp-07820.description_en: Caster adds 10 to his next initiative roll next round.

sp-07821.description_en: As Focus/, except the bonus is +30.

sp-07822.description_en: For the duration of this spell, all criticals against the caster are reduced by one in severity (e.g., "E" becomes a "D", "B" becomes an "A", with an "A" receiving a -50 modification).

sp-07823.description_en: As Haste I, except for the duration.

sp-07824.description_en: As Focus I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-07825.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a bonus of +50 to any RRs versus disease and poison.

sp-07826.description_en: As Haste I, except for the duration.

sp-07827.description_en: Caster is able to sustain and additional I 00% of his total concussion hits before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-07828.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's skin toughens, giving him an effective AT of 11.

sp-07829.description_en: As Focus I, except the bonus is +60.

sp-07830.description_en: Caster receives the bonuses of Toughness I, Toughness II, Toughness Ill, and Unpain simultaneously .

sp-07846.description_en: Target must answer a single concept question truthfully (presuming the target can understand the question).

sp-07847.description_en: Caster knows whether the target is lying or not.

sp-07848.description_en: Target humanoid believes that the caster is a good friend.

sp-07849.description_en: As Question, except that target must respond to up to 5 single concept questions.

sp-07850.description_en: Target will follow a single suggestion so long as it is not completely alien to him (no jumping off the bridge suggestions, no throwing yourself in front of runaway manure cart suggestions, etc).

sp-07851.description_en: The next spell the target attempts to cast requires a Spell Casting Static Maneuver (with a special -JO modifier).

sp-07852.description_en: As Question, except that target must respond to up to 10 single concept questions.

sp-07853.description_en: As Suggestion, except that two targets will receive the same suggestion. JO. Telepathy - Caster can read the surface thoughts of one target.

sp-07855.description_en: Target humanoid must obey caster. Commands must not be completely alien to the target.

sp-07856.description_en: As Question, except that target must respond to up to 20 single concept questions.

sp-07857.description_en: As Fumble Spell I, except affects the next three spells the target attempts to cast.

sp-07858.description_en: As Telepathy, except for the range.

sp-07859.description_en: The target forgets the spell that he most recently cast. He may not cast that spell again for the duration of this spell. All lower- and higher-level versions of the spell are also forgotten (e.g., Sleep V, Sleep X, etc.).

sp-07860.description_en: Caster may read target's conscious memories, at a rate of I scene per round.

sp-07862.description_en: Caster may read target's deep subconscious memories, at a rate of I scene per round.

sp-07863.description_en: As Mind Scan, except that the caster may scan a different target each round.

sp-07864.description_en: Caster may read a single memory from target's mind each round.

sp-07865.description_en: As Mind Probe, except that the caster may scan a different target each round. In addition, the number of scenes scanned per round is equal to the caster's level.

sp-07882.description_en: Caster gains +5 to all RRs versus spells of all realms.

sp-07883.description_en: Caster is totally protected against all natural heat (up to 200°F and modifies spells involving heat by 10.

sp-07884.description_en: As Resist Heat, except protects against natural cold to -20°F and modifies spells involving cold by 10.

sp-07885.description_en: Caster gains + 10 on RRs and DB versus all frontal spell attacks. The caster must be aware of the attack(s) to get the bonus.

sp-07887.description_en: Casteris able to parry any directed spell attack. He may gain a bonus of+ 1 DB for every 5 points of OB put into the parry. In addition, the caster can parry any spell that he would normally get an RR against (so long as the origin of the spell is more than 5' away from the caster). In this case, he may gain an RR bonus of + 1 for every 5 points of OB put into the parry.

sp-07890.description_en: Caster gains +20 to RRs and DB versus electricity-based attacks.

sp-07891.description_en: As Light Shield, except applies to heat/firebased attacks.

sp-07892.description_en: As Light Shield, except applies to cold-based attacks.

sp-07893.description_en: As Spell Parry I, except that the bonus is gained for every 3 points of OB.

sp-07894.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] The target spell is reversed back upon its caster. If necessary, the spell is treated as having a +O attack modification.

sp-07895.description_en: As Spell Parry I, except that the bonus is gained for every point of OB.

sp-07896.description_en: As any one of Heat Shield, Light Shield, or Cold Shield (chosen at the time of casting). In addition, any damage incurred from the selected element is halved and all criticals taken from the element are reduced by one in severity ("D" goes to a "C", with an "A" critical modified by -50).

sp-07897.description_en: As Reverse Spells, except for the duration. Any spells that target the caster are reflected back upon their origin.

sp-07898.description_en: As all three variants of Elemental Shield (heat, cold, and light) simultaneous. In addition, the caster gains a +20 bonus to all RRs versus those elements.

sp-07913.description_en: Caster determines the presence of any extradimensional entities within the area. A different area may be concentrated on each round. I 2. Origin of Entity - Caster learns the place of origin of the target entity and gets a vision of that place.

sp-07915.description_en: Allows the caster to totally control a Type I or Type II Entity (the chance of non-control is [the Entity's Type x 2%]). The Entity leaves when the caster stops concentrating. The Entity will not speak with the caster.

sp-07916.description_en: Caster summons a lesser Entity. Roll for random Type (01-55 Type I Entity; 56-90Type II Entity; 91-lOOType III Entity). The Entity forms over two rounds. Ifthe Entity is not mastered within 2 rounds, the caster suffers the effects as outline in Section 7 .1.31 of Spell law.

sp-07917.description_en: Caster enchants a Circle protecting him from Lesser Entities (no greater than Type II). Any Entity summoned from this list can be made to appear within or outside the Circle. Entities within the Circle may not leave the Circle while the caster is concentrating. Entities outside the Circle may not enter it while the caster is concentrating. Treat the edges of the Circle as a very specific Wall ofForce (creating an inpenatrable barrier between the caster and the Entity). The caster can cross the barrier freely (though why he would want to is not clear). The design of the Circle is very important and dictates the kind (race) of Entity is affected. Circles must be especially made for each race of Entity (demons, fire elementals, etc.) and will not affect any other kind of Entity. Only one Circle may be placed on each 40' x 40' area. The area must be flat and horizontal to the ground. Circles take some time to create (note that creating the Circle does not enchant it; this spell enchants an a Circle), depending upon the method of creation.

sp-07918.description_en: Caster may control any Type I Entity, regardless of its present state of control (mastered/controlled by another spell user, free, berserk, etc). The Entity will revert to its original state of control when the caster stops concentrating. If the Entity was being 'controlled' by another spellcaster and that caster is no longer concentrating, the original controller has three rounds to re-control the Entity or it will berserk. If the Entity was 'controlled' or 'mastered' by another spell user, the original controller may make an RR to prevent the seizure of control.

sp-07919.description_en: As Control Entity II, except that caster need not concentrate to control Entity. The chance of nonmastery is 5 times the Entity's type. The Entity will remain and obey the caster untilthe caster is killed or the Entity is outside the range limit or the caster releases him. A maximum of two Entities may be master at one time by one caster.

sp-07920.description_en: As Gate I, except that more powerful Entities may be summoned: 01-10 Type I; 11-20 Type II; 21-50 Type III; 51-90 Type IV; 91-100 Type V. JO. Seize Control II - As Seize Control I, except that the caster may seize control of a Type II Entity.

sp-07922.description_en: As Seize Control/ and Master Entity II, except that only a mastered Type I Entity may be seized.

sp-07923.description_en: As Circle/, except that up to Type IV Entities are affected.

sp-07924.description_en: As Control Entity II, except that up to a Type IV Entity may be controlled.

sp-07925.description_en: As Seize Control/, except that the caster may seize control of a Type III Entity.

sp-07926.description_en: As Master Entity II, except that up to a Type IV Entity may be mastered.

sp-07936.description_en: Target loses I PP per round.

sp-07937.description_en: Target loses I PP per round for as long as the caster concentrates. The caster is limited to 10% activity while concentrating on this spell.

sp-07938.description_en: Caster drains I PP per round from the target When this spell expires, the caster regains a number of PPs equal to the total drained from the target

sp-07939.description_en: As Lose Power I, except target loses 3 PPs.

sp-07940.description_en: As Leak Power I, except target loses 2 PPs per round.

sp-07941.description_en: As Transfer Power I, except that 2 PPs per round are lost (and transferred to the caster).

sp-07942.description_en: As Power Drain I, except target loses 3 PPs per round.

sp-07943.description_en: As Transfer Power I, except that 3 PPs per round are lost (and transferred to the caster).

sp-07944.description_en: As Lose Power I, except target loses 5 PPs.

sp-07945.description_en: As Transfer Power/, except that4 PPs per round are lost (and transferred to the caster).

sp-07946.description_en: As Leak Power I, except target loses 3 PPs per round.

sp-07947.description_en: As Power Drain/, except target loses 5 PPs per round.

sp-07948.description_en: As Transfer Power/, except that 5 PPs per round are lost (and transferred to the caster).

sp-07949.description_en: As Lose Power I, except target loses 10 PPs.

sp-07950.description_en: As Leak Power I, except target loses 4 PPs per round.

sp-07951.description_en: As Power Drain I, except target loses 10 PPs per round.

sp-07952.description_en: As Transfer Power I, except that 10 PPs per round are lost (and transferred to the caster).

sp-07953.description_en: As Power Drain I, except target loses 20 PPs per round.

sp-07954.description_en: As Leak Power I, except target loses 5 PPs per round.

sp-07955.description_en: Target loses a number of PPs equal to the caster's level.

sp-07957.description_en: Target rolls dlO0 (open-ended). Add the current number of corruption points the target has and subtract three times his SD bonus. If the result is over 100, the character has been converted to "evil." 1be GM should determine the ramifications of such an event.

sp-07958.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target will cast one spell per round. The spell must be a Force, Directed Elemental, or Ball Elemental spell. The target will cast the highest level he can without giving himself more than a -5 Spell Casting Static Maneuver modification (after including all bonuses and penalties; including the fixed modification of +50). If the target cannot cast a spell every round without incurring too much penalty, the target will start casting one spell as often as he can. If the target cannot cast any Force, Directed Elemental, or Ball Elemental spells, this spell has no effect.

sp-07960.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target will use spells for every possible application, rather than depend on skills or other characters. For example, he will cast Opening I instead of picking a lock.

sp-07961.description_en: The target power source (Earthnode, Ley-line, etc.) is temporarily corrupted. All power emanating from the source is condiered "evil" for the duration (with additional effects at the GM's discrection). Any power points drawn from this source will yield 10% of their number in corruption points. For example, if a spell user gains 10 PPs from a source, he will gain 1 corruption point.

sp-07962.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07963.description_en: As Magical Frenzy, except for the duration and target will attempt spells that do not incur a penalty ofless than -25.

sp-07964.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains 5 corruption points.

sp-07965.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07966.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains 7 corruption points.

sp-07967.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07968.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains 10 corruption points.

sp-07969.description_en: As Call of Darkness, except that yield is 20% (10 PPs = 2 corruption points).

sp-07970.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07971.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains a number of corruption points equal to the caster's level.

sp-07973.description_en: As Spook /, except for number of targets.

sp-07974.description_en: Target must make a Fear RR.

sp-07975.description_en: As Spook/, except for number of targets.

sp-07976.description_en: Creates a 'Cold Spot,' a region of uneasiness and mild fear. Anyone entering the area must make a Fear RR (with a + I O modifier).

sp-07977.description_en: As Fear, except that caster may gaze at one target per round.

sp-07978.description_en: As Fear, except for the duration. In addition, if the target fails his Fear RR, that the target will not attempt to attack the caster for I day/10% failuer.

sp-07979.description_en: Target has a fear of a specific type of thing that the caster chooses. The target has a 25% (modified by three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintaining control around the subject. If the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll dlOO (not open-ended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result ofOl-25 results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it). A result of 26 or more results in the target avoiding the subject at all costs.

sp-07980.description_en: As Fear, except that this spell is instantaneous.

sp-07981.description_en: As Fear, except for the number of targets.

sp-07982.description_en: As Spook /, except for the number of targets.

sp-07984.description_en: As Terror, except for the number of targets.

sp-07986.description_en: Target believes that everyone is out to get him (including his close associates).

sp-07988.description_en: As Fear, except for the number of targets.

sp-07989.description_en: As Word of Fear, except for the area of effect.

sp-07990.description_en: All within the area are panicked. They will run about screaming and generally doing more harm than good.

sp-07991.description_en: Caster may use any of the lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-00404.description_en: Caster determines the realm, element and spell classification of target spell.

sp-00405.description_en: Caster channels elemental energy from his Main Element at target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 2nd level class “E” spell from the caster's Source Element. Caster must make a successful Directed Spells maneuver (i.e., make an attack against the caster of the target spell using the appropriate elemental attack table). If the attack is successful (delivers hits) then the maneuver succeeds in countering the spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. Target spell receives no RR.

sp-00406.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects any element within the caster's elemental Triad.

sp-00407.description_en: Drains power from a spell of the caster's main element. For every 10% failure spell is reduced by one level. If spell level is reduced to 0 then the spell is cancelled. Otherwise the effect of the spell is reduced accordingly (GM's discretion). For most spells, this would reduce the caster's level for RRs, spell duration, etc.… Caster gains 1 PP for every 2 levels by which the spell is reduced.

sp-00408.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects up to 5th level spells.

sp-00409.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects spells from the elements not of the caster's triad.

sp-00410.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 5th level spells can be affected.

sp-00411.description_en: Converts a spell of the caster's Source Element to change its elemental make-up to that of the caster's Main Element. Effects are up to the GM.

sp-00412.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects 7th level spells.

sp-00413.description_en: As Counter Element II, except up to 5th level spells can be affected.

sp-00414.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 7th level spells can be affected.

sp-00415.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Power Drain I, except spell level is reduced by 1 for every 5% failure.

sp-00416.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects 10th level spells.

sp-00417.description_en: As Counter Element II, except up to 7th level spells can be affected.

sp-00418.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 10th level spells can be affected.

sp-00419.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Power Drain I, except spell level is reduced by 2 for every 5% failure.

sp-00420.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects 15th level spells.

sp-00421.description_en: Allows the caster to store a Counter Spell from this list. Spell is activated when the first spell of the appropriate type targets or affects the caster. No other spells from this list may be cast while this spell is active; doing so dissipates this spell. If a Counter Element spell is used the caster must specify the Element that this spell is waiting for.

sp-00422.description_en: As Counter Element II, except up to 10th level spells can be affected.

sp-00423.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 15th level spells can be affected.

sp-00424.description_en: As Counter Source II, except any level of spell may be affected. PP's spent on this spell must be greater than or equal to the spell to be countered. Increasing Power Points increases the level of this spell. Adjust the spell casting rolls accordingly.

sp-00425.description_en: As Counter Element II, except that up to 15th level spells can be affected.

sp-00426.description_en: As Counter Source True, except this spell may be used to cancel spells from any element in the casters triad. This spell must be 3 levels higher than the spell to be cancelled or it fails.

sp-00427.description_en: Target is protected from all natural (Mundane) forms of caster's main element; additionally target gets +20 to Resistance Rolls (RR's) against the caster's Main Element; and elemental attacks from the caster's main element are at -20. These bonuses apply against Magical, High, and True forms of the caster's main element. This spell only works against attacks from the caster's Main Element (Fire, for a Fire Specialist; Ice, for an Ice Specialists, etc.)

sp-00428.description_en: One elemental “bolt” spell within range is deviated from its course. This causes 20 to be subtracted from the attack roll.

sp-00429.description_en: As Main Armor I except it works against any one element in the caster's triad. The element that this spell protects against must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-00430.description_en: As Main Armor I except all beings within 10'R of the target are protected.

sp-00431.description_en: As Main Armor I, except it works against any one element. The element that this spell protects against must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-00432.description_en: Caster uses elemental force to contain that of an elemental attack like a ball, cone or other area effect. This blunts the energy. It doesn't negate it. Target spell's attack rolls are modified by —20, if applicable. Alternately, any targets gain a +20 RR vs. the spell's effects, or any critical delivered is reduced by one degree of severity.

sp-00433.description_en: As Main Armor I, except it also decreases concussion hit damage from the caster's Main element by half, and decreases critical strikes by one level (e.g. 'A's become 'A'25, 'B's become 'A's, 'C's become 'B's, etc.)

sp-00434.description_en: As Main Armor I, except it works against all three elements of the caster's triad.

sp-00435.description_en: As Triad Armor I, except all beings within 10' R of the target are protected.

sp-00436.description_en: As Turn Element, except the spell course deviation is more severe, causing 50 to be subtracted from the attack roll.

sp-00437.description_en: As Minor Containment except containing energy is more powerful causing 35 to be subtracted from the attack roll.

sp-00438.description_en: As Main Armor II except it affects any one element in the caster's triad, element affected is chosen at time of casting.

sp-00439.description_en: As Elemental Armor I, except all beings within 10' R of the target are protected.

sp-00440.description_en: Target is made completely immune to elemental attacks from the caster's Main Element. This applies to Mundane, Magical, and High Elemental Material. Target only receives a +50 DB/RR modifier against True Elemental Material.

sp-00441.description_en: As Deflect Element, except the spell's course deviation is more severe, causing 75 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-00442.description_en: As Main Armor II, except it affects any one element. Element affected is chosen at time of casting.

sp-00443.description_en: As Prismatic Armor I, except it affects everyone within a 10'R of the target.

sp-00444.description_en: As Main Armor II, except it works against all three elements of the caster's triad.

sp-00445.description_en: As Main Immunity, except it works against any one element from the caster's triad. Element must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-00446.description_en: As Minor Containment except the containing energy is more powerful causing 50 to be subtracted from the attack roll.

sp-00447.description_en: As Triad Immunity, except as many targets as the caster's level may be affected.

sp-00381.description_en: Target is buffeted by focused strong winds. All actions made by target are at -30.

sp-00382.description_en: A dust devil forms in front of the caster and races towards target. Those in the path of the dust devil have a 50% chance of getting hit. Target and those who get in its path must resist or take a 'B' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00383.description_en: Strong winds flow from the caster's arm, striking target. Resolve attack on the Airbolt Table.

sp-00384.description_en: Caster envelops target with bands of force, which immobilizes target. Target can make a Very Hard Strength maneuver every round to act normally, otherwise they are at 20% activity. One man-sized target can be bound for every five levels of the caster. Caster must concentrate.

sp-00385.description_en: As Dust Devil I, except 'C' Unbalancing criticals are delivered.

sp-00386.description_en: Target can walk on air as if it was solid ground. This spell only allows for horizontal movement; vertical movement must be achieved by other means.

sp-00387.description_en: A bolt of force is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Force Bolt table.

sp-00388.description_en: Caster summons a 20 foot radius intense burst of air on target point. Results are determined on the Cold Ball table delivering Unbalancing criticals instead of Cold criticals.

sp-00389.description_en: Creates a clear wall of force. All attacks through the wall are at -100. No being can pass through the wall unless they make a Very Hard maneuver modified by strength. Wall is a manifestation of High Elemental Air. Air based beings, attacks and spells are only at -50 and it is only a Hard maneuver to go through the wall.

sp-00391.description_en: Caster creates a five-foot radius disk of force. Disk can move up to 100 feet per round in any direction, if the caster concentrates. When caster stops concentrating the disk stops moving.

sp-00392.description_en: A bolt of High Elemental Air is fired from the caster's palm, results are resolved on the Huge Bash Attack Table.

sp-00393.description_en: Creates a shimmering field of force 1' around the caster. If caster concentrates this spell increases his defensive bonus 100 versus all physical and elemental attacks. If caster ceases concentrating then the defensive bonus is only 20.

sp-00394.description_en: As Dust Devil I, except target takes a 'E' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00395.description_en: I— As Force Wall, except for duration.

sp-00396.description_en: Creates a clear dome of force. Dome has a ten-foot radius and completely encloses area. Treat the effects of the dome as a Force Wall.

sp-00397.description_en: As Force Wall, except for duration.

sp-00398.description_en: Target item is surrounded by a 1' radius sphere of force. Item can only be seen and not touched for the duration. Item must fit inside of the sphere or the spell fails.

sp-00399.description_en: As Force Binding, except targets that are constrained take an 'A' Krush critical each round.

sp-00400.description_en: As Air Walking, except it affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-00401.description_en: A cone of vibrating force erupts from the caster's palm. Cone is 100 feet long and 10 feet wide at its base. Resolve attack on the Fireball Table delivering Impact criticals instead of the normal Heat criticals.

sp-00402.description_en: Creates a shimmering field of force 1' around the target. If caster concentrates this spell increases target's defensive bonus 150 versus all physical and elemental attacks.. If caster ceases concentrating then the defensive bonus is only 50.

sp-00403.description_en: As Force Field II, except caster need not concentrate to get the full benefit of the spell.

sp-00494.description_en: Caster is aware of gravity and magnetic fields in the area of effect.

sp-00495.description_en: The target can levitate up to 10' per round in any direction up or down. This is caused by the nullification of gravity around the target.

sp-00496.description_en: Caster can magnetize or demagnetize up to 1 lb. per level of ferric material. Force of attraction/repulsion strength can be varied up to 1 point per 3 levels. This requires a strength bonus equal to the magnetic strength to force a ferric object away from the magnetized object or to push it in to the magnetized object. If a repulsive magnetic force is cast on a ferric shield, ferric weapons will be at -1 penalty per 3 levels of the caster, to attacks on the bearer of shield with a weapon. If cast on a weapon, it provides a +1 bonus per 3 levels when striking ferric targets.

sp-00497.description_en: Caster is surrounded with an aura of fluctuating magnetic energies. Ferric weapons are at -10 to hit the caster while the field is in effect.

sp-00498.description_en: Up to 1 cu ft/level of material is made immune to the effects of gravity. Object may be moved as if it has no weight. Inertia is constant for object; once force is applied in one direction it will keep moving that direction until an equal but opposing force is applied to the object (or they drift to a halt from wind resistance).

sp-00500.description_en: An intense magnetic field warps one ferric object. The penalty to use the item is equal to the amount by which it failed its resistance roll.

sp-00501.description_en: Target is struck with intense gravitational forces, receiving a 'C' Krush critical if they fail to resist.

sp-00502.description_en: All of those who are within 10' of a point specified by the caster are under the effect of a high gravitational field. All actions in area are reduced by 25%, exhaustion point expenditure is doubled and fumble ranges for physical activities are tripled.

sp-00503.description_en: As Zero G, except there is no inertia. Item will stop moving once force is no longer applied to it.

sp-00504.description_en: Can move one ferric object, up to 1 pound per level in mass, up to 1' per second (with no acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell of equal weight limit cast upon it.

sp-00505.description_en: All who are within 10' of a point specified by caster take an 'A' unbalancing critical if they try to do any sudden movements like combat, running, etc. All Climbing maneuvers are at +25.

sp-00507.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] All in the area of effect are under the effect of intense Gravitational forces. All within area must resist or take an 'A' Krush critical and a 'C' Unbalancing critical each round. Targets will suffer from this 1 round per 10% failure.

sp-00508.description_en: All of those within 10' of a point specified by the caster must resist or begin falling upward for one round per 10% failure. At the end of the duration targets are under the effect of normal gravity and will begin falling if not prevented from doing so.

sp-00509.description_en: As Magnetic Shield I, except shield is more powerful giving a +30 DB against Melee weapons and +40 vs Missile weapons. This will also subtract 10 from any ferric weapons or earth based attacks trying to attack the caster no matter which angle they attack from.

sp-00510.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] A 100' long conical force of magnetism is released from the caster's palm, with an end 10' R in size. Those wearing ferric armor must make a Resistance Roll or get thrown back a number of feet equal to the percentage that they failed to resist by. Targets take an 'A' Impact crit for every 50' moved. Those with ferric weapons must resist or have them ripped violently out of their grip.

sp-00511.description_en: As Warp Metal, except if item fails to resist it is broken.

sp-00512.description_en: As Barrier II, except radius is 20'.

sp-00513.description_en: All within AOE is under the effect of an intense gravity field. All actions are reduced by 50%. Fumble ranges and exhaustion points expenditures are quadrupled while in this area.

sp-00514.description_en: As Reverse Gravity except radius is 20'.

sp-00515.description_en: Caster is surrounded by a globe of magnetism extending up to 10'R. All elemental attacks directed at those within the radius are at -50 unless the attack is made of air. All missiles are at -75 and melee weapons must resist or break as if they were under the effects of a Barrier I spell.

sp-00516.description_en: Caster directs intense gravitational forces at target causing target to either explode or implode. If resistance roll is made target takes a 'D' Krush critical. Explosion will spread the target's body over a 50' radius, Imploding turns them into a pool of jelly. Get some toast.

sp-00540.description_en: Caster's hand is enveloped by flame for the duration. If caster touches something, it will cause the flame to leap to the item touched. This ignites any combustibles and can deliver an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-00541.description_en: A small narrow flame erupts from the caster's hand. This can be used to cauterize a bleeding wound of up to 5 hits of bleeding per round. This is not painless, however, causing 2 hits per point of bleeding stopped by this spell. Target will have a bad scar where the wound is.

sp-00542.description_en: An arc of fire is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-00543.description_en: Caster causes the next fire spell that he casts to be a spell of heat, effectively becoming invisible. Stationary spells are hard to detect (-20) and may inadvertently be walked into. Additionally, a directed spell that is under the effect of this spell, negates up 20 of the target's defensive bonus from Quickness.

sp-00544.description_en: Caster causes a 10'x10' surface to be on fire. Those stepping on the surface take an 'A' heat critical. Surfaces need not be flat. Flames only reach 6 inches above the floor.

sp-00545.description_en: A sheet of fire is shot from the caster's hands spreading out in a fan shape. Fan is 1' at its base, 5' long, and 5' wide at its ending. All caught in the area of the fan take an attack on the Fireball table.

sp-00546.description_en: As Fire Arc except the energy is invisible heat, causing only a shimmering to be seen as it strikes. This negates up to 20 of the target's defensive bonus from Quickness.

sp-00547.description_en: A wall of invisible heat (up to 10' x 10' x 6"). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Heat critical. This wall is Very Hard (-20) to notice.

sp-00548.description_en: Flames flare out from caster's body. All within 5' of caster take an attack on the Fireball Table.

sp-00549.description_en: Two 1' diameter balls are shot from palm of the caster. These can be targeted independently of each other (within range). When each ball strikes their target they explode in a 5' radius ball of fire. Results of each ball are determined on the Fireball Table.

sp-00550.description_en: A shimmering beam of heat hits target. Attack is resolved on the Fire Bolt Table. This negates up to 20 of the target's defensive bonus from Quickness.

sp-00551.description_en: A cone of fire is shot from the caster's palm. Cone is 50' long and has a 5' R width at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00552.description_en: As Wall of Heat, except it creates a cube of flame (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical

sp-00553.description_en: A shimmering 1" nearly invisible globe shoots from the caster's hand exploding in a Heat Ball. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10' R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00554.description_en: As Fire Strike I, except balls have a 10' radius.

sp-00555.description_en: All within 5' of caster take a 'B' Heat crit. Anyone touching gives a 'D' Heat critical. Caster must concentrate to maintain spell. Caster is also immune to flame (including Magical and High Elemental Material, but not True Elemental Material) while this spell is in effect.

sp-00556.description_en: As Cone of Fire I, except cone is effectively invisible.

sp-00557.description_en: As Wall of Heat, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster). Wall is not visible.

sp-00558.description_en: As Cone of Fire I, except cone is 100' long and has a 10' R width at its full extent.

sp-00559.description_en: As Fire Strike II, except three balls of fire are created.

sp-00560.description_en: As Heat Cone I, except cone is 100' long and has a 10'R width at it's full extent.

sp-00561.description_en: As Fire Strike II, except four balls of fire are created.

sp-00562.description_en: a 5'R ball of fire is created before the caster, this ball can be directed to move at 150'/round when the caster concentrates. Those struck by the ball take an attack on the Fireball table at +10.

sp-00586.description_en: Caster knows the exact temperature of the area within 10 feet.

sp-00587.description_en: Targets limbs are numbed. Loss of feeling causes a penalty of -20 to all actions.

sp-00588.description_en: An arc of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Cold Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-00589.description_en: Temperature within the radius is reduced by up to one degree per level of the caster.

sp-00590.description_en: A bolt of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Icebolt table delivering Cold criticals.

sp-00591.description_en: Target object (within size limits) is freeze-dried. Target will stay well preserved if protected from the elements. Effects of this spell are up to the GM. This spell can be used to prevent further deterioration of dead bodies.

sp-00592.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] This awful spell attempts to completely freeze the target's body. If the target fails its RR by 1-10, they take an 'A' Cold critical; by 11-20, they take a 'B' Cold critical; by 21-30, they take a 'C' Cold critical; by 31-40, they take a 'D' Cold critical; by 41-74, they take a 'E' Cold critical. If they fail by more than 75 they are dead (frozen to a solid block).

sp-00593.description_en: Cold is summoned to the area of effect. All moisture in the area is turned to frost. Plants that are in the area for more than 10 rounds suffer the effects of natural frost . Fog cannot exist in the area of this spell (turned to frost). The ambient temperature is reduced to 0° Fahrenheit in the area of effect.

sp-00594.description_en: A cone of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Cone is 50' long and is 10' wide at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Cold Ball Table.

sp-00595.description_en: As Cold Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00596.description_en: As Freeze I except it affects two targets.

sp-00597.description_en: Target is placed into a stabilized hypothermic state. All injuries that occur over a period of time are reduced to a point where they happen at 10 times the normal duration (i.e. if someone is to die in 12 rounds and this spell is cast on them, they will die in 120 rounds). Target is at -90 to all actions while in this hypothermic state.

sp-00598.description_en: Target weapon is surrounded by an aura of cold. All attacks delivered by the weapon deliver a Cold critical of equal severity to the normal critical.

sp-00599.description_en: Multiple blasts of cold race from caster's palm towards target. First blast is resolved on the Firebolt Table delivering Cold criticals, the second is resolved on the Waterbolt Table delivering Cold criticals, and the third on the Shockbolt Table delivering Cold criticals. The caster's Directed Spells are used on all three attacks. All attacks occur in the same round.

sp-00600.description_en: As Cold Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-00601.description_en: As Numbing, except it affects one target per level.

sp-00602.description_en: As Cone of Cold I, except cone is 100' long by 10' wide at its full extent.

sp-00603.description_en: Target is surrounded by swirling frost and cold. All within 5' of the target take an 'A' Cold critical. Anyone touching the target takes a 'C' Cold critical.

sp-00604.description_en: As Freeze I, except it affects five targets.

sp-00605.description_en: Target's extremities are frostbitten if RR is failed. Target is at -5 and bleeds at 1 hit per round for every 5% failure.

sp-00606.description_en: As Cone of Cold I, except cone is 150' long and 15' wide at its full extent.

sp-00607.description_en: As Hypothermia, except this affects one target per level.

sp-00608.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's body is completely frozen; all cells burst from the damage. When thawed target is a gelatinous pulp. Target must have every part of his body healed if there is any hope to raise him from the dead.

sp-00632.description_en: Detects any magically occurring shadows or darkness.

sp-00633.description_en: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See of Essence, section 15.12.

sp-00634.description_en: Creates a wall of absolute darkness (up to 10'x10'x1'). This wall prevents all light from passing through its surface; nothing can see through the wall and light-based attacks cannot penetrate.

sp-00635.description_en: Frequency and depth of shadows increase for the duration. All stalk and hide attempts in the area are at +20 for the duration.

sp-00636.description_en: Target's shadow is no longer visible. This helps prevent detection while invisible giving another -20 modifier to detect through normal means (spells always work). Target gains a special +10 bonus to Stalking and Ambush while this spell is in effect.

sp-00637.description_en: Everything within 1' radius of target is invisible as long as it stays within 1' of the original target and none of the termination conditions for the unseen spell occur.

sp-00638.description_en: Causes a 10' R burst of intense dark. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5% failure.

sp-00639.description_en: As Wall of Darkness, except duration is 1 round per level.

sp-00640.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.
