sp-00641.description_en: Natural shadows vibrate and change hue for the duration. This will confuse any shadow-based sneaking spell causing any bonuses from the spell to be negated. Also, within this area all Stalking and Hiding attempts are at -20.

sp-00642.description_en: As Invisibility I, except the radius can vary up to 1' (chosen at the time of casting). This makes the invisible target harder to see.

sp-00643.description_en: As Nightvision, except it affects one target per level.

sp-00644.description_en: Caster can see the flow of light and discern its various colors and spectrums. By concentrating caster can sift through magical and non-magical light. Illusions can be perceived and invisible creatures are discernable. It also gives a +25 to locate hidden objects

sp-00646.description_en: As Sudden Dark I, except the radius is 50'.

sp-00647.description_en: Caster can transform his shadow into a shadow spy. A Shadow Spy will follow any moderately simple instructions the caster gives (e.g., follow that man, go to the center of town, look in the next room). It moves at a rate of 100' and cannot move through solid objects (though they can fit through small openings.) They cannot affect any solid object. If the Shadow Spy has not returned at the end of the spell's duration, it will begin traveling at the rate of 500' per round to return to the caster. When the Shadow Spy returns the caster sees everything that the Shadow Spy witnessed. While the caster is “reliving” what the spy saw, he is in a trance-like state. As long as the caster's shadow is spying, he will have no mundane shadow.

sp-00648.description_en: As Shadow Spy, except that shadow may interact with the environment and has the following combat statistics: AT4; DB [half the caster's], Hits [half the caster's], Melee Attack [half the caster's best OB]. The shadow warrior can only be affected by magical attacks. If destroyed, the caster takes 50% of his remaining hits and the caster's shadow will not return for 1 week.

sp-00649.description_en: As Shadow Servant, except the Shadow also has half of the caster's PP's (the PPs he has remaining after casting this spell). The Shadow can cast spells from any one list that the caster knows (the list is designated when the spell is cast.)

sp-00650.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Target shadow (either a Shadow creature or Shadow Spy, Shadow Servant, or Shadow Mage ) is banished to the elemental plane of Light, painfully ripping it from the target's body (if from a spell caster.) Shadow creatures that are banished this way may not return and may be slain (GM discretion.) A shadow from one of the spells on this list will be gone for 1 day per 10% failure. During that time the caster does not have a shadow and may not cast the Shadow Spy, Shadow Servant, or Shadow Mage, spells. Additionally, target loses 25% of their remaining hits and 25% of their remaining power points in addition to other penalties provided by the Shadow spell's desciption.

sp-00651.description_en: Caster creates an area of absolute darkness; all existing light sources are immediately extinguished (even Utterlight.) Any light sources that are introduced after the first round of the spell will not function, except Utterlight, which will have half of its normal radius.

sp-00652.description_en: True— As Invisibility I, except if target attacks, they are visible for one round then they become invisible again.

sp-00699.description_en: Creates a small area of steam. Contact with steam will cause an 'A' heat critical. Generally used to cook crustaceans and sterilize goods.

sp-00700.description_en: Target in a body of water is transported up to 10' per level of the caster, within that body of water. Water must be at least 6" deep at both locations. This spell fails if the target is not in sufficient water. If destination isn't deep enough, target is transported to the closest point to the destination, within the body of water.

sp-00701.description_en: Caster can move his Hearing sense up and down one body of water, within range of the spell. Point of hearing is 6 inches above the water.

sp-00702.description_en: Caster is aware of all creatures/beings within one body of water as long as they are in range of this spell. Approximate location is known as well. (Fishermen pay handsomely for this spell).

sp-00703.description_en: One small wooden vessel (canoe, rowboat, etc.) and all of its contents/passengers are moved up to 10' per level of the caster, within the same body of water.

sp-00704.description_en: Allows caster to completely ignore sounds of natural water (e.g., like lapping waves, but not splashing by creatures or oars in the water). Very useful for the Listening spell.

sp-00705.description_en: A small portal is opened in the body of water (half of it is above water and half is below). When designated

sp-03996.description_en: As Aggression I, except bonus is +20.

sp-03997.description_en: Target Elemental's energy is intensified. All attacks deal double damage, including breath weapons but not spells. If this spell is cast on a non-elemental, then only breath weapons would be affected. For example, if this was cast on a Zephyr Hound, its breath weapon would do double damage but its melee attacks would remain unaffected.

sp-03998.description_en: As Haste I, except the duration is 3 rounds, split among 1 to 3 targets (in any combination.)

sp-03999.description_en: As Quickness I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04000.description_en: Allows the next spell cast from this list, that is 7th level or lower, to affect one target per level of the caster.

sp-04001.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 5 rounds, split among 1 to 5 targets (in any combination.)

sp-04002.description_en: As Aggression I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04003.description_en: All of the target's attacks deal double-damage, even breath weapons. Spells remain unaffected.

sp-04004.description_en: As Quickness II, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04005.description_en: Allows the next spell cast from this list to last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-04006.description_en: As Mass Enhancement I, except it will work with any spell on this list 20th level or lower.

sp-04007.description_en: Target is under the effects of Battle Awareness, Reactions I, Peripheral Vision, Aggression III, Quickness III, and Empower for the duration.

sp-04008.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small elemental (of animal intelligence) to serve as his familiar. Creature can be no more than 10% of the caster's own mass and the caster must cast this spell on the creature once per day for 1 week (concentrating on it two hours per day.) The caster must then choose one of two options: the caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). Alternatively, creature can act as a +1 spell adder to the caster gaining a +1 for every 10 levels of the caster. If the first option is chosen then if the creature is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks. If the second option is chosen, then the caster will be at half power points for 2 weeks.

sp-04009.description_en: Allows caster total control of a Type I Elemental. When caster stops concentrating the elemental will either return to its normal plane of existence or attack the summoner (equal chance of either.) Alternatively, instead of controlling the elemental, the caster can force it to flee for 1 round per level of the caster. Option must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-04010.description_en: Allows the caster to open a gate to the elemental plane of his choice. Gate forms over the course of three rounds. After gate forms an elemental will come through the gate and will stay for three rounds. If the elemental is not controlled or mastered within three rounds, the elemental will return through the gate or will attack the summoner (equal chance of either). Gate is attuned to drawing in the weakest of elementals (Type I), however it won't prevent a stronger one from coming through. Roll randomly to determine the type of elemental that comes through the gate: 01-75, Type I Elemental; 76-90, Type II Elemental; 91-100, Type III Elemental.

sp-04011.description_en: As Control Elemental I, except caster need not concentrate to control the elemental. The elemental will remain and obey the caster until the caster is killed, the elemental is outside the range limit, or the elemental is killed. If the elemental is ever freed from this bond, it will either return to its normal plane of existence or attack the summoner (equal chance of either).

sp-04012.description_en: As Control Elemental I, except it affects Type I or Type II Elementals.

sp-04013.description_en: For the duration caster can speak to elementals of one Elemental Source (Fire, Water, Earth, etc.). Caster must choose the type of elemental at the time of casting. Casting of this spell does not ensure that the elemental is friendly, just that the caster can speak to him.

sp-04014.description_en: As Master Elemental I, except it affects Type I or Type II Elementals.

sp-04015.description_en: As Elemental Gate I, except gate is attuned to pulling in Type II Elementals, however it won't prevent a

sp-04016.description_en: As Control Type I, except it affects Type I, II, or III Elementals.

sp-04017.description_en: As Control Type I, except it affects Type I, II, III, or IV Elementals.

sp-04018.description_en: As Master Type I, except it affects Type I, II or III Elementals.

sp-04019.description_en: As Elemental Gate I, except gate is attuned to pulling in Type III Elementals, however it won't prevent a weaker or stronger elemental from coming through the gate. Roll randomly to determine the type of elemental that comes through the gate: 01-05, Type I Elemental; 06-10, Type II Elemental; 11-75, Type III Elemental; 76-90, Type IV Elemental; 91-100, Type V Elemental.

sp-04020.description_en: As Master Type I, except it affects Type I - IV Elementals. If cast on a Type V Elemental, effect only lasts 1 hour per level.

sp-04021.description_en: As Elemental Gate I, except caster can specify type of Elemental (I-V) and the specific elemental summoned. GM's may allow Priests to summon Avatars of their Deity with this spell, though the caster must be in very good graces with his Deity to do so.

sp-04044.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any bodily damage, including the tools and methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-04045.description_en: Allows to caster to repair (not replace) 1 sprain; recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-04046.description_en: Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters, joint damage, etc.) Recovery time is one day.

sp-04047.description_en: Allows caster to repair (not replace) 1 damaged muscle, recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-04048.description_en: Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time is one day.

sp-04049.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor damage to 1 nerve; there is no recovery time. Minor damage is any damage that results in penalties up to -20.

sp-04050.description_en: Allows caster to repair one damaged tendon; recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-04051.description_en: As Minor Fracture Repair, except that the caster can repair compound fractures. Recovery time is one day.

sp-04052.description_en: Allows caster to repair one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered area). Recovery time is 1-10 days (depending on the damage.)

sp-04053.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except it will heal any nerve damage.

sp-04054.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

sp-04055.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

sp-04056.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

sp-04057.description_en: Caster can repair any eye damage short of total eye loss (e.g., eye's destruction precludes repair); recovery time: 1-10 days.

sp-04058.description_en: Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered joint). Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-04059.description_en: Caster can cure any 1 paralysis problem.

sp-04060.description_en: Allows caster to repair any internal or external organ damage (not including the brain or nervous system); requires a 1-10 hour operation and 1-10 day recovery time.

sp-04061.description_en: Allows caster to reattach limb. As long as all four Preservation spells have been cast on the limb this spell succeeds. Otherwise this spell fails. If successful, limb is fully functional in 1-10 days.

sp-04062.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor brain damage (including recovery from coma); note that experience lost is not restored (% lost permanently dependent on severity of damage); requires a 1 hour operation; recover time: 1-10 days.

sp-04063.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate any one part of the target's body. There is no recovery time.

sp-01581.description_en: Caster is aware of any active combat links within the area of effect.

sp-01582.description_en: Caster sends a mental message to the members of his Triad or Circle.

sp-01584.description_en: Members of the Triad share each other's perceptions in a non-distracting way. The Triad receives a +30 to Battle Awareness and +15 to general Awareness checks and Sense Ambush/Assassin checks.

sp-01585.description_en: Members of the Triad benefit from each other's intuition and foresight giving them all members a +15 to DB against all attacks.

sp-01586.description_en: Members of the Triad benefit from each other's strength giving them all a +15 to their Offensive Bonuses and Strength maneuvers.

sp-01587.description_en: Minor injuries done to a member of the Triad are shared with the members of the bond. Stunning, Hits, and Bleeding results are divided by three and assigned to all members of the Triad. All results are rounded down, so 2 rounds of stun will not affect the group and 5 rounds of stun will stun the entire group for 1 round.

sp-01588.description_en: The Power Points from each member of the Triad are added together to form a pool. Spells cast by any member are subtracted from this pool. Power Point multipliers therefore work differently for each member. Do not apply them to the pool; instead take the multiplier and divide the casting cost of the spell by the multiplier to determine the casting cost. When this spell ends, divide the Power Points left among each member of the Triad. Then those with Power Point multipliers can multiply these Power Points normally.

sp-01589.description_en: Members of the Triad can communicate mentally. When this spell is used, all members of the link can hear and participate as if having a conversation amongst themselves.

sp-01590.description_en: Allows the Elemental Champion to link to two other Elemental Champions of different elements within their Triad (Fire-Water-Ice or Air-Earth-Light). The link is completed when all three Champions successfully cast this spell. Once completed the link cannot be broken until the duration of this spell runs out. Spells 2-9 require that this Link be active for them to work.

sp-01591.description_en: Triad or Circle members can temporarily switch their main element for the duration of this spell. Members are restricted to elements represented by other members. (E.g., a Fire champion could temporarily switch his primary element to water, but could not switch to Air unless the Champion was a member of a Circle.)

sp-01593.description_en: Members of the Circle share each other's perceptions. The Circle receives a+50 to Battle Awareness and +30 to general Awareness checks and Sense Ambush/Assassin.

sp-01594.description_en: Members of the Circle benefit from the other's intuition and foresight, giving them a +30 to DB against all attacks. This bonus is cumulative with other bonuses.

sp-01595.description_en: Members of the Circle benefit from each other's strength, giving them a +30 to all of his offensive bonuses and Strength maneuvers.

sp-01596.description_en: II— As Shared Injuries I, except this spell only affects Circles and all injuries have their results divided by six rounded down. So an attack that delivered 5 rounds of stun would not affect any member of the group. An attack that did six rounds of stun would stun every member of the group for one round.

sp-01597.description_en: As Shared Power I, except this spell affects Circles.

sp-01599.description_en: Members of the Triad or Circle are hasted for the duration.

sp-01600.description_en: Allows an Elemental Champion to link to five other Elemental Champions of different Elements. The link is complete when all of the Champions successfully cast this spell. Once completed, the link cannot be broken until the duration of this spell runs out. Spells 12-19 require that this Link be complete for them to work. Once this linking has begun, members of the Circle have 5 minutes to successfully cast this spell or the link fails.

sp-01601.description_en: The Shared Power spell must be in effect for this spell to be cast. When this spell is successfully cast by all of the members of the Circle, it allows them to specify a single Elemental Champion as a Champion of Nether or Aether. The Aether or Nether Champion's spells work as if his primary element is Aether or Nether depending on which element was chosen. If the Champion's bonded weapon delivers additional criticals those criticals change to Aether or Nether. Whenever the Aether or Nether Champion casts a spell it draws power from every member of the Circle. Subtract 20 power points from the pool every time the champion casts a spell, in addition to the normal casting costs.

sp-01602.description_en: As Aether/Nether Champion, except when the champion casts spells it only draws 10 power points from the pool.

sp-01603.description_en: As Aether/Nether Champion, except the Champion may change what type of elemental force his spells are using at will from among all eight elements.

sp-01627.description_en: For the duration, the target hybrid elemental animal will believe the caster is a good friend. Attacking the creature will negate this spell. This spell lasts 1 round per 5% failure.

sp-01628.description_en: As Calm Hybrid I, except two animals are affected.

sp-01629.description_en: Caster summons a hybrid elemental animal of the same type as his chosen element. Animal is stationary for three rounds after summoning due to disorientation. If not controlled or mastered the animal will act according to its nature, if from this plane, or dissolve if an elemental spirit was called to animate a form.

sp-01630.description_en: Caster controls target hybrid elemental animal like it was a well-trained animal (note: this is not absolute control) while the caster concentrates. It can be commanded to attack, fetch, etc. If severely wounded it will retreat like a mundane animal. Concentration for this spell is not intense and only takes 20% of the caster's actions.

sp-01631.description_en: Sends a command to the caster's bonded animal that is inaudible to all but the animal. The animal must be within earshot.

sp-01632.description_en: Caster summons an Elemental Steed of the same type as his chosen element. The steed is stationary for three rounds after summoning due to disorientation. If not controlled or mastered the mount will act according to its nature, if from this plane, or dissolve, if an elemental spirit was called to animate the form.

sp-01633.description_en: As Control Hybrid, except for duration. The caster may only have one hybrid animal mastered at a time and it must be of the same element as the caster's chosen element.

sp-01634.description_en: Caster controls the target Elemental Steed like it was a well-trained horse. It can be ridden and understands the

sp-01635.description_en: Caster knows the location of all of his mastered animals if within the radius of this spell.

sp-01636.description_en: Caster sends a command to the animal that is out of caster's ear shot. Caster must know the location of the animal through the Locate Animal spell.

sp-01637.description_en: Caster gains +20 to Riding maneuvers and mounted combat while on an Elemental Steed (includes Elemental Riding Drakes) for the duration.

sp-01638.description_en: As Control Steed, except for the duration. The caster may only have a single mount mastered at a time and it must be of the same elemental type as the caster.

sp-01639.description_en: Caster specifies one animal bonded to them. If it is within range, it is transported instantly to the caster's left side.

sp-01640.description_en: As Silent Command, except it does not require the animal to be within earshot.

sp-01641.description_en: Calls the caster's mount (includes Elemental Riding Drakes) so it will come to where he is or as close as possible to where he is. This is a loud audible call.

sp-01642.description_en: Caster gains a +30 to Riding maneuver and Mounted Combat while on an elemental mount for the spell's duration (includes Elemental Riding Drakes).

sp-01643.description_en: As Summon Mount, except the mount is a Lesser Riding Drake.

sp-01644.description_en: As Control Mount, except it affects Lesser Riding Drakes of the same element as the caster's chosen element.

sp-01645.description_en: As Call Mount, except the call is silent.

sp-01646.description_en: As Control Lesser Riding Drake, except for the duration. The caster may only have a single mount (steed or riding drake) mastered at a time and it must be of the same elemental type as the caster.

sp-01670.description_en: Any unarmed attack that the caster delivers this round does an additional 'A' critical at -25 of the appropriate elemental type.

sp-01671.description_en: Any unarmed attack this round delivers an additional 'A' critical of the appropriate elemental type.

sp-01672.description_en: Caster's normal clothes bond to his skin and then transforms his skin to that of a Zephyr Hound. AT is 4 for the duration. Caster's skin will look like the hide of a Zephyr Hound of the same element as the caster.

sp-01673.description_en: Caster takes the form of an Elemental Servant of the appropriate type. The caster gains the abilities and attacks of the Elemental Servant but retains his hits and intelligence. Because of the size difference between the Servant Form and the caster's True Form attacks deliver 50% more damage. Spell casting is not possible. Offensive bonuses are considered to be

sp-01674.description_en: Any unarmed attack this round delivers an additional 'B' critical of the appropriate elemental type.

sp-01675.description_en: Caster takes the form of a Zephyr Hound of the appropriate type. Caster gains the abilities and attacks of the Zephyr Hound but retains his hits and intelligence. Spell casting is not possible. All offensive bonuses are 0. This may be counteracted by the caster developing skill in the attacks. The Breath Weapon skill is a sub-skill of Directed Spells and the Bite is a sub-skill of Martial Arts: Strikes.

sp-01676.description_en: Caster's normal clothes bond to his skin and then transform his skin to that of a Lesser Drake. AT is 12 for the duration. The caster's skin will look like the hide of the appropriate Lesser Drake.

sp-01677.description_en: Caster takes the form of a Lesser Elemental of the caster's chosen element. Caster gains the abilities and attacks of the Lesser Elemental but retains hits and intelligence. Spell casting is not possible in this form. All attacks have an Offensive Bonus of 0. Caster can develop skill in the attacks. The Bash attack(s) are a sub-skill of Martial Arts strikes and the Grapple is a sub-skill of Martial Arts: Sweeps.

sp-01678.description_en: Transforms the caster's hands into elemental material. Any unarmed attack delivered during the duration of this spell no longer delivers Martial Arts criticals. Instead they deliver Elemental Criticals of the appropriate type. Reduce critical severity from these attacks by one.

sp-01679.description_en: Any unarmed attack this round delivers an additional 'C' critical of the appropriate elemental type.

sp-01680.description_en: Caster takes the form of a Lesser Elemental of the caster's chosen element. The caster gains the abilities but not attacks of the Lesser Elemental. The caster retains hits, intelligence, weapons, armor and spell casting ability.

sp-01681.description_en: The next spell cast from this list has its' duration tripled. The spell must be cast within 3 rounds.

sp-01683.description_en: Caster's normal clothes bond to his skin and then transform his skin into that of a Dragon. AT is 20 for the duration. The caster's skin will look like the hide of the appropriate Dragon.

sp-01684.description_en: As Lesser Elemental Form, except the form is that of a Greater Elemental.

sp-01685.description_en: Caster takes the form of a Lesser Drake of his chosen element. Caster gains the abilities and attacks of the Lesser Drake but does not get the spell casting abilities nor does he know how to fly in this form. Caster must learn the appropriate Flying/Gliding skill to Fly in the Lesser Drake form. In addition, offensive bonuses for attacks are 0. Caster may develop skills in the attacks; refer to the Zephyr Form and Lesser Elemental Form spells for details. Spell casting is not possible in this form.

sp-01686.description_en: Caster takes the form of a Greater Elemental of the caster's chosen element. The caster gains the abilities but not attacks of the Greater Elemental. The caster retains hits, intelligence, weapons, armor and spell casting ability.

sp-01687.description_en: Caster takes the form of a High Elemental of the caster's chosen element. Caster gains the abilities and attacks of the High Elemental but retains hits and intelligence. Spell casting is not possible in this form.

sp-01688.description_en: Caster is protected from all natural forms of caster's main element; additionally target gets +10 to Resistance Rolls (RR's) against the caster's main element; and elemental attacks from the caster's main element are at -20. These bonuses apply to Magical, High, and True Elemental Material. This spell only works against attacks from the caster's Main element (Fire, for a Fire Champion; Ice, for an Ice Champion, etc.).

sp-01689.description_en: Triad— As Resist Main, except it is effective against one of the elements from the caster's triad. This must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-01690.description_en: As Resist Triad, except caster may choose any single element.

sp-01691.description_en: * — Elemental power is drained from elemental attacks of the caster's primary element, halving the damage delivered by the attack and reducing the Critical Severity by one. This will affect all attacks from the caster's main element that will strike the caster the round this spell is cast.

sp-01692.description_en: As Resist Main, except bonus is +20.

sp-01693.description_en: As Resist Triad, except bonus is +20.

sp-01694.description_en: As Resist Main, except it affects all of the elements from the caster's triad.

sp-01695.description_en: As Main Sink I, except it will work against any element from the caster's triad.

sp-01696.description_en: As Resist Element, except bonus is +20.

sp-01697.description_en: As Main Armor I, except it also decreases concussion hit damage from the caster's Main element by half, and decreases critical strikes by one level (e.g. 'A's become an 'A'25, 'B's become 'A's, 'C's become 'B's, etc.)

sp-01698.description_en: As Main Sink I, except damage is quartered and critical severities are reduced by two.

sp-01699.description_en: As Main Armor II except it affects any one element in the caster's triad, element affected is chosen at time of casting.

sp-01700.description_en: As Main Armor I, except it works against all three elements of the caster's triad.

sp-01701.description_en: As Main Sink II, except it will work against any element of the caster's triad.

sp-01702.description_en: As Main Armor II, except it affects any one element; element affected is chosen at time of casting.

sp-01705.description_en: Target is made completely immune to elemental attacks from the caster's Main Element.

sp-01706.description_en: As Main Immunity, except it works against any one element from the caster's triad. Element must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-01707.description_en: As Triad Immunity, except any element may be chosen.

sp-07608.description_en: Caster is aware of any Elemental Aether in the area of effect as long as he concentrates.

sp-07609.description_en: Caster channels Elemental Aether energy at the target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 1st level class “E” Nether based spell. The caster must make a successful Targeting maneuver to counter spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster, then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. The target spell receives no RR.

sp-07610.description_en: Target is protected from Elemental Aether, providing a +10 to the target's resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against Aether. This spell also provides a +5 bonus against all other elements except Nether.

sp-07611.description_en: An arc of Aether is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Aether Bolt Attack Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-07612.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of Aether (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Aether critical (no RR).

sp-07613.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it affects up to 5th level spells.

sp-07615.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it can effect up to 8th level spells.

sp-07616.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of Aether is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Aether Ball Table.

sp-07617.description_en: As Resist Aether, except bonus against Aether is +20 and +10 against all other elements.

sp-07618.description_en: As Aether Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-07619.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it can effect up to 11th level spells.

sp-07620.description_en: As Wall of Aether, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07621.description_en: Caster directs a ray of Aether energy at target non-sentient material. Target material is separated into its base elements (e.g., if a block of stone is disrupted, then it would

sp-07622.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it affects up to 15th level spells.

sp-07623.description_en: As Aether Ball II, except the radius is 20'.

sp-07624.description_en: As Aether Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-07625.description_en: As Aether Armor I, except the bonus is +20, target takes half damage and critical results are reduced one level in severity. Against all other elements it grants a +20 bonus.

sp-07626.description_en: Caster creates Aether energy within the radius that is non-damaging in nature. This energy will cling to and enhance all elemental attacks through the area. All elemental attacks originating within the radius or passing through the radius deliver double Concussion hit damage and gain a +10 to the attack roll.

sp-07627.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it affects any level spell. The caster must spend a number of power points 10% higher than the level of the spell to be countered.

sp-07628.description_en: As Aether Armor I, except target is immune to all Aether-based attacks. Against all other elements (except Nether), the target gains a +20 to DB and RR, halves all hits and reduces critical severities by one.

sp-07629.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-07630.description_en: Caster is aware of any elemental Nether in the area of effect as long as he concentrates.

sp-07631.description_en: Caster channels elemental Nether energy at the target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 1st level class “E” based spell of any elemental type except Nether. Caster must make a successful Directed Spells maneuver to counter spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. The target spell receives no RR.

sp-07632.description_en: Target is protected from elemental Nether, providing a +10 to the target's resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against Nether. This spell also provides a +5 bonus against all other elements except Aether.

sp-07633.description_en: An arc of Nether is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Nether Bolt Attack Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-07634.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it affects up to 3rd level spells.

sp-07635.description_en: Target inanimate matter is dissolved completely and reduced to nothingness. If something is held or worn, the item resists at the level of the person holding it. Magic items can resist at the level of their creator.

sp-07636.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of Nether (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Nether critical (no RR).

sp-07637.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it affects of up to 4th level spells.

sp-07638.description_en: A bolt of Nether is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Nether Bolt Table.

sp-07639.description_en: As Nether Resistance, except the bonus against Aether is +20.

sp-07640.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of Nether is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Nether Ball Table.

sp-07641.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it can effect up to 7th level spells.

sp-07643.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it can effect up to 8th level spells.

sp-07644.description_en: As Wall of Nether, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07645.description_en: Caster channels the raw essence of Nether at the target. The target must resist or have his entire body dissolved into nothingness.

sp-07647.description_en: As Nether Armor I, except the bonus is +20; target takes half damage, and critical results are reduced one level in severity.

sp-07649.description_en: Three bolts of Nether are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are within 60º of each other and they are visible to the caster). The caster may apply his directed spell skill (Nether Bolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB).

sp-07650.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it will work against any level spell.

sp-07651.description_en: Caster is able to detect all elemental energy forms within range. Energy forms include any manifestation of elemental fire or elemental light. Caster is able to discern whether or not the source is True Elemental Material.

sp-07652.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration of the spell has not expired). See note on light spells.

sp-07653.description_en: For each level of the caster, one cubic foot of liquid can be heated to boiling at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round. There is a 2% chance each round (non-cumulative) that the liquid becomes contaminated and undrinkable, turning into a level 1 ingested poison. The caster will not know that this has happened.

sp-07654.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 2 TEP attack.

sp-07655.description_en: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Of Essence, section 15.12 for details. Also see note on light spells for this list.

sp-07656.description_en: Causes any wood to ignite and burn. All wood ignited must be within 1' of the caster's palm. Targets exposed to wood during ignition are subject to a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07657.description_en: All shadows in the area of effect deepen. This results in a +25 bonus to Hiding maneuvers and +10 to Stalking maneuvers.

sp-07658.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of fire (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Heat critical (no RR) and a level 2 TEP attack.

sp-07659.description_en: Causes a 10'R burst of intense light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5% failure and must resist against a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07660.description_en: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 6 TEP attack.

sp-07661.description_en: As Light I, except the radius is as dark as night.

sp-07662.description_en: As Light I, except radius can be up to 50' (radius can be changed by concentrating for one round).

sp-07663.description_en: As Wall of Fire, except it creates a cube of flame (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical and a level 2 TEP attack.

sp-07664.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except range is 300'. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 7 TEP attack.

sp-07665.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 8 TEP attack.

sp-07666.description_en: As Dark I, except radius can be up to 50' (radius can be changed by concentrating for one round).

sp-07667.description_en: The caster may designate a type of light source to ignite or extinguish (e.g., candles, torches, fireplaces and lanterns, etc.) This spell will affect all of the light sources of the specified type(s) within the area of effect. Touching a light source at the time of ignition results in a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07668.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except a Lightning Bolt is shot. Resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 10 TEP attack.

sp-07669.description_en: As Wall of Fire, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07670.description_en: This spell is cast in conjunction with any Light or Dark spell (i.e., this spell is cast and then the light/dark spell is cast within 1 minute). It can delay the action of that spell for up to 24 hours. It can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): time period, specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent actions in the area, etc.

sp-07671.description_en: As Fire Bolt I, except range is 300'. The targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 12 TEP attack.

sp-07672.description_en: As Light I, except radius is 100' and caster has the choice of doing darkness or light. If the light version is chosen then the light also nullifies all magically created darkness. If the dark version is chosen then no non-magical light in the radius can exist. Magical darkness or any lights in the radius will return when this spell's duration expires. TEP exposure for either version, occurs every five rounds of continuous exposure. TEP level is 5 for this spell.

sp-07673.description_en: As Lighting Bolt I, except range is 500'. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 20 TEP attack.

sp-07694.description_en: Caster is aware of all elemental energies, forces, or materials in the area along with its direction and size. Type is unknown.

sp-07695.description_en: Caster analyzes an area for its elemental content. Type of element is known as well as its purity and strength.

sp-07696.description_en: Target gains +20 to their resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against all forms of Fire and Light (elemental or mundane). This will nullify the effects of any slow exposure (like that of a TEM Light spell off of the True Elemental Energy spell list).

sp-07698.description_en: As Resist Energy, except it affects all forms of Earth and Ice (elemental or mundane).

sp-07699.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target manifestation of elemental energy (Fire or Light) must resist or be rapidly diffused into the surrounding environment, making it harmless. This will affect a single spell or up to 10 cu' feet of elemental material.

sp-07700.description_en: Allows caster to see the effects of taint and the level of taint in area focused on. It takes a full minute of concentration to determine the full effects.

sp-07702.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Diffuse Energy, except it affects elemental forms (earth or ice).

sp-07703.description_en: Target who has had corruption due to an elemental attack or True Elemental Poisoning (TEP) may make another resistance roll against the attack at +20. If target fails to resist again, the failure amount may not exceed the original (i.e., make it worse). Damage caused by the original attack still must be healed before any penalties are removed. This spell only affects TEP from fire or light.

sp-07704.description_en: As Remove Energy, except it affects TEP from water or air.

sp-07705.description_en: As Remove Energy, except it affects TEP from ice or earth.

sp-07706.description_en: As Resist Energy, except it affects all who are within 10' of the target.

sp-07708.description_en: As Resist Forms, except it affects all who are within 10' of the target.

sp-07709.description_en: As Remove Energy, except Resistance Roll automatically succeeds.

sp-09376.description_en: Caster is able to determine the amount and type of elemental corruption within an item. If the item is cursed, the caster will know it is cursed but will not be able to tell what the nature of the curse is or how to remove it.

sp-09377.description_en: This spell allows a caster to memorize the taint patterns within an item. This is necessary to manipulate the corruption within an item.

sp-09378.description_en: Caster removes a single factor point from an item (caster chooses which one) changing it to a nonmanifesting factor point. This factor point is now free for use with other spells on this list.

sp-09379.description_en: Caster is able to change a nonmanifesting factor point to one of the desired type within an item. Subcategories are also chosen by the caster (e.g., the caster decides the item has a spell slot for a particular spell, instead of rolling randomly.) Total factor points in a factor may not be increased over 2 by the use of this spell.

sp-09380.description_en: Caster is able to predetermine one factor point in the item as it is being forged. This spell must be used in conjunction with the Elemental Forge spell list or it has no effect. This will cause the forging process to take as long as it would to cast this spell (i.e., 6 weeks). This spell will not prevent an item from being destroyed in the creation process.

sp-09381.description_en: As Remove Manifestation I, except the caster can remove up to two factor points from the item.

sp-09382.description_en: As Add Manifestation I, except up to two non-manifesting factor points may be changed with this spell. Factor points for a specific factor may not be increased over 3 through the use of this spell.

sp-09383.description_en: As Remove Manifestation I, except the caster can remove up to three factor points from the item.

sp-09384.description_en: As Add Manifestation I, except up to three non-manifesting factor points may be changed with this spell. Factor points for a specific factor may not be increased over 5 through the use of this spell.

sp-09388.description_en: As Remove Manifestation I, except caster can remove up to five factor points from the item.

sp-09389.description_en: As Add Manifestation I, except up to five non-manifesting factor points may be changed with this spell. Factor points for a specific factor may not be increased over 10 through the use of this spell.

sp-09390.description_en: Allows caster to force weapon's physical memory into an item that risks losing its physical form (i.e., an item of Air, Water, Light or Fire). By forcing the item to retain its physical memory, the item will retains its physical hardness while still manifesting the corruptive properties of the element. This spell must be cast on an item once a day for a week for the effects to become permanent.

sp-09391.description_en: As Favorable Manifestation I, except caster can predetermine up to four factor points.

sp-09392.description_en: As Favorable Manifestation II, except caster can predetermine up to five factors points.

sp-09393.description_en: Allows caster to create an elemental item with its capabilities restricted to two of the six factor options (chosen at the time of casting). All factors that the item gains will be split between the two chosen factors. Roll randomly for each factor point (equal chance for either factor.) This spell must be used in conjunction with the Elemental Forge spell list. Creation time is equal to one week per level of the Elemental Forge spell used.

sp-09394.description_en: Elemental material of the caster's main elemental type is pooled into a vessel for use with the Forge spells on this list. If the vessel has not been prepared with Prepare Tool, then the vessel will be destroyed by the elemental material and will risk damaging other equipment (effects are up to GM).

sp-09395.description_en: Prepares a tool or vessel for work with elemental material. The item will not corrode or suffer contamination while under the effects of this spell. Gloves are usually one of the first items protected by this spell. Anvils or furnaces cannot be protected by this spell.

sp-09396.description_en: As Prepare Tool, except this spell affects anvils.

sp-09037.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 5th level.

sp-09038.description_en: Allows the caster to attach an external body part (such as a hand, foot, etc.) to an assembled or living Amalgam in a one-hour operation. If the Surgery maneuver is successful and the target fails to resist this spell, then the appendage will function normally for the Amalgam.

sp-09040.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be up to 10th level.

sp-09041.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can attach a limb to an Amalgam and the operation takes 2 hours.

sp-09042.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 10th level.

sp-09044.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can attach (or transplant) a sensory organ (such as an eye, tongue, ear, etc.) into an Amalgam and the operation takes 3 hours.

sp-09045.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be up to 15th level.

sp-09047.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can transplant an internal organ (such as a heart, liver, lung) into an Amalgam and the operation takes 3 hours.

sp-09048.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 15th level.

sp-09049.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can attach or transplant a mechanical body part and the operation takes 3 hours.

sp-09050.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be up to 20th level.

sp-09051.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 20th level.

sp-09052.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be of any level.

sp-09053.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of any level.

sp-09031.description_en: Caster can preserve one corpse (or a severed body part) from any deterioration and decay for the duration of this spell.

sp-09032.description_en: This spell analyzes one Amalgam, giving the caster in-depth information on how it was created and on its abilities. This translates into a +25 bonus to all maneuvers made by the caster to fashion an Amalgam of a similar nature.

sp-09033.description_en: Caster can convert a living person (of up to 3rd level) into a “Living” Amalgam of the same level or assemble (from body parts) an “assembled” Amalgam of up to 3rd level.

sp-09034.description_en: Caster can totally control an Amalgam of up to 3rd level. If the target is a “Living” Amalgam, then the duration of this spell is 1 hour per level of the caster and the range is 100' per level of the caster. If the target is an “assembled” Amalgam, then the duration of this spell is 1 day per level of the caster and the range is 1000' per level of the caster. If the Amalgam moves beyond this range or the spell expires, then the Amalgam is free to act (including attacking the caster). When not acting on the caster's orders, the Amalgam Special Notes will wait idly by on the next command. 1.Many of the spells described here have a duration of “24

sp-09035.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting hours”. For these spells, it is assumed that the caster must Amalgam can be up to 5th level. cast the spell once per day during the creation process

sp-09073.description_en: The caster may restore 7d10 concussion hits of damage to an Automaton or repair all malfunctions or replace all damaged parts with spares. Any repairs or replacements take 10 minutes to take effect.

sp-09075.description_en: Allows the caster to add a True Empowerment to any type of Automaton.

sp-09076.description_en: Allows the caster to create and imbue with magical energy an Automaton (Device, Machine, or Vehicle), whose mundane capabilities depend on “advanced” (pseudo)scientific principles. Special Notes 1.Many of the spells described here have a duration of “24 hours”. For these spells, it is assumed that the caster must cast the spell once per day during the creation process (see also Spell Law, section 7.4.1) — the creations of these spell lists are permanent unless otherwise stated. 2.For details on the definitions and basic capabilities of Device, Machine, and Vehicle Automata, as well as appropriate Empowerments, please see Chapter 5.

sp-09085.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify whatever the target uses for manipulation (e.g. fingers, toes, claws, nails, webbing between digits, small tentacles).

sp-09086.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify miscellaneous external appendages (e.g. sex organs, stingers, rattles, web spinners, etc., but not hands or feet).

sp-09087.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify in shape or sensory range one sensory organ (e.g. eyes, ears, nose, etc.).

sp-09088.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify any one (pair of) limb(s) (e.g. arm, leg, wing, tentacle, tail) or limb part (e.g. hand, foot, joint, etc.).

sp-09089.description_en: Caster can alter the overall size of a creature by one step (e.g. from Tiny to Small, Small to Medium, Medium to Large, Large to Huge, or vice versa).

sp-09090.description_en: Caster can add, remove or modify any one internal organ of the target (e.g. gills, glands, heart, lungs, poison sac, sex organs, spit, stomach) or affect the target internally (e.g. balance, blood type, bone density, fat layer, floatation, metabolism).

sp-09091.description_en: By casting this spell, the caster may make the next Change spell of 10th level or lower on this list affect the target and be inherited by all his/ her future progeny.

sp-09092.description_en: Caster can alter any one racial Resistance Roll modifier of the target by +5 or —5.

sp-09093.description_en: Caster can alter any one racial stat modifier of the target by +2 or —2.

sp-09094.description_en: If cast on two targets of the opposite sex, who then mate within the duration, the union will result in a fertile hybrid offspring, known as an Abomination. The targets may be of different species, but not of different “orders” (e.g. mammals, reptiles, fish, birds, etc.) e.g. using this spell, a lion may be mated with a horse, but a lion may not successfully mate with a crocodile. The result in form and statistics is at the GM's discretion.

sp-09095.description_en: Caster can make any target with animal instincts or no intelligence sentient (roll d100 for each mental stat). This spell has no effect on targets who are already sentient.

sp-09096.description_en: Caster can alter the target to any desired shape or form.

sp-09097.description_en: As Inherit Lesser Change, except any Change spell of 20th level or lower may be made permanent.

sp-09098.description_en: As Lesser Abomination, but the targets may be of any species.

sp-09099.description_en: As Greater Abomination, but the caster may choose the form and statistics (within limits) of the resulting hybrid.

sp-09077.description_en: Caster may magically study and store the form and nature of the target, if it fails to resist this spell. The caster must spend one minute in uninterrupted concentration after a successful casting in order to assimilate the information. Caster may only have as many targets stored as his temporary Memory stat (not stat bonus). Stored patterns may be released at any time.

sp-09078.description_en: This spell analyzes one Changeling, giving the caster in-depth information on how the changes were made and the nature of the changes (+25 to any maneuvers related to this knowledge). Even if the caster does not have the Changeling's original form stored, this spell gives the caster sufficient details to use the appropriate higher-level Change spell(s) to reverse the effects. Abominations cannot be reversed by this means.

sp-09079.description_en: Target's skin is altered (e.g. one change in hue, addition/removal of spots or stripes, one change in texture (oily, dry, scaly, leathery, metallic, etc.)).

sp-09080.description_en: Target's natural armor type can be raised or lowered by 1. Armor Type may not be reduced below 1 or raised above 20.

sp-09081.description_en: Caster can add, remove or modify one external bone projection of target (e.g. antlers, barbs, beaks, horns, talons, thorns, etc.). Special Notes

sp-09082.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify any 1.See Chapter 8 for details on Changelings and Abomione piece of external cartilage of the target (e.g. antenna, ear, nations. nose, spikes, stalks, etc.). 2.All Change spells on this list require the caster to

sp-09083.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify any one concentrate for a number of rounds equal to the spell's external body part that covers another (e.g. eye lids, gill slots, level after casting for the spell to take permanent effect. neck and stomach pouches, feathers, fur, hair, whiskers, etc.). The caster must continue touching the target during this period. If either of these conditions is not met, the

sp-09084.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify parts of spell will fail and the effect will be undone. the target's mouth (e.g. snout, lips, teeth, fangs, suckers, tusks, tongue).

sp-09140.description_en: Caster can restore all concussion hits to a Construct or unite a replacement body part to a Construct. Installing a replacement body part takes 1 hour to take effect.

sp-09141.description_en: As Purge Construct V, except one spirit of any level can be expelled.

sp-09142.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 20 can be created and animated.

sp-09143.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Construct of any level.

sp-09144.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 30 can be created and animated.

sp-09145.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of any creation level can be created and animated. Special Notes: 1.Many of the spells on this spell list have a duration of 24 hrs — the creation process requires that these spells be cast once per day during entity creation and gives the caster the ability to enchant entities for a whole day. The Construct's animation is permanent once the creation process is complete. 2.For more details on Construct creation, please see Chapter 6.

sp-09215.description_en: Caster is aware of any spirits trapped or possessing any golems within range.

sp-09216.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Wood Golem.

sp-09217.description_en: Allows the caster to expel one spirit of up to 5th level from a Golem.

sp-09218.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Water or an Ice Golem.

sp-09219.description_en: Allows the caster to inscribe a symbol on a Golem of up to 10th level, which will prevent any spirit from possessing the entity without permission from its creator. Any spirit trapped within the Golem must obey the entity's creator and designated master. At casting, the caster must choose what will happen if the glyph is defaced: either the Golem will deanimate (until the Glyph is repaired) or the protection against possession is removed and any spirit already possessing the Golem is released from obedience to the entity's creator and master. It takes one round per creation level of the entity to inscribe the glyph.

sp-09220.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from any organic materials, such as a Tar Golem, a Clay Golem, or a Bone Golem.

sp-09221.description_en: Caster can restore 2d10 concussion hits to a Golem or reattach an undamaged body part to a Golem or repair a damaged body part, which is still attached to a Golem. A reattachment or repair takes 10 minutes to take effect.

sp-09222.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Stone Golem.

sp-09223.description_en: As Purge Golem V, except one spirit of up to 10th level can be expelled.

sp-09224.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from a single non-magical metal, excluding iron. This spell covers Copper Golems, Lead Golems, Silver Golems, and Gold Golems.

sp-09225.description_en: Caster can restore 5d10 concussion hits to a Golem or reattach a damaged body part to a Golem, as long as all the bits are available. A reattachment takes 30 minutes to take effect.

sp-09226.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from any non-magical alloy, excluding steel. This spell covers Brass Golems and Bronze Golems.

sp-09227.description_en: As Purge Golem V, except one spirit of up to 20th level can be expelled.

sp-09228.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate an Iron Golem.

sp-09229.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Golem of up to 20th level.

sp-09230.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Crystal Golem.

sp-09231.description_en: Caster can restore all concussion hits to a Golem or unite a replacement body part to a Golem. Installing a replacement body part takes 1 hour to take effect.

sp-09232.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Steel Golem.

sp-09233.description_en: As Purge Golem V, except one spirit of any level can be expelled.

sp-09234.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from non-magical gems, excluding diamond. This spell covers Emerald Golems, Ruby Golems, and Sapphire Golems.

sp-09235.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Golem of any level.

sp-09236.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Diamond Golem.

sp-09237.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem from any material, including magical metals, alloys and crystals. Special Notes 1.Many of the spells on this spell list have a duration of 24 hrs — the creation process requires that these spells be cast once per day during entity creation and gives the caster the ability to enchant entities for a whole day. The Golem's animation is permanent once the creation process is complete. 2.For more details on Golem creation, please see Chapter 6.

sp-09300.description_en: As Animal/Plant Matrix, except the Simulacrum may be shaped into a beast form (e.g. monster, unnatural creature, or sentient plant) or the vat is designed for one such form.

sp-09301.description_en: As Warp Matrix I, except the caster may make one Greater alteration.

sp-09302.description_en: Target Simulacrum is healed of any one shattered bone or joint or one damaged nerve or one damaged external or internal organ. In all cases, a recovery time of 1-10 days is required.

sp-09303.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 20th level.

sp-09304.description_en: The caster may command a Simulacrum of any level, even if the caster is not its blood donor. The caster must concentrate for one round to give or cancel an order, but need not maintain concentration to ensure the order is undertaken. The simulacrum will continue to obey the order until it is accomplished or cancelled or the spell's duration ends. If the Simulacrum moves beyond the spell's range of the caster, the spell ends. If the Simulacrum receives orders from its creator / blood donor in the same round as it receives an order from the caster, the Entity may make a new RR. Success terminates this spell.

sp-09305.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 30th level.

sp-09306.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be of any level.

sp-09100.description_en: Allows the caster to store the parameters of any one spell cast within the next minute for use in later imbedding. Thereafter, the creator may cast the Research spell (at a power point cost of one plus the level of the imbedded spell) instead of the imbedded spell itself. A caster may only have one spell's parameters stored in a Research spell at any given time (but may choose to replace the stored spell at any time.)

sp-09101.description_en: Allows caster to imbed a 1st-level spell of any realm into an artificial entity.

sp-09102.description_en: Allows caster to charge an entity with 20 charges of any spell (imbedded using an Imbed spell).

sp-09103.description_en: Allows caster to imbed a 1st-level spell (using an Imbed spell) that can be cast once per day.

sp-09104.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09105.description_en: Allows caster to imbed a 1st-level spell (using an Imbed spell) so that it functions either constantly or “at will”.

sp-09106.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 3 times per day; a 2nd or 3rd, once per day.

sp-09107.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09108.description_en: As Minor Charged Power, except the entity receives 50 charges.

sp-09109.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09110.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09111.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 5 times per day; a 2nd, twice per day; a 3rd, 4th, or 5th, once per day.

sp-09112.description_en: As Minor Charged Power, except the entity receives 100 charges.

sp-09113.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09114.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09115.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 7 times per day; a 2nd, 3 times per day; a 3rd, twice per day; a 4th, 5th, 6th, or 7th, once per day.

sp-09116.description_en: As Minor Charged Power, except the entity receives 200 charges.

sp-09117.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09118.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 10 times per day; a 2nd, 5 times per day; a 3rd, 3 times per day; a 4th or 5th, twice per day; a 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th, once per day.

sp-09119.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 20th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09120.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09121.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 20th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 20 times per day; a 2nd, 10 times per day; a 3rd, 6 times per day; a 4th, 5 times per day; a 5th, 4 times per day; a 6th, 3 times per day; a 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th, twice per day; a 11th to 20th level spell, once per day.

sp-09122.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 20th level spells can be imbedded. Special Notes

sp-09211.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09212.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09213.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 10 times per day; a 2nd, 5 times per day; a 3rd, 3 times per day; a 4th or 5th, twice per day; a 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th, once per day.

sp-09214.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded. Special Notes 1.Many of the spells on this spell list have a duration of 24 hrs — the creation process requires that these spells be cast once per day during entity creation and gives the caster the ability to enchant entities for a whole day. The Golem's animation is permanent once the creation process is complete.

sp-09261.description_en: Caster grants a measure of rudimentary reasoning to the entity. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats with a range of values from 11 to 30. After the spell is cast, roll a d20 and add 10 (D20+10) separately to determine Re and Me stats randomly. If the caster's Memory or Reasoning stats are lower than the randomly generated stats, then use the caster's stats instead. The entity will be able to follow simple orders (e.g. single sentences of ten words or less), but will have no ability for independent thinking.

sp-09262.description_en: Caster grants the entity the ability to understand a specific language. The number of ranks in both written and spoken forms is equal to the ranks possessed by the caster. The entity cannot actually speak using this spell.

sp-09263.description_en: Caster imparts up to five category ranks of a single chosen skill category to the entity.

sp-09264.description_en: Caster imparts up to five skill ranks of a single chosen skill to the entity. Ranks in spell lists, Power Point Development, Body Development and language skills may not be imbedded.

sp-09265.description_en: Caster can extend the duration of the next spell cast from this list onto an entity to 1 day per level of the caster.

sp-09266.description_en: The entity's eyes record all that it sees during the duration of this spell for playback later (the caster need only look into their eyes).

sp-09267.description_en: As Imbed Category V, except the caster imparts up to ten category ranks.

sp-09268.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to ten skill ranks.

sp-09269.description_en: As Low Sentience, except the caster grants a greater measure of rudimentary reasoning to the entity. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats with a range of values from 33 to

sp-09270.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 1 week per level of the caster.

sp-09271.description_en: As Visual Recording, except that the entity's ears can record any sounds that it hears during the duration of this spell for playback later (the caster need only touch their ears to hear the sounds himself.)

sp-09272.description_en: Caster grants the entity the ability to speak any languages to understand. Golem voices are low and rumbling; Construct voices sound hollow.

sp-09273.description_en: As Imbed Category V, except the caster imparts up to fifteen category ranks.

sp-09274.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to fifteen skill ranks.

sp-09275.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 1 month per level of the caster.

sp-09276.description_en: The caster grants the entity a measure of willpower and personality. This takes the form of either Self Discipline, Intuition, Empathy and Presence stats with a range of values from 33 to 69 (roll 4d10 and add 29 (4D10+29) to determine each stat randomly) or one of Self Discipline, Intuition, Empathy and Presence stats with a range of values from 70 to 89 (roll d20 and add 69 (D20+69) to determine the chosen stat). This spell can be cast multiple times. If the caster's equivalent stat is lower than the randomly generated stat, use the caster's stat instead.

sp-09277.description_en: As Medium Sentience, except the caster grants the entity the ability of independent thinking. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats with a range of values from 70 to 89. After the spell is cast, roll d20 and add 69 (D20+69) separately to determine Re and Me stats randomly. The entity will thus be able to improvise solutions by adapting previously received orders to new situations.

sp-09278.description_en: As Imbed Category V, except the caster imparts up to twenty category ranks.

sp-09279.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to twenty skill ranks.

sp-09280.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 1 year per level of the caster.

sp-09281.description_en: As High Sentience, except the caster grants the entity a high degree of intelligence. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats

sp-09182.description_en: As Manifest Element I, except either two random Elemental Minor Powers or one random Elemental Lesser Power can be triggered. A Class B Elemental must be imbedded to trigger a Lesser Power.

sp-09183.description_en: As Elemental Banish I, except the caster can banish one Class C Elemental.

sp-09184.description_en: As Elemental Summons I, except the caster can summon a Class C Elemental.

sp-09185.description_en: As Elemental Imbed I, except the caster can imbed a Class C Elemental.

sp-09186.description_en: As Elemental Compel I, except the caster can control a Class C Elemental.

sp-09187.description_en: As Manifest Element I, except either three random Elemental Minor Powers or two random Elemental Lesser Powers or one random Elemental Greater Power can be triggered. A Class B (or higher) Elemental must be imbedded to trigger a Lesser Power; a Class C (or higher) must be imbedded to trigger a Greater Power.

sp-09188.description_en: As Extend Compel I, except the duration is now 1 week per level of the caster and the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-09189.description_en: As Elemental Summons I, except the caster can summon a Class D Elemental.

sp-09190.description_en: As Elemental Imbed I, except the caster can imbed a Class D Elemental.

sp-09248.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 10th level.

sp-09249.description_en: As Imbed Being Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a being of up to 10th level.

sp-09250.description_en: As Imbed Beast Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast of up to 10th level.

sp-09251.description_en: As Body Stasis I, except the duration of the stasis is one week per level of the caster.

sp-09252.description_en: Caster can prevent a life essence transferred out of its own body but not imbedded in an artificial body from dissipating out of its current container for the duration of this spell.

sp-09253.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 15th level.

sp-09254.description_en: As Imbed Being Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a being of up to 15th level.

sp-09255.description_en: As Imbed Beast Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast of up to 15th level.

sp-09256.description_en: As Body Stasis I, except the duration of the stasis is one week per level of the caster.

sp-09257.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 20th level.

sp-09258.description_en: As Imbed Being Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a being of up to 20th level.

sp-09259.description_en: As Imbed Beast Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast of up to 20th level.

sp-09260.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal, being, or beast of any level. Special Notes 1.See section 7.2.5 for a full treatment of how this spell list should be used.

sp-09307.description_en: Allows the caster to detect any spirit within the area of effect of the spell. The caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09308.description_en: The caster learns the type of a given Spirit as well as its power level.

sp-09309.description_en: Gives the caster the ability to speak with and understand Spirits.

sp-09310.description_en: The caster can banish one spirit of up to 5th level back to the Spirit world. The Spirit may make a Resistance Roll.

sp-09311.description_en: Caster learns the number of taint levels possessed by a given Spirit.

sp-09312.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a spirit of up to 5th level of a type chosen by the caster prior to the casting of this spell. The caster is not granted the ability to converse with the spirit nor any control over the Spirit through this spell. The Spirit will appear before the caster as a wavering form.

sp-09313.description_en: Allows the caster to imbed a Spirit of up to 5th level into a Golem or a Construct within 10' of the caster. The Spirit may make a Resistance Roll to prevent this.

sp-09314.description_en: The caster may totally control one Spirit of up to 5th level. The Spirit receives an initial Resistance Roll to resist this spell's effects. If the Spirit is not imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 1 minute per level of the caster, and the range is 100'. If the Spirit moves outside this 100' range, then it becomes free to attack the caster and/or return to the Spirit world. If the Spirit is imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 1 hour per level of the caster and the range is 100' per level of the caster. If the Golem or Construct moves beyond this range or the spell expires, then the Spirit is free to act (including attacking the caster) — however the imbedded Spirit cannot leave the body of the entity. When not acting on the caster's orders, the Spirit will wait idly by on the next command.

sp-09315.description_en: As Banish Spirit V, except the caster can banish one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09316.description_en: As Summon Spirit V, except the caster can summon one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09317.description_en: The caster may purify up to one taint level per caster level from a given Spirit. Each level of taint that a Spirit has gives it a special bonus of +5 to its Resistance Roll.

sp-09318.description_en: As Imbed Spirit V, except the caster can imbed one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09319.description_en: As Compel Spirit V, except the caster can control one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09320.description_en: If cast within one minute prior to casting a Compel Spirit spell on a spirit imbedded within a Golem or Construct, it increases the duration to 1 day per level of the caster and the range to 1000' per level of the caster. This has no effect on a Compel Spirit spell used to control a disembodied Spirit.

sp-09321.description_en: As Banish Spirit V, except the caster can banish one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09322.description_en: As Summon Spirit V, except the caster can summon one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09323.description_en: As Imbed Spirit V, except the caster can imbed one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09324.description_en: As Compel Spirit V, except the caster can control one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09325.description_en: As Banish Spirit V, except the caster can banish one Spirit of any level.

sp-09326.description_en: As Summon Spirit V, except the caster can summon one Spirit of any level.

sp-09327.description_en: As Extend Compel I, except the duration is now 1 week per level of the caster and the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-09328.description_en: As Imbed Spirit V, except the caster can imbed one Spirit of any level.

sp-09329.description_en: As Compel Spirit V, except the caster can control one Spirit of any level. Special Notes 1.See chapter 7 for details on imbedding Spirits, types of Spirits, taint levels, etc.

sp-09341.description_en: Allow the caster to temporarily annul the effects of one Awaken Ability or one Awaken Spell or one Awaken Skill spell on the target Simulacrum.

sp-09342.description_en: Caster can identify the creator (and blood donor, if any) of one Amalgam, Simulacrum, or Changeling.

sp-09343.description_en: As Trace Abomination I, except the range is 1000' per level of the caster.

sp-09344.description_en: As Restore Changeling V, except one Change of up to 10th-level can be reversed.

sp-09347.description_en: As Suppress Awakened, except for the shorter range and the permanent duration.

sp-09348.description_en: As Suppress Graft, except the duration is permanent.

sp-09349.description_en: As Restore Changeling V, except one Change of up to 15th-level can be reversed.

sp-09352.description_en: As Restore Changeling V, except all Changes of any level can be reversed.

sp-09353.description_en: Caster can detect the presence of any Golem or Construct in the area of effect. Caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09354.description_en: Caster learns the location of any Glyph of Control on the target's body.
